sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-1E
sections.overview: The pre-main amplifier of the QUEST series was developed and designed with the concept of quality, and introduced high quality materials and high quality parts.In order to achieve excellent DC performance, the differential amplifier of the first and second pre-drive stages employs a high-precision dual transistor for measuring instruments, and the main part from the pre-drive stage to the final output stage employs a high-precision resistor with an error of   0.1% to achieve a stable circuit configuration.By reexamining the circuit design and the phase compensation method, it was possible to reduce the negative feedback amount of the overall and also succeeded in eliminating the filter coil of the output part, which is one of the causes of sound quality degradation.This eliminates the influence of electromagnetic coupling with other circuits, and makes it possible to prevent an increase in output impedance in the high frequencies.By incorporating the output relay into the negative feedback loop, the equivalent linearity of the contact section is improved.We have developed a new real-time temperature compensation circuit for output transistors to minimize the degradation of sound quality caused by bias fluctuations due to changes in loads and music signals.In this method, a two chip dual transistor is used, one of which monitors the loss of the output transistor, and the other detects a proportional temperature change and controls the bias.Since this method cannot be used for a large output amplifier due to the limitation of the control element used, the rated output is set to 50W. However, the linearity at low load is improved by using a Pc = 80W transistor for the output stage to increase the current margin.The power transformer is equipped with a newly developed toroidal type LASER transformer, which realizes small size, large capacity and low leakage flux characteristics taking advantage of the high efficiency characteristics of the toroidal type.The chassis uses a 9 mm thick non-magnetic all-aluminum extrusion molded monocoque chassis on the front panel. With the latest high-precision machining technology, it has a high-precision finish with an error of   0.5 mm.By providing many ribs on the inner and outer surfaces, chassis rigidity is improved and unwanted resonance is reduced.In addition, the transformer, heat sink, and printed circuit board are mounted in isolation with the chassis using an insulator to ensure high rigidity and no resonance.High-precision and high-quality parts have been introduced. In addition to high-precision dual transistors for measuring instruments and high-precision resistors with an error of   0.1%, which are used for differential amplification, ultra-low-distortion volume, film conditioners manufactured by Raderstein of Germany, and low-impedance, 70 ? m copper foil printed circuit boards that are twice as thick as conventional ones, all have been used for high sound quality.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-1EVER2
sections.overview: Based on the A-1E of the Quest Integra series, this pre-main amplifier was developed by reviewing the basic operation of the circuit and the elements used.In general amplifiers, phase correction is used to suppress high-frequency characteristics in order to prevent problems such as oscillation. This deteriorates the naked characteristics of the amplifier and adversely affects sound quality.The A-1Ever2 realizes excellent frequency characteristics extending to 200 kHz or more by reducing the phase correction as much as possible. The solution is to install the phase correction circuit in a circuit with little influence on sound quality and to use carefully selected parts.The output filter coil has been eliminated, and combined with flat damping technology that ensures a flat warping factor characteristic in the audible band, a stretchy high range characteristic is achieved.We have also succeeded in reducing the negative feedback of the overall by reducing the distortion factor in the high frequency range.By lowering the output impedance of the circuit, the adverse effect of the electromotive force caused by the inertia of the speaker on the operation mechanism of the amplifier circuit is eliminated.In addition, a real-time temperature compensation circuit is adopted to reduce bias fluctuation due to changes in load and music signal, and to improve stability of operation.The capacitor in the power supply section is equipped with a blue capacitor, development number 923, which has been developed for three years to achieve both energy and high resolution.In addition, the power transformer is equipped with a toroidal type LASER with ultra-low leakage flux characteristics and an inverter.In addition, it uses a 15A-type bridge rectifier diode with a margin.The front panel is 9 mm thick, highly rigid, non-magnetic all-aluminum extrusion molded monocoque chassis. This chassis is finished to an accuracy of   0.5 mm by high-precision machining technology. By providing many ribs on the inside and outside, the rigidity of the chassis is improved and unwanted resonance is reduced.In addition, the transformer, heat sink, and printed circuit board are mounted in isolation with the chassis using an insulator. The insulator supporting the chassis is DuPont Corian, and the concept of non-resonance and high rigidity is thoroughly implemented.The speaker terminal uses the well-established WBT terminal.In addition, the PIN terminal uses newly manufactured high rigidity brass machined gold plated terminal, and the rear panel is fixed to the rigid with 2 point stops for 1 pair of left and right.The space between the left and right terminals is 18 mm, making it possible to use thick PIN plugs.It uses thorough parts such as high-precision dual transistor for measuring instrument in differential amplifier, high-precision resistance of   0.1% error, low-distortion volume, Radarstein Film Con, 70 ? m copper foil printed circuit board, etc.

sections.title: ONKYO A-1VL
sections.overview: PWM pre-main amplifier using VL Digital.The PWM digital amplifier realizes 90% higher power efficiency than an analog amplifier with a maximum efficiency of approximately 70%. As a result, it consumes less power and generates less heat, making it possible to size.Taking advantage of this advantage, the A-1VL uses a thin design, while improving the reproducibility of power and speed, which are the sound quality characteristics of digital amplifiers.PWM (pulse width modulation) method is adopted for A/D modulation which converts analog signals into digital signals.The A-1VL uses a VL digital circuit developed by Onkyo for audio applications.The VL digital is an integral-type modulation circuit with two circuits consisting of a vector generator, an integrator, and an inversion trigger generator. Therefore, even if spike noise, which is the cause of conversion error, enters from outside, the spike noise itself has a symmetrical waveform. As a result, the energy of the upper and lower waveforms cancel each other, making error-free A/D conversion possible.When the signal changes from 0 to 1 (or from 1 to 0), a large current flows through the power line of the digital amplifier. If the impedance of this part is high, the characteristics and operation stability are affected.To cope with this problem, copper bus plates with a thickness of 1.5 mm and a width of 5 mm are used for the power lines. The ultra-low impedance reduces power transmission loss to less than 1 / 40.The internal wiring from the output circuit of the amplifier to the speaker terminal is 1.5 mm thick, 12 mm wide and 18 mm cross-sectional area.2It uses extremely thick copper bus plates and is connected at the shortest distance, providing excellent power transmission comparable to that of extremely thick cables.Uses a brass scraping insulator.Machined gold plated pin jacks are used for the terminals.A large speaker terminal is used for the output terminal.It has a main in jack so that it can also be used as a power amplifier.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-917
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier released as the new Integra series in the 90's.A "Current Drive Amplifier", a current amplifier, is mounted on the output stage and a "BI-MOS Drive System" is combined into a super current amplifier structure.The current drive amplifier takes note of the fact that the important process of "voltage to current" conversion is carried out by the output stage transistor of the conventional amplifier with drastic temperature change. The current drive amplifier is composed so that "voltage to current" conversion is completed in the previous stage of the output stage, and the output stage only amplifies the current.This allows current amplification in an extremely stable state without being affected by the heat generated by the output transistor.The BI-MOS drive system brings out the advantages of a MOS FET and a bipolar transistor. As the input voltage increases, the MOS FET exhibits a gentle rising curve in the low-current region, while in the high-current region, the stretch and linear characteristics of the bipolar transistor become dominant.As a result, almost linear characteristics can be obtained in the crossover region, and linearity with elongation even at large amplitude is realized.The super current amplifier has a structure that adopts a BI-MOS drive system that converts voltage to current at the front stage of the output stage.All stages constituting the power amplifier are push-pull specifications with perfect symmetry between the + side and the side to suppress asymmetrical distortion of the waveform.The LASER transformer originally developed by Onkyo is used as the power transformer.The newly developed LASER transformer employs a new type of conversion core with a wider outer circumference than the standard one. This is a result of focusing on the fact that the magnetic leakage from the outer circumference reduces electric resistance by widening the outer circumference. The ratio of the outer circumference to the center 2 was previously 1, but the width of the outer circumference is widened from 1 to 1.07 in the LASER transformer.In addition, the core is carefully shielded by silicon steel plate shielding material, and as a result, leakage flux is reduced to 1 / 30 compared with conventional EI transformers.The chassis structure adopts a 2-box 2-division bottom chassis structure with the power supply and other stages separated.In addition, the power stage and small signal section are divided into blocks by a heat sink to guard against interference to the small signal section.The secondary winding of the power transformer is separated and independent for power amplifier and protector circuit. Sub-transformers are mounted for microcomputer and display to supply power independently to each stage, eliminating interference between each stage.In order to reproduce all music signals with high purity, we have adopted a simple direct design that sends signals directly to the power amplifier via a dedicated volume.When the source direct switch is set to DIRECT, simple transmission is possible, and when the position is set to TONE, direct tone adjustment is possible.Equipped as standard with a remote control function that allows you to perform power supply, volume, input selector and muting from your hand.Since the volume and input selector employ a motor-driven mechanical system, there is no nonlinear distortion that occurs in semiconductor switches.The capacitor in the power supply section is firmly fixed by a new type of Chemi-Con damping structural material.The bottom chassis is coated with PVC to reduce vibration.High-speed diode, AC cord with polarity display, and die-cast and detent volume are adopted.The side panel is a BMC side panel.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-917F
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier based on A-917 and improved.The power amplifier section uses a super-current amplifier configuration unique to Onkyo.This amplifier uses a Bi-MOS drive system that performs voltage-current conversion before the output stage. The current drive amplifier achieves stable and linear amplification by current-current amplification.The current drive amplifier is not affected by the voltage-to-current conversion characteristics of the transistor unlike the conventional output stage. It is composed of a current amplifier that supplies the output current to the speaker in proportion to the current sent from the previous stage. It has excellent linearity and does not vary with temperature.The Bi-MOS drive system adopted in the previous stage is a circuit using two elements, a MOS FET and a bipolar transistor. In the low-current region, the MOS FET exhibits a gentle rise curve, and in the high-current region, the stretchy and linear characteristics of the bipolar transistor are dominant. As a result, characteristics close to a straight line are obtained in the crossover region, and linearity characteristics with elongation are realized even in the large-amplitude region.In addition, this power amplifier section has push-pull specifications for all stages with perfect symmetry of + side / - side. The current drive amplifier stage of the final stage following the differential amplifier stage of the first stage, pre-driver and Bi-MOS drive stage is 3-parallel configuration.The power transformer is equipped with a LASER transformer originally developed by Onkyo.The new EI core and the perfect shielding material reduce the magnetic leakage flux radiated to the surroundings by approximately 1 / 30.The power supply section has been strengthened, and a bridge diode with a maximum current capacity 2.5 times that of the conventional one has been adopted as the rectifier diode to enable stable power supply.In addition, the secondary winding of the power transformer is separated and independent for the power amplifier and protector circuit, and sub-transformers are mounted for the microcomputer and display. By supplying power to each stage independently, interference between each stage is eliminated.It has a 2-box structure with the power supply and other stages separated, and a 2-division bottom chassis structure. In addition, the power stage and the small signal section are divided into blocks by a heat sink to prevent interference with the small signal section.This reduces the influence on small signals caused by large currents handled by the power supply and power stage.It comes with a remote control that can operate the power supply, volume, input selector and muting from your hand.Since the volume and input rector uses a mechanical system driven by a motor, there is no non-linear distortion like semiconductor switches.In addition to the titanium gold model, there was also a black model.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-917R
sections.overview: Unit 3 of the A-917 series, which is the 90's version of the A-817 series.New technologies such as the newly developed constant current bias amplifier and the flat damping technology developed in the QUEST series are introduced to further improve sound quality.In order to achieve high precision amplification, a constant current bias amplifier is used.In order to improve the accuracy of the differential amplifier, this circuit uses an ultra-high-precision constant-current circuit as the bias circuit used as the operation reference, and has succeeded in increasing the power supply voltage fluctuation suppression ratio (SVRR).This constant current circuit consists of a circuit configuration in which the operation reference of a high-precision feedback constant current circuit is stabilized by another constant current circuit. Moreover, this constant current circuit is also used for the bias circuit of the first stage cascode and the second stage cascode, and for the second stage constant current load, thereby realizing highly stable voltage amplification.In addition, the power supply for the voltage amplifier is equipped with a low-impedance filter circuit independently on the left and right sides, which greatly reduces power supply voltage fluctuations caused by power supply ripple and load current at large output, and interference caused by power supply fluctuations on the left and right sides.The flat sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-919
sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier that integrates the design know-how of the Integra series and thoroughly pursues sound quality.The power amplifier section uses a super-current amplifier configuration unique to Onkyo.This amplifier uses a Bi-MOS drive system that performs voltage-current conversion before the output stage. The current drive amplifier achieves stable and linear amplification by current-current amplification.The current drive amplifier is not affected by the voltage-to-current conversion characteristics of the transistor unlike the conventional output stage. It is composed of a current amplifier that supplies the output current to the speaker in proportion to the current sent from the previous stage. It has excellent linearity and does not vary with temperature.The Bi-MOS drive system adopted in the previous stage is a circuit using two elements, a MOS FET and a bipolar transistor. In the low-current region, the MOS FET exhibits a gentle rise curve, and in the high-current region, the stretchy and linear characteristics of the bipolar transistor are dominant. As a result, characteristics close to a straight line are obtained in the crossover region, and linearity characteristics with elongation are realized even in the large-amplitude region.In addition, this power amplifier section has push-pull specifications for all stages with perfect symmetry of + side / - side. The current drive amplifier stage of the final stage following the differential amplifier stage of the first stage, pre-driver and Bi-MOS drive stage is 3-parallel configuration.A twin monaural configuration is adopted in which the left and right are independent. The small signal block is placed in the center, and the power section / power supply section for handling large current is placed on the left and right.This reduces interference caused by electromagnetic waves from large currents and shortens the signal transmission distance.The power supply section is equipped with two LASER transformers, one on each of the left and right sides, reducing the magnetic leakage flux radiated to the surrounding area to approximately 1 / 30 of that of conventional transformers.In addition, the secondary winding of the power transformer is made independent for the power amplifier, EQ amplifier and protector circuit, and a sub-transformer is installed for the microcomputer to eliminate interference between each stage.The chassis structure is a 3 box structure, and the power supply and power section for handling large current are housed on the left and right sides, and the input equalizer amplifier and preamplifier for handling small signals are housed in the central box to eliminate mutual interference.The bottom chassis is also divided into 3 parts to reduce interference caused by chassis current.In order to shorten the signal transmission distance and simplify the transmission, the selector switch of the motor drive is located near the input pin jack, and the volume is also located near the selector with an independent 4-chain type of the shaft drive to connect the signal transmission distance as short as possible.The adoption of high-quality, low-impedance twin-roll Chemicon, high-speed diodes, and 70 ? m copper foil printed circuit board realizes low impedance circuits.Onkyo's proprietary technologies such as Delta Turbo Power Supply and Pre / Power Section Independent Super Servo Amplifier are used.It is equipped with functions such as source direct switch, direct tone circuit, tape monitor function, MC2 position cartridge selector, charge noise filter, etc.It comes with a remote control that allows you to control the power supply, volume, input selector and muting at your hand.The volume and input selector use a motor drive system to prevent non-linear distortion caused by semiconductor switches.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-927LTD
sections.overview:
* Limited to 300 units per month  125,000 (released in 1997)

An improved pre-main amplifier based on the Integra A-927.It is designed freely as an amplifier that the development team wants to use by themselves, and it is realized by small production of 300 units per month.While a general transistor amplifier uses a Darlington circuit in which emitter followers are connected in multiple stages to the power amplifier, the A-927LTD uses an inverted Darlington circuit in which collector followers are connected to the final stage.Since the inverted Darlington is a collector follower, nonlinear distortion between the base and emitter of the power transistor does not enter the signal circuit, so nonlinear distortion can be reduced.In addition to the conventional ground theory, the ground potential is closed loop for each stage from the signal inlet to the signal outlet, so that the potential does not change even if current flows through the load.This eliminates interference caused by the ground loop, which previously caused masking of music information, and improves S/N and other functions.In order to realize a non-feedback amplifier, NFB (negative feedback) is eliminated from the power amplification stage of the power amplifier, and the low distortion factor is realized by reviewing the circuit.In addition, by reviewing the temperature compensation circuit, excellent thermal stability has been obtained, and the need for a small resistor inserted in series on the output side of the normal amplifier is eliminated, and the output impedance of the power amplifier has been reduced.Equipped with a mid-bus presence that controls the feeling of congestion caused by the characteristics of the listening room.This boosts and cuts the middle and low frequency range around 200 to 300 Hz, which is impossible with the conventional tone correction, and removes the uncomfortable feeling of congestion.In addition, when the bus control is boosted, a booth is set to the middle range at the same time, which is also effective when it becomes difficult to listen.In addition to the Source Direct Position, which bypasses the tone circuit, the Power Amp Direct Position, which can be directly input to the Power Amp from the dedicated input terminal via only the volume, is installed.A 4-row high-grade detent volume is used so that dedicated circuits can be configured for each tone position and direct position.In addition, assuming actual operating conditions, the rise of the attenuation curve is made gradual and the input sensitivity is revised to obtain the lowest operational feeling.The power cable adopts the inlet method (power input connector) in accordance with IEC standard, and is 2 mm.2OFC (oxygen-free copper) cabtire cable is attached.This allows the cable to be replaced and upgraded.The internal structure is designed to minimize the signal path from input to output and to construct a rational power supply line. The circuit block layout is optimized as an amplifier.Each block has a strong box-shaped structure and is connected to each other to increase the strength of the chassis as a whole. In addition, vibration analysis is focused on, and irregular ribs are provided everywhere to ensure strength and dispersion of resonance.The power supply section is equipped with a double-core laser transformer, which is a further evolution of the previously used laser transformer.This transformer has succeeded in reducing magnetic leakage to the limit by combining two coil cores that are continuous in the rolling direction with less magnetic resistance. Also, by cutting off part of the core, the coil shape can be made cylindrical, and even very thick copper wire can be wound without difficulty, thus greatly improving current supply capability.The electrolytic capacitor is equipped with a blue capacitor, a custom part with strength and delicacy. The copper foil on the printed circuit board, which constitutes the main circuit, is 70 ? thick, twice the usual thickness, ensuring high quality.In addition, WIMA film wimA and high-precision carbon resistors are used in all major areas related to sound quality to improve sound quality.The use of a switch-type attenuator to control the balance prevents degradation of sound quality and ensures reliability.It is also equipped with a MM/MC switching phono equalizer.As an A-927LTD special specification, it uses a knurled volume and selector knob with which you can enjoy high-class feeling and operation feeling to reduce external vibration.The speaker terminal is also gold-plated.

sections.overview:
59,800 (1 unit, released in September 1987)

A speaker system based on the D-77X with further increased rigidity and no resonance.A 31 cm cone type woofer with pure cross carbon diaphragm is mounted in the low range.This diaphragm achieves high purity and high rigidity by using carbon fiber as a cone without mixing with other materials with inferior characteristics. In addition, the diaphragm is constructed with two layers of carbon sheets. They are overlapped with each other at an angle of 45   to increase the strength in all directions. In addition, the diaphragm is molded into a special shape curved cone to eliminate resonance while maintaining the rigidity of the diaphragm.In addition, the magnetic circuit uses a magnet of size   140x   75x17tmm, magnetic flux density 11,700 gauss and total magnetic flux 155,000 maxwell, and the edge uses engineering elastomer with less characteristic change due to temperature and humidity.In addition, an acoustic stabilizer, a heavyweight weight, is mounted on the underplate of the woofer to reduce unnecessary vibration.A 12 cm cone type skoker made of pure cross carbon is mounted in the middle area.The diaphragm has a 12 cm of 12 cm, it uses a two layer structure of carbon fiber sheet, which is thinner and lighter than woofer. In addition, a newly developed special polymer compound is introduced into the binding material for cone molding to further reduce weight. In addition, a unique vibration reduction technology has been introduced. Focusing on dispersing and eliminating high-frequency resonance peaks by changing the half apex angle of the cone (the depth of the cone), it uses a structure with two angles of 25   and 55  .The edge uses engineering elastomer as well as woofer.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter using plasma carbonite titanium is installed in the high range.Plasma Carbonite Titanium is a titanium base material that has undergone surface hardening treatment using the plasma method. It forms a high-hardness ceramicized titanium and a carbonite layer, resulting in hardness 5.6 times higher than that of pure titanium. Unlike the conventional process of coating the surface of titanium, this plasma production method hardens the base material itself so that there is no boundary (interface) between the hardened layer and pure titanium, so durability and reliability are enhanced.In addition, in order to eliminate resonance of the diaphragm, a reinforcement structure is added to the outer periphery of the diaphragm to obtain a strong resonance elimination effect. This flattens the high-frequency resonance peak at 30k to 50 kHz outside the audible band, suppresses adverse effects on the audible band, and improves the transient response characteristics in the audible band.There is no level control attenuator in order to make the network circuit direct and eliminate the elements of time variation.For the network parts, a choke coil containing silicon steel plate with high saturation level is adopted. sections.title: ONKYO GRANDSCEPTERGS-1
sections.overview:
1,000,000 (1 unit, sold in July 1984)  1,200,000 (1 unit, around 1990 s)

A speaker system designed based on a completely new theory of design and measurement aiming at the ultimate speaker.The Grand-Ceptor is an all-horn configuration.In principle, horn type speakers have good transient characteristics, but they also have disadvantages such as many time-domain distortions (multipath ghost distortion, reverb distortion, etc.). Theoretical analysis of on-kiyo has revealed that horn type speakers have very low high-order harmonic distortion compared with other systems in principle. Research and development has been carried out over a long period of time in order to realize an ideal speaker system by complete control of horn type speakers.Although multi-pass ghost distortion and reverb distortion have been used to create sound because they are not necessarily objectionable, the Grandceptor eliminates these distortions for proper representation of the music.ConfigurationThe GS-1 is a sound insulator and is divided into a low-sound reproduction block and a medium-sound reproduction block.The bass block is divided into a low-frequency horn and a low-frequency compression driver unit with a back cavity, and the two low-frequency units are housed in separate back cavities of 40 liters each.The middle and high sound block has a tilt adjustment circuit to adjust the sound axis.WooferTwo 28 cm cone type woofer W3060A are installed in the low range.These units use a 10 cm diameter voice coil for a 23 mm effective diameter cone, and the magnetic circuit uses a 220 mm diameter magnet, the largest available at the time, to drive a 10 cm voice coil.By combining a relatively small-diameter diaphragm with a large-diameter voice coil, the path of the sound wave inside the diaphragm is shortened and the transient is improved. In addition, it is strongly driven by a large magnet, and the movement of the cone is completely controlled by applying a horn load to the entire band of the woofer.FRP laminated horn is used for the horn part.The horn is sandwiched between FRP and anti-vibration materials. The back side of the phase plug is molded to match the shape of the driver's center cap and is covered with felt. The hyperbolic function is used for the change in the area of the horn, and the superelliptic function is used for the change in the shape. Both equations are solved by a computer, and the original model is obtained by using an NC lathe.TweeterA horn type tweeter is installed in the middle and high area.The diaphragm is a 65 mm diameter diaphragm made of titanium nitride that is integrally molded up to the voice coil bobbin, and the phase plug is ultra-precisely shaped by the lost wax method to obtain good high-frequency characteristics.???? FRP laminated horn is used for the horn. By stacking FRP and vibration isolation materials used for vibration isolation of iron bridges, multipath ghost distortion and reverb reverberation distortion are eliminated.NetworkThe network circuit is a 2-way configuration and the network is a 12dB/oct. reverse connection configuration to eliminate the time delay caused by the circuit.The network parts are installed in a distributed manner to reduce mutual interference.EnclosureThe unit layout is based on the Constant Time Unit Array method to eliminate time lag due to the positional relationship between the woofer and the tweeter.A unique layered structure is used to reduce the reverb distortion that occurs in the enclosure.In general enclosures, reinforcement is used to suppress resonance. However, reinforcement only changes the frequency of resonance and does not absorb energy, so it can be adjusted but cannot be eliminated.The Grand-Ceptor has a 7-layer structure consisting of six layers of Lauan and Yonematsu veneer, and is restrained by newly developed damping materials and steel plates to minimize vibration by orders of magnitude.A glass plate is embedded in the top plate of the middle and high area regeneration block.OtherBy changing the connection of the terminal board on the back, you can use a special external equalizer or bi-amp drive without a divider.

A radial horn used in an experiment to verify multipath ghost distortion.By removing the separator and support, and smoothing the part where the shape of the slow part suddenly changes, multi-pass ghost distortion is eliminated and the high range is smoothed.

Multi-Path Ghost The horn used in the experiment to fabricate a distortion-free horn is designed to ensure smooth changes in cross-sectional area and shape, and sidewall slope.Although the shape of the slope is circular, it is smoothly changed to a super ellipse in the middle part and a rectangle in the opening part. Hundreds of prototypes have been built on computers together with formulas to calculate directivity and low-range reflections to determine the shape of the horn.

A horn carved out of white marble.It is made using an NC lathe, and it was made when looking for a material which is hard to cause reverb reverberation distortion (distortion phenomenon caused by the reverberation of sound being subtracted).In addition, various metals such as aluminum die-cast and steel, various molding materials such as lauan and cherry, various stone materials such as Mikage stone and marbles, and molding materials such as gypsum and concrete are used. The horn is actually made and measured, and studies are being carried out.

A horn made of polymer composite materials such as resin concrete (center photo).Reverb It was created during repeated experiments to find a material that is less prone to reverberation distortion, and a structure with composite ribs on the back side of the horn to increase strength is being considered.

???? FRP laminated horn.FRP and dump materials used for steel bridges, etc., and prototypes with laminated steel plates for high-speed materials.

A group of prototype horns created in search of the best combination of materials that do not cause reverberation distortion.Examination of polymer materials, improvement of characteristics of dump material, and change of lamination method of FRP and dump material were carried out.

Early prototype bass horn.This horn is designed to achieve a low tone with good response, a low tone without delay, and a low tone with good braking.

Medium-term prototype bass horn.At this point it is still a wooden parabolic horn, and it was decided to use a phase plug at this point.

Prototype low tone horn in the final stage.An FRP laminated horn is used to obtain an ideal horn curve and to eliminate the reverberation distortion.

The last stage of the barrack set.At this stage, audiophiles, audio critics, musicians, acousticians, and studio engineers gave a trial listening and it received a high evaluation.

Grandceptor development office.Audio systems, computers, records, measuring instruments, and machine tools are installed.

As a result of adopting a polyimide bobbin with excellent heat resistance, an allowable input increase of 25% has been achieved compared with conventional products.In addition, strong aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame.A 10 cm cone type skoker using the same mixed cone as M90 is used for the middle area.The diaphragm has a lightweight mass of 0.37g and high rigidity, enabling wide-band reproduction.In addition, by installing a 0.54L back chamber, the reproduction capability in the low range is improved.A 3 cm direct drive type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit directly drives a special diaphragm formed by etching an annular voice coil pattern on a film consisting of 12.5 ? m polyimide foil and 20 ? m aluminum foil.Since the diaphragm has a lightweight mass of 26 mg and the high rigidity of the material is utilized, the playback upper limit frequency is extended to 70 kHz, and high input resistance is also realized.In addition, uniform directional characteristics are secured in all directions by the shape of the annular diaphragm itself and the adoption of precision processing equalizer.The network is designed with an emphasis on connections between units, and the optimal network constants and unit configurations are determined by utilizing computer simulations and repeated audibility tests.Level control is installed in the high and middle range.In the enclosure, the shape of the bass reflex port is designed to improve low-frequency characteristics, and the acoustic resistance is controlled by installing a damping material on the front surface.

Strong magnetic circuit with sufficient consideration for heat radiation effect and synergy of large diameter 65   voice coil with heat-resistant treatment suppresses temperature rise to 1/2 compared to conventional one, forming a drive part that can withstand high power at continuous large input.The cabinet is equipped with a large for a wide range.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.Magnetic fluid is injected into the gap of the tweeter, and it is a powerful magnetic circuit adopting the optimum structure of flux concentration. sections.overview:
90,000 (1 unit, released in November 1984)

Compact 2-way speaker system with materials and technology in a compact size.A 23 cm diameter unit with a high-rigidity pure cross carbon 2-layer structure is used for the low frequency band.In addition, a large magnet of   160x   85x20tmm, which is almost the same as the effective vibration diameter, and a large voice coil of   76 mm are adopted, and driving force and braking force areA 2.5 cm hard dome unit with a special alloy diaphragm is used for the high frequency range.Two parts around the diaphragm are cut by laser processing to effectively disperse the resonance and flatten the high-frequency resonance peak, thereby improving the transient characteristics.For the network, in addition to the centralized one point grounding method applying the design know-how of the integra amplifier and the woofer / tweeter circuit separation method, the layout of each part of the network is also analyzed strictly.In order to solve the problem of crosstalk caused by the coupling between coils, a magnetic flux distribution measuring device linked with a computer is used, and the arrangement of the network is determined to be minimized.High-quality parts with low impedance, low distortion rate and high input resistance, and extra-thick OFC (oxygen-free dynamic) wiring materials are used for the parts.The enclosure is made of resin concrete with high rigidity and high density, and adopts a large and smooth round baffle with R determined by comparison with an infinite baffle.This resin-concrete front baffle is mounted on top of a particle-board cabinet.

sections.title: ONKYO MONITOR500X
sections.overview:
98,000 (1 unit, released in 1988)  89,900 (1 unit, around 1991)

This is a speaker system developed in pursuit of high quality by putting all of the high rigidity / no resonance technology that Onkyo had obtained until then into a compact 2-way.A 23 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm is based on a two layer structure of pure cross carbon, which achieves both high rigidity and light weight through the development of fine carbon fibers. It is equipped with a non-resonance structure in which the half-apex angle is changed at the inner circumference of the cone. In addition, damping characteristics are improved by using a special polymer compound that ensures large internal loss in the binding material.In addition, the edge material is made of engineering elastomer with excellent linearity, and by making it highly compliant, the reproduction limit in the low range is expanded downward.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is equipped with plasma carbonite titanium in pursuit of high rigidity, unifying the whole band with the same carbon material as the low band. Plaza Uma Carbonite titanium is a titanium base material that undergoes surface hardening treatment by the plasma method. It forms a three layer structure of high-hardness ceramicized titanium and carbonite part, and it obtains 6 times the hardness of pure titanium. Unlike the coating method, this plasma method cures the titanium base material itself, so there is almost no increase in the thickness or weight of the diaphragm. In addition, by installing a rib structure to improve the strength on the outer periphery of the diaphragm, the high-frequency resonance peak at 30 to 50 kHz outside the audible band is flattened, and the transient response within the audible band is improved.In addition, the tweeter unit is vibrationally isolated from CFCs and baffles by using aluminum die-cast spacers and acoustic absorbers.Both the woofer and tweeter are designed to prevent leakage of magnetic field lines by using a canceling magnet.The network division not only separates the woofer circuit and the tweeter circuit, but also determines the network layout with the least crosstalk by making full use of magnetic flux distribution measuring equipment linked with a computer. In addition, the sense of sound field is improved by the concentrated one point grounding by incorporating the idea of strengthening the earth line obtained from the experience of amplifier circuit design.The parts used are coils containing silicon steel plates with high saturation levels, capacitors for audio equipment, and OFC wiring materials.The enclosure structure consists of a high-density, rigid particle-board cabinet with a resin concrete front baffle attached.The resin concrete material has a high specific gravity and excellent strength, so that unwanted vibration from the unit caused by the reaction of the diaphragm operation can be suppressed to a low level, and the sound pressure radiation of the front baffle with a time delay harmful to audibility is reduced. In addition to the material advantage of high rigidity, the resin concrete can be processed to a precise shape of micron order, and a 4-sided round baffle composed of a combination of especially smooth curves is molded and adopted.We have also introduced an insulated mounting system, a technology for eliminating resonance in the enclosure. The woofer unit is attached to a resin concrete front baffle, and the tweeter unit is screwed together with an aluminum die-cast spacer and an acoustic absorber (restraining damping material) to a particle-board sub-baffle inside the baffle, increasing the independence of vibration of the two speaker units.There was a speaker stand exclusively for the Monitor500X sold separately.Uses hard material and 1-leg structure that does not generate standing waves. In addition, it is equipped with 4 metal points on the side so that the height can be finely adjusted.

sections.title: ONKYO MONITOR2000
sections.overview: This monitor series speaker system is compatible with various music sources by using pure cross carbon and magnesium alloy diaphragm.WooferA 34 cm cone type woofer using a pure cross carbon diaphragm is mounted in the low range.The pure cross carbon diaphragm has a structure in which three layers of carbon plain-woven fabric are stacked with angles shifted by 30  , and the dust cap has a structure in which two layers of carbon are stacked with angles shifted by 45  . This structure demonstrates the rigidity unique to carbon in all directions and realizes a diaphragm utilizing the material.Carbon fiber has a unique sound due to its low internal loss. However, we have succeeded in increasing internal loss without lowering rigidity by using newly developed epoxy resin for binding material used in cone molding.In Monitor2000, pure cross carbon was molded into a cone for the first time, and the rigidity (Young's modulus) is 12.7 times that of paper cone.The magnetic circuit uses a large magnet with dimensions of   200x   95x25t and a magnetic flux density of 14,150 gauss. This magnet is equivalent to a 38 cm class unit, and the unit weight reaches 9 kg.midrangeThe middle area is equipped with a 10 cm compound skoker using a compound structure of   6.5 cm dome type and 10 cm cone type.Magnesium alloy diaphragm is used for the diaphragm.Magnesium has a large internal loss and the lowest density among practical metals (0.38 times that of titanium and 0.64 times that of aluminum). This material is molded to a thickness of 100 ? m by Skoker to ensure structural rigidity. In addition, the coating is finished uniformly to a thickness of 6 ? m by a newly developed resin vacuum deposition method to realize the straightforward sound of magnesium.The superior internal loss of the Skoker suppresses unwanted resonance, so there is no need to attach a damping material to the back of the dome, and there is no excessive suppression of sound.A newly designed equalizer is installed on the front of the diaphragm to improve directivity.  140x   75x17t, magnetic flux density 12,000 gauss magnet and 65 mm diameter voice coil are used for the magnetic circuit.TweeterA 2.5 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.In this unit, a magnesium alloy diaphragm is used as the diaphragm in the same way as the SCOKER. The diaphragm is 40 ? thick according to the characteristics of the unit, and a newly designed equalizer is installed on the front to improve the directivity.Magnet of   90x   45x15t, magnetic flux density 18,250 gauss is used for the magnetic circuit.NetworkThe network section uses a centralized single-point grounding system that applies the know-how of amplifier circuit technology. In this system, the grounding of each wire is concentrated at one point, eliminating interference between units and networks, and improving the sense of orientation.In addition, high-quality materials with low impedance, low distortion rate and high input resistance are used, and sound quality is improved by sufficient audibility.CabinetIn the Monitor2000, the bass port is located on the rear of the system to eliminate interference from the port.The cabinet design focuses on plate thickness and reinforcement, using 25 mm particleboards for baffle plates, top plate, bottom plate and side plates, 28 mm high rigidity, high internal loss Apiton plywood for the back plate, and sufficient reinforcement for a total system weight of 40 kg.The front baffle has a symmetrical unit layout to improve sound localization.In the Monitor2000, smoothing is attempted to solve the effect of reflection and diffraction of sound waves on the baffle surface. The protrusion of the level controller is also pushed in to make it flat except for adjustment. In addition, there is no thick emblem on the baffle surface and thorough measures are taken such as writing the model number by etching.In addition, by creating a clearance between the baffle surface and the secondary RUNNET, the effect of reflection by the secondary RUNNET frame is suppressed.

sections.overview: A speaker system developed for export to Europe, mainly Germany.The system planning and sound quality coordination were done by Onkyo Germany (Onkyo Deutschland GmbH Electronics) staff, and the basic design and manufacturing were done by Onkyo technical staff.A 21 cm cone type unit is used for the low range, and a 16 cm cone type unit is used for the middle range.The material of the cone type vibration plate is made from Finnish pulp made from Northern European conifer as the main raw material, and is tuned with an emphasis on the reproducibility of acoustic instruments.A 2.5 cm soft dome type tweeter is used for the high range.The vibration plate is made of chemical fiber and has a flat characteristic with few peaks and dips that cause stimulating sound quality.The enclosure uses high-density particleboard and is assembled with a unique joint structure using real-wood angle block on the left and right sides of the top plate.In addition, in order to maintain visual harmony with other furnitures, etc., a wood grain nut board is used, and in addition, the level difference at the boundary between sub RUNNET and baffle is completely removed for a smooth finish.Designed as a tall boy type floor standing type, it can be set directly on the flat floor at the upper part.

sections.title: ONKYO SCEPTER200
sections.overview: A sound field type speaker system with a rear radiator to compensate for the indirect sound component of the band that is insufficient for ordinary speakers.In a normal 3-way system, the sound energy imbalance caused by the directional characteristics of the unit causes the sound pressure frequency characteristics on the axis to be flat, but the energy response shows a pattern of large undulations around the crossover frequency, and decreases as the frequency goes higher.To compensate for this unevenness in acoustic energy and to keep the ratio of direct and indirect sound constant over the whole fractional band, rear radiators are installed on the top and back of the enclosure. This rear radiator consists of three ways to compensate for the high range energy of each front unit.A 38 cm cone type woofer using Delta Olefin Refined Corn is installed in the low range.Delta Olefin Refined Corn is an improved version of conventional Delta Olefin. While maintaining the ideal internal loss, which is the greatest feature of Delta Olefin, the rigidity is enhanced by increasing Young's modulus by four times by controlling the added compound.In addition, a large magnet of 160   x85   x20tmm and a 4-layer long voice coil of 76 mm diameter are used for the magnetic circuit, and a butterfly damper made of glass-reinforced polyimide resin with excellent linearity is used for the damper.The middle section is equipped with a composite unit combining magnesium alloy and 10 cm cone.The diaphragm part uses a composite diaphragm composed of a magnesium alloy diaphragm of 65   mm and 100 ? m thick and a 10 cm cone for both weight reduction and high rigidity. The composite diaphragm structure also stabilizes the suspension system such as weight reduction of the diaphragm and two point support.The magnetic circuit uses a strong magnet of 140   x75   x1tmm, magnetic flux density 12,000 gauss, total magnetic flux 127,000 maxwell, and the voice coil uses a 65   mm voice coil.The edge has a special double support structure that supports the magnesium alloy diaphragm and cone, respectively.This mid-range unit has a back cavity with a capacity of 0.7l and a minimum resonance frequency of 240 Hz.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm uses a newly developed plastic vapor deposition method and a newly developed 40 ? m magnesium alloy diaphragm with a uniform coating as thin as 6 ? m. In addition, the foam rubber for braking, which had been strapping inside the dome part in order to suppress high-frequency resonance in the past, is removed, and efficiency is improved by 4-5 dB and wide-band characteristics up to 45 kHz are obtained.In addition to the use of a strong magnet, the magnetic circuit has a shape that makes it easy for the plate magnetic flux to concentrate. In addition, a magnetic fluid is injected into the gap, so that all the magnetic flux is concentrated in the voice coil.Furthermore, by adopting an equalizer based on computer analysis, we have improved the energy and directional characteristics between 10 kHz and 15 kHz.The Low-Mid radiator, which compensates for sound energy in the high-frequency range of the woofer, employs a 10 cm cone unit of a delta olefin diaphragm.The Mid-High radiator uses two 7 cm cone units and is fixed to a frame at an angle of 30   to the baffle surface.The Super High radiator uses a ring-shaped diaphragm driven by a 35 mm diameter voice coil in combination with a conical horn with a three dimensional rotation angle of 90  .

sections.title: ONKYO SCEPTER300
sections.overview: A sound field type speaker system with a 3-way rear radiator system for indirect sound generation on the back to enhance the rich atmosphere and sense of presence unique to the live Symphony Hall.In addition to the normal 3-way system, the Scepter300 adds a rear radiator for reflected sound only for the band where energy is insufficient. By increasing the sound radiated backward, energy characteristics are made uniform.In addition, in order to realize the three points of Onkyo's design policy of expanding the dynamic range, expanding the playback range, and expanding the listening area, we are working to improve the quality of the system by introducing new technologies from both software and hardware aspects, such as the development of a magnesium alloy diaphragm and the development of a listening area measuring method and an energy response measuring method as design methods.A 38 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.In order to cope with the expansion of the dynamic range and to prevent bell vibration at high power, the rotary sheet-making cone with increased rigidity in the circumferential direction of cone paper is adopted. In addition, the heat radiation effect and heat resistance characteristics are improved by adding a reinforcing die-cast cap considering the heat radiation effect. The rigidity in the circumferential direction is increased approximately twice by the rotary sheet-making cone. In addition, the characteristics are improved by impregnating special resin into the cone paper, and at the same time, the rigidity and airtightness of the cone paper are increased.The magnetic circuit uses a strong magnet with a magnet size of 180   x95   x20tmm, a magnetic flux density of 11,500 gauss and a total magnetic flux of 258,000 maxwell, and a long voice coil with an aperture of 76 mm.In addition, a double damper made of polyimide fiber material, which does not change with time, is used for large input.The mid-range is equipped with a composite squaker that combines a magnesium alloy diaphragm with a 10 cm cone.With this composite diaphragm, we have achieved two and a half times the thickness and nearly seven times the strength of the conventional diaphragm, as well as a reduction in weight.The magnetic circuit uses a magnet with dimensions of 140   x75   x17tmm, total flux density of 12,000 gauss and total flux density of 127,000 maxwell, and a voice coil with a large diameter of 65   mm. In addition, the edge section uses a double support structure that supports a magnesium-alloy diaphragm and carbon cone respectively, ensuring stable operation even when Dainyu is in use.In addition, a back cavity with a volume of 0.7L and a minimum resonance frequency of 240 Hz is installed in the squaker.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter with a magnesium alloy diaphragm is mounted in the high range.In this diaphragm, the foam rubber for braking, which had been used as a strapping in the inner surface of the dome part in order to suppress high-frequency resonance in the past, is removed, and dramatic improvement in efficiency of 4 to 5 dB and wide-band characteristics are realized.In addition, we are working to improve the energy characteristics of the tweeter region, which is on a decreasing trend compared with the woofer band and other regions. We are working to improve this by developing and adding new equalizers.In addition, magnetic fluid is injected into the gap of the magnetic circuit in the same way as before to suppress temperature rise of the voice coil, improve input resistance characteristics, and reduce harmonic distortion. In addition, the plate is shaped so that magnetic flux is easily concentrated, and all magnetic flux is concentrated in the voice coil.The rear radiator is a 3-way structure to compensate for the high-frequency RUNNET of each front unit. It is cut at 45   to the top and rear of the enclosure so that it does not directly affect the characteristics of the front speakers. In addition, for low-mid radiators, a diffuse plate, which also serves as a reflection plate, is installed in the secondary radiator frame to prevent wraparound.For the Low-Mid, a 10 cm cone unit with a delta-olefin diaphragm is used as a radiator to compensate for sound energy in the high range of the woofer. The sound energy is expanded over a wide range by an diffuser incorporated in a sub RUNNET frame.Four 7 cm cone type speakers are used for Mid-High. They are mounted on a frame with an angle of 30   to the baffle surface. Two of them are directed upward to the rear surface and the other two are directed upward to the left and right for uniform rear radiation.For Super High, we use a unit that combines a ring-shaped diaphragm driven by a 35 mm diameter voice coil with a conical horn with a three dimensional rotation angle of 90  .Equipped with a bi-amplifier drive terminal, only the rear radiator can be disconnected and connected separately.It can be used when you want to increase the energy of the indirect sound component or when you want to change the frequency characteristics of the indirect sound component with a graphic equalizer according to the acoustic characteristics of the room.Equipped with independent level control for the Skoka Tweeter and each rear radiator.

sections.title: ONKYO SCEPTER3001
sections.overview: This is a floor-type speaker system that uses a super labyrinth bath system in pursuit of the ideal speaker system such as creating a natural sound field without making you feel the existence of the speaker, and reproducing natural sound without peculiarity.As a super woofer, 25 cm reinforced delta olefin cone type woofer unit is adopted.The super labyrinth bus system of this unit realizes low-frequency reproduction at 40 hz.The low-frequency band uses a 20 cm pure cross carbon woofer based on the MID4 concept of covering 80 Hz to 1.5 kHz, the fundamental band of human voice, with a single unit.In addition, the ADM frame with high damping capacity is adopted.A 5 cm dome type skoker with an ultra-lightweight aluminum (Al-Mg) diaphragm is used for the middle area.We have succeeded in developing an aluminum diaphragm by realizing the integrated molding of an aluminum voice coil, which had been difficult in the past, with our original press machine.In addition, the high frequency resonance is dispersed by an oval diaphragm whose central part is elliptical and becomes circular toward the outer peripheral part, and the damping material 0 is realized.An oval-shaped 2.5 cm dome type tweeter using an ultra-lightweight aluminum diaphragm integrated with a voice coil is adopted for the high band as well as for the middle band.Because the wavelength of the tweeter is short, it is severely affected by the reflection of the baffle plate. In order to suppress this, the enclosure is made as slim as possible, and the tweeter is spherical as close as possible to the baffle and mounted on the upper part of the cabinet.

sections.title: ONKYO SCEPTER5001
sections.overview:
400,000 (1 unit, released in October 1986)

In this speaker system, the mounting method of the unit has been reconsidered from the starting point to achieve high rigidity and no resonance.The woofer and tweeter are rigidly fixed while being vibrationally independent from the front baffle, and the vibration transmission path between each unit is cut off. This reduces the vibration of the front baffle, which has been the cause of blurred sound images, to less than 1/10 of that of a typical cabinet.A 35 cm cone type woofer with pure cross carbon diaphragm is mounted in the low range.Compared to general pure cross carbon, by weaving finer fibers at a higher density, a lightweight cone is realized while maintaining its rigidity.In addition, for the first time as a woofer unit, a resonance canceling structure is adopted for the diaphragm, and flat sound pressure characteristics and excellent transient characteristics are obtained.Furthermore, it is equipped with a large magnet of   220x   110x25tmm and a large voice coil of   100 mm to drive the diaphragm with high fidelity.The mid-range is equipped with a newly developed diamond-bonded film diaphragm made by our original manufacturing method and an 8 cm dome type squaker that combines resonance resolution technology.The diaphragm of this unit is a diamond-bonded film diaphragm formed with ultra-hard diamond on the diaphragm surface by further developing the plasma nitriding method, in which the base material of titanium itself is made into ceramic to increase the rigidity, and excellent hardness is obtained.In addition, the adoption of a diaphragm structure that eliminates resonance by laser processing thoroughly suppresses distortion in the time domain.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter with a diamond-bonded film diaphragm is installed in the high range as well as in the middle range.In addition, a diaphragm structure that eliminates high-frequency resonance peaks is employed to improve high-speed response and transient.High-quality parts selected through repeated trial listening are used in the network section, and a zircon sand filled network box is introduced to eliminate the slight influence of vibration of parts.Most of the network components that do not interfere with each other even if they are close to each other are contained in a dedicated network box, which is filled with high-density zircon sand. This eliminates microvibration of network components and eliminates distortion caused by unwanted resonance of network components.The choke coil is three dimensionally arranged outside the network box to minimize mutual interference.Furthermore, in order to maintain the purity of the network, no printed circuit board or solder is used, and each element wiring is directly connected with crimp terminals.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAT-405
sections.overview: An FM/AM tuner equipped with servo lock and pursuing the concept of TQ = total quality.Servo lock using high gain operational amplifier IC is adopted for the lock mechanism.This realizes excellent locking accuracy within   5 khz of the best sound quality point, and quick and accurate channel selection by instantaneously locking to the optimum tuning point.In the front-end section, a dual-gate MOS FET known for its low noise figure and wide dynamic range is inserted into the RF stage, and a frequency linear type four variable capacitor is adopted.The IF section uses a wide-band linear phase filter strictly selected by the differential gain direct-viewing method, and the IF amplifier uses a differential IC to obtain a sufficient limiter effect.In addition, the detector has also obtained wide-band linear characteristics by the differential gain direct-viewing method.The MPX section is equipped with a high-stability AF amplifier, a new-type PLL and an IC to obtain an excellent stereo signal.In addition, in order to suppress the generation of slight distortion, we have added a strengthening filter to the stable PLL / IC to ensure the low distortion factor of the MPX system as a whole.In addition to the IF section and low-distortion MPX section of the wide-band linear phase filter, we have adopted an AF amplifier with a large dynamic margin to take thorough measures against overmodulation.Equipped with 50% modulation 440 Hz continuous sound air check calibrator, low distortion rate recording is possible by setting an appropriate recording level.By detecting the signal to the signal meter from three differential type limiters and using an IC that does not saturate even at a strong input, linear response characteristics up to a strong input of 70 dB realized.The AM tuner section uses a highly sensitive double varicon and a highly selective IF triple tune filter to improve sound quality.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAT-406
sections.overview: AM/FM stereo tuner equipped with servo lockThe servo lock system of the T-406 detects the difference between the best sound quality point of the minimum distortion and fine separation of the detector and the actual passing signal. A high-gain operational amplifier IC is used to feed back to the local oscillator and fix the local frequency.At this time, the tuning frequency accuracy is within   5 khz of the sound quality best point, and low distortion rate reception is maintained, so that there is no concern that the frequency drift during reception deteriorates the music and loses the clearness of the music.When the tuning point is within   50 kHz of the tuning point, the locked indicator (red) glows to indicate that it is within the locked range. When the tuning position is released, the optimum tuning point is immediately locked and the tuning indicator (green) indicates that the tuning is complete.In the case of a re-tuning station, when the tuning part is touched, the lock mechanism is released immediately and the tuning state returns to manual tuning. As a result, the delicate complication of center tuning, which is inherent in continuous frequency tuners, is eliminated, and quick and accurate tuning is realized.Equipped with an excellent lock mechanism, it eliminates the fear of mistuning = sound quality degradation, and always enables good low-distortion recording.Equipped with a deviation meter that displays the modulation level.This is a third meter that is equipped to ensure excellent sound quality. It shows the degree of modulation of FM broadcasting. For example, music broadcasting with a wide dynamic range such as 200% modulation has an excess input of + 12 dB over 50% modulation. This meter allows you to take into account the degree of modulation of more dynamic music when setting the recording level of your tape deck.Equipped with air check and calibrator.Equipped with an air check calibrator that emits 50% modulation and 440 Hz continuous sound. By setting the appropriate recording level on the tape deck, it is useful for low distortion rate recording with wide dynamic range.With multi-path output terminal. Can be viewed directly.Equipped with a multipath output terminal that detects multipath linearly up to a strong input of 70 dB, it is useful for good antenna setting when used in combination with an oscilloscope.Even if you do not have an oscilloscope, you can connect an amplifier to the multi-path V terminal and check only the distortion component with your ears.In addition to the variable output terminal for normal amplifier connection, there is also a dedicated output terminal for recording, so that you can record directly to the deck.A dual-gate MOS-FET known for its low noise figure and wide dynamic range is put into the RF stage, and it is a front-end using a frequency linear type 4 variable capacitor.In addition to achieving both high sensitivity and excellent interference rejection performance, we have achieved results in eliminating cross-modulation interference, which was often overlooked in the past, and reception interference (intermodulation interference) caused by two adjacent high-level stations.On the other hand, the effect of temperature and humidity drift is suppressed even in the local station, and combined with the adoption of the servo lock, it demonstrates its power in maintaining the best sound quality with minimum distortion and maximum separation.The IF section, which amplifies the accurate intermediate frequency (IF) obtained by the front-end mixer, uses a wide-band linear phase filter that is strictly selected by differential gain direct-viewing method. The IF amplifier uses a high-performance differential IC to obtain a sufficient limiter effect.In addition, the differential gain direct-viewing method is used to obtain wide-band linear characteristics for the detector, which contributes to improving sound quality.The MPX section (stereo demodulation section), which separates the composite signal obtained from the detector into left and right audio signals, uses a high-stability built-in AF amplifier, new PLL and IC to obtain a stereo signal with a separation of 50 dB (1 kHz).In order to suppress the generation of distortion, a strengthening filter is added to the stable PLL / IC, and the distortion factor of the MPX system as a whole is thoroughly reduced. This has achieved significant results in improving the sound quality as a whole.As a countermeasure against overmodulation in FM broadcasting, we adopted an AF amplifier with a large dynamic margin in addition to the IF part and low-distortion MPX part of a wide-band linear phase filter, and achieved a low distortion rate of 0.15% or less at 150% modulation and 0.3% or less at 200% modulation (ST ? 400 Hz).A long scale dial with a travel length of 250 mm and a tuning knob with a large flywheel for smooth movement, etc. provide an excellent operational feeling.In addition, the AM receiver uses a highly sensitive double varicon and a highly selective IF triple tune filter to improve sound quality.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAT-415
sections.overview: FM/AM tuner using super servo amplifier and servo lock ICThe Super Servo system is used in the audio section of FM and MPX and later.In this method, the basic circuit is composed of a DC amplifier, which is controlled by the servo amplifier of the operational amplifier IC. It is also called servo operational DC amplifier.As a result, while taking advantage of the advantages of DC amplifiers, we have succeeded in eliminating the disadvantages of servo amplifiers by cutting out unnecessary ultra-low frequencies.Servo lock system using high-gain operational amplifier IC is adopted.With lock accuracy within   5 khz of the best sound quality point, the best sound quality point with minimum distortion and maximum separation is maintained severely.It is equipped with a just-chain touch sensor for quick and accurate channel selection operation.As a result, the locked indicator lights when the tuning knob is within the lock range of   100 kHz from the tuning point. When the tuning knob is released, the tuning knob is immediately locked at the optimum tuning point.In the front end section, a wide-air-gap frequency linear 4 series varicon is adopted to improve the scale accuracy. In addition, a wide dynamic range, low-noise dual-gate MOS FET is used in the RF stage and mixer stage to reduce RF intermodulation interference and cross modulation.In addition to the temperature, a local variable capacitor is used to suppress the effect of humidity drift and prevent the slight tuning deviation.A wide-band linear phase filter selected by the differential gain direct-viewing method is used for the IF section, and a differential type IC is adopted for the IF amplifier to obtain a sufficient limiter effect.In addition, the differential gain direct-viewing method is used to obtain wide-band linear characteristics for the detector, which improves sound quality.The MPX section, which separates audio signals into left and right signals, uses a highly stable PLL IC to obtain a separation signal with good separation.In addition, by adding a strengthening filter and NFB, the distortion factor is also reduced thoroughly.The AM section includes the RF stage to the audio section. The AM section is completely independent of the FM section, and uses a dedicated high-fidelity AM / IC.A 3-stage delay type AGC is built in, with 2 stages to the RF amplifier and 1 stage to the IF amplifier, to prevent beat disturbance and shock sound at tuning while maintaining a low distortion rate against strong input.Equipped with multi-path detection terminal useful for antenna installation.With Output Level ControlEquipped with two output terminals.Built-in air check and calibrator for recording.

sections.overview: An AM/FM stereo tuner equipped with a servo lock system in both the FM and AM sections.By installing servo locks in both FM and AM, tuning stability is improved.When the tuning range is reached, the locked indicator lights up and the tuning knob is locked to the optimum tuning point as soon as you release the tuning knob.This allows for quick and accurate tuning.The IF stage employs WIDE and NARROW IF bandwidth switching for both FM and AM to balance selectivity and sound quality.In reception areas with good radio wave conditions, the WIDE position allows reception with high sound quality. We are pursuing low distortion in all circuits.The AM section has a built-in 3-stage delayed type AGC that reduces distortion and beat disturbance in the strong input region. From the RF to the audio section, FM is an AM section IC assembled in a completely independent package.In combination with servo lock and selectivity switching, AM tone quality is improved.A deviation meter has been newly installed.For example, in a wide-dynamic-range broadcast with 200% modulation, the input is + 12 dB larger than that with 50% modulation. The deviation meter displays the modulation level accurately with the meter circuit of the op-amp configuration and helps you set the recording level.Automatic noise reduction is built in.Equipped with two output terminals.Built-in air check calibrator useful for recording.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAT-425
sections.overview: FM/AM stereo tuner that adopts quartz synthesizer system.This is a synthesizer tuner that electronically synthesizes local frequencies using a PLL (Phase Locked Loop) controlled by a microcomputer.The frequency is digitally determined at 100 kHz intervals, and the reference frequency of the PLL is derived from an accurate crystal oscillator. This eliminates the loss of tuning due to changes in temperature and humidity, as well as the degradation of sound quality caused by this.Built-in 12-station preset memories that store up to 6 FM/AM stations each.The memory does not disappear even if the power switch is turned off or the power cord is unplugged.You can choose between auto-scan and manual scan by changing how you press the tuning switch.In the manual mode, the frequency changes in increments of 0.1 MHz with one push of the switch. In the automatic mode, the frequency changes automatically when the switch is held down. The channel selection is completed by releasing the switch at the desired station while watching the digital frequency display and signal indicator.In the front-end section, a dual-gate MOS FET with low noise figure and wide dynamic range is adopted in the RF stage.In addition to improving high sensitivity and interference rejection performance, we have also succeeded in eliminating intermodulation interference and reception interference caused by two adjacent high-level stations.The IF section that amplifies the intermediate frequency uses a wide-band linear phase filter that is strictly selected by the differential gain direct-viewing method. The IF amplifier uses a high-performance differential IC to obtain a sufficient limiter effect.In addition, the detector also achieves wide-band linear characteristics by the differential gain direct-viewing method.The MPX section, which separates audio signals into left and right audio signals, uses a highly stable PLL IC.In addition, the distortion is thoroughly reduced by adding a strengthening filter and NFB.The AM section is equipped with an AM-only loop antenna that is resistant to external noise, and uses an AM-only IC that is completely independent of the FM section from the RF stage to the audio section.With a built-in three step delayed type AGC, two steps to the RF amplifier and one step to the IF amplifier, it maintains a low distortion factor against strong input, and prevents beat disturbance and shock sound during tuning.It is equipped with noise reduction that automatically prevents S/N degradation by changing the high-frequency blending amount of L/R according to the input level in order to respond to weak radio waves of the desired station.When the input level is high, the circuit is automatically disconnected.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAT-427
sections.overview: FM/AM tuner adopting the newly developed FM feedback system.In the FM feedback system, part of the output signal of the detector is fed back to the local transmitter through the FM servo circuit, and the local transmitter signal is modulated by the low distortion circuit built into the local transmitter. The modulated local transmitter signal is mixed with the input signal by a mixer and an IF signal is extracted.Therefore, the FM feedback method has the same effect as doubling the bandwidth of the IF circuit and allows only the part of the IF circuit with the best phase characteristics to pass through.As a result, the dynamic range of the IF circuit is expanded, and a low distortion factor can be maintained even in the wide IF signal band accompanied by large input in overmodulation.In addition, since it has the NFB effect, linearity in the IF and detection section is greatly improved, and distortion can be reduced.Other features include improved separation at the MPX by clearing the signal, enhanced effect of the servo lock system by widening the IF band, and improved tuning accuracy.Even if a slight phase shift occurs in the detector output signal, the FM servo does not work.Therefore, since it is necessary to obtain excellent phase characteristics, the IF linear phase filter and wideband ultralinear detector are strictly selected and adopted.In addition, it is equipped with 2-stage switching of IF bandwidth (low distortion rate WIDE, high selectivity NARROW), and FM feedback is operated only when WIDE.The front-end consists of a single and double tuned RF amplifier using a dual-gate MOS FET. The mixer is also a double-balanced type with a carefully selected dual-gate MOS FETx2. The output from the station is input to the mixer through an FET buffer to expand the dynamic range at strong input.Servo lock system is adopted for the lock mechanism.The MPX section, which separates the L/R audio signal, uses a highly stable AF amplifier built-in, PLL and IC.In addition, in order to suppress the generation of slight distortion here, we have added a strengthening filter to the PLL / IC to make the distortion factor as a whole MPX diameter low.The AM section is equipped with a touch sensor servo lock that emphasizes sound quality and pursues comfortable channel selection and perfect tuning.In addition, a 4-element ladder filter and two impedance matching transformers are employed in the IF stage, which is the heart of sound, in order to expand frequency characteristics and reduce spurious interference.The IF bandwidth can be switched to two levels : the wide-band WIDE position and the narrow position, which cuts out external interference when reception conditions are poor.In addition, an AM loop antenna that is resistant to external noise such as fluorescent light noise is used, and a low-noise FET is used at the input stage to increase the selectivity and suppress adjacent station interference with strong input.Equipped with AF amplifier with wide dynamic range.440 Hz air check calibrator.Automatic noise reductionEquipped with a deviation meter that shows the degree of modulation.
