sections.overview: FM/AM stereo tuner using FM feedback system.In the FM feedback system, part of the output signal of the detector is fed back to the local transmitter through the FM servo circuit, and the local transmitter signal is modulated by an ultra-low distortion modulation circuit built into the local transmitter. The modulated local transmitter signal is mixed with the input signal by a mixer to extract the IF signal.NFB (Negative Feedback), an amplifier distortion reduction technology, has been introduced into the IF and detection section of the tuner to improve linearity and reduce distortion. In particular, this FM feedback circuit reduces the distortion of the local frequency modulation circuit to 1/10 of the conventional one, improving the distortion reduction effect.Also, by applying FM servo feedback, the IF spectrum signal band is greatly compressed. This is equivalent to expanding the bandwidth of the IF circuit. The IF signal band can only pass through the part of the IF circuit that has the best phase characteristics. This allows the wide IF signal band for stereo reception or dynamic live programming (overmodulation) to pass and amplify linearly.In addition, since the stereo separation signal included in the IF spectrum is also transmitted, the phase shift in the MPX demodulator is suppressed and separation is improved.Even if there is a slight phase shift in the detected output signal, the FM feedback (servo) does not work, so we pursue excellent phase characteristics. To this end, we carefully select and select an IF linear phase filter and a wideband ultralinear detector.Equipped with 2-stage switching of IF bandwidth, FM feedback operation can be selected at WIDE time.For the first time in its class, the front-end is equipped with two levels of sensitivity switching (Boost Out/In). You can choose between Out = Triple and High sensitivity depending on the reception area.Especially in the Direct position, the input triple tune is followed by direct input to the mixer (MOS FET), and the local output is input to the mixer through the FET buffer to expand the dynamic range at the time of strong input reception.In areas with weak reception, switching to the high-sensitivity position (Boost-In) adds an RF amplifier and operates to enable high-sensitivity reception.Equipped with a servo-lock system, the best sound quality is maintained by improving the tuning stability.When the tuning range is reached, the locked indicator flashes, and as soon as you release the tuning knob, as soon as the tuning knob is released.A highly stable AF amplifier, PLL and IC are used in the MPX section, which separates audio signals into left and right.We have also added an enhanced filter to the stable PLL / IC, and have achieved significant improvements in overall sound quality.It is equipped with a deviation meter that shows the degree of modulation and serves as a guide for setting the FM recording level.The AM part is equipped with a touch sensor and servo lock, and the IF stage is equipped with a 4-element ladder filter and two impedance matching transformers to expand frequency characteristics and reduce spurious interference.In addition to the IF bandwidth WIDE position, it also has a narrow position.In addition, a high-sensitivity AM loop antenna that is resistant to external noise such as fluorescent light noise is used, and the amplitude characteristic of the antenna coil is made steep to increase the selectivity.There was a real wood side plate (CW-9) sold separately.

sections.overview: FM/AM tuner developed and equipped with Onkyo's original dynamic FM feedback technology.FM feedback is a technology that introduces NFB, a distortion reduction technology for the amplifier, into the IF circuit and detector of the tuner. In addition, the IF spectrum signal is greatly compressed and the bandwidth of the IF circuit is expanded.This allows the IF signal to pass through only the part with the best phase characteristics of the circuit, enabling linear amplification and transmission of wide-range IF signals for stereo reception and dynamic live broadcasting, resulting in low distortion and high separation combined with the NFB effect.The IF is equipped with a linear phase filter and the detector with a wide-band linear detector, and the detection output is flat over the range of 20 Hz to 53 kHz, which is an excellent characteristic.In the front end section, the RF stage is switched to two stages of Boost-OFF/ON.The OFF position is designed for high-field areas and short-range reception. It has excellent interference rejection characteristics. After the input triple chain, it passes directly to the mixer without passing through the RF booster. The local output consists of a low-noise twin varicap for parallel use and a MOS FET buffer to drive the mixer.The ON position is a position for low-power regions and long-distance reception. The triple tune is equipped with an RF booster by MOS FET and the input is single-tuned.The IF section can switch between two levels of bandwidth, Wide = FM feedback and Narrow, depending on the reception conditions.By combining this two step switching of IF bandwidth with the two step switching of front-end sensitivity, you can obtain the quality that matches the reception area and radio wave condition.PLL IC is adopted in the MPX part, and 19 khz / 38 khz pilot canceler is mounted.FM/AM12 station random preset memories are installed.Especially, the memory stations 1 to 5 are timer compatible, and by using the timer together, 1 to 5 stations can be received sequentially.A super turbo system is adopted to prevent the influence of modulation noise generated from the power supply and external noise entering from the AC power supply on the signal system.The AM section is equipped with an AM IC which is completely independent from the FM section.Equipped with automatic noise reduction and auto-tuning system.

sections.overview: FM/AM tuner using W stabilizer system.In order to achieve even higher levels of reception performance and sound quality, which are the development themes for the Integra tuner, we developed and installed a W stabilizer system.The W stabilizer method is an improved method using two stabilizers, an electrical D. R (Direct Receiving) stabilizer and a mechanical X stabilizer. In both electrical and mechanical aspects, the W stabilizer method pursues low distortion and stability of the tuner circuit.The D. R stabilizer is a circuit developed to directly receive a wide dynamic range source such as CD. The I. D. S (Isolated Digital System) and D. C. I (Distortion Correcting IF System) reduce digital noise generated inside the tuner to obtain high S/N ratio and achieve high selectivity and low distortion rate.The X stabilizer is made of a special alloy of PbSb. It is the most susceptible to speaker vibration and mechanically suppresses the local vibration that causes the music signal to become muddy.In the I. D. S, the digital and analog sections are separated during broadcast reception by automatically switching between the PLL mode required for receiving and the mode required for listening to the broadcast, thereby reducing digital noise and improving S/N.L. T. D (Linear Tracing Detector) is used for the detector.This system directly detects 10.7 MHz signals. It is a closed-loop system in which signals delayed by 90   from the IF signal are detected by tracing the IF signal linearly. Therefore, S/N is good.Using a D.C. I circuit that compensates for the distortion generated by the IF filter while maintaining a selectivity of 60 dB, it achieves a low distortion factor.The IF stage employs wide/narrow 2-stage switching.The MPX circuit is simplified using a Digital Computed Decordor (D.C. D).By creating a pure 38 kHz (sine wave) for left and right separation and using an analog operation method for the input composite signal, there is no generation of harmonics and no need for a filter to improve separation and distortion factor.The front-end section has been designed to improve intermodulation by adopting a two stage series buffer from the station and two stage RF switching.AM/FM random such as AM/FM random 20-station memory, preset scan and 5-station timer program.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAT-408
sections.overview: This FM stereo tuner is equipped with a quartz lock and has pursued the performance of audio equipment by adhering to the concept of TQ = total quality.It is equipped with a quartz lock system that applies crystal oscillation and realizes excellent tuning accuracy of 0.005% or less of local frequency deviation. Moreover, it is locked to the accurate tuning point instantaneously, enabling excellent tuning.The front end section consists of a basic configuration of a 5-row varicon exclusively for FM using 2 MOS FET and linear frequency type, and a local generation circuit blocked by Tetoron epoxy board. Furthermore, the input stage is double-tuned, which drastically reduces reception interference (intermodulation interference) caused by two adjacent high-level stations.In addition, for the first stage (wide) of the IF stage, a MOS FET with a low noise figure and a wide dynamic range was adopted for the first time in place of the conventional bipolar transistor and IC. Furthermore, an AGC is applied to the second gate to ensure linear response at strong input.The IF stage employs 2-stage bandwidth switching to respond to various radio wave conditions.In the wide mode, a new 4-element linear-phase filter is adopted in which the center of the flat band is suppressed at 10.7 MHz by the group delay direct-viewing device. By selecting and managing severe characteristics, it is possible to add a phase equalization filter with accurate inverse characteristics that compensates for even slight phase undulations.In the narrow mode, a 6-element linear-phase filter is added to the front stage of the wide-mode filter to obtain high selectivity.In the MPX section, a pilot canceler is built into the MPX / PLL IC, and by extending the cutoff of the low-pass filter to 23 khz, the frequency characteristic is expanded to the high band of 18 khz.Moreover, sufficient NFB is applied to the amplifier inside the IC to reduce the generation of harmonic distortion.When the 19 kHz pilot signal required for left / right separation is modulated by the audio signal in the MPX section, a beat occurs in the high-frequency range and distortion increases in the mid-frequency range. To prevent this, we have developed our own beat canceler, which extracts a pure pilot signal by cutting all signals except 19 kHz.In addition to the IF part, wide-band ratio detector and low-distortion MPX part, the   2 power supply audio amplifier with a large dynamic margin is used to clear overmodulation with a low distortion factor even at 200% modulation.Equipped with 50% modulation 440 Hz continuous sound air check calibrator, it is useful for low distortion rate recording with wide dynamic range by setting appropriate recording level.Equipped with a linear type signal meter.The signal to the signal meter is detected by three differential type limiters, an IC that does not saturate even with strong input is used, and by applying AGC to the second gate of the IF first stage MOS FET, linear response characteristics up to a strong input level of 80 dB is realized.Equipped with a multipath output terminal that can detect multipath linearly up to a strong 80 dB input.Also, by connecting an amplifier to the multi-path V terminal, only the distortion component can be checked by ear.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAT-410DG
sections.overview: Digital FM stereo tuner using quartz synthesizer system.It employs a quartz digital synthesizer system, and the local frequency is synthesized electronically by PLL (Phase Locked Loop).The frequency is digitally determined at 100 kHz intervals, and the reference frequency of the PLL is derived from the crystal oscillator. This eliminates the cause of tuning deviation and accompanying sound quality degradation.Built-in 6-station preset digital memory allows you to store up to 6 stations of the desired broadcasting station.Equipped with an auto-scan function, it can scan automatically and easily find a frequency with a station above a certain level.You can also select the channel manually, in which the frequency changes by 0.1 MHz (100 kHz) for each push.It has a built-in clock function that keeps ticking time regardless of whether the power switch is ON or OFF. When the power switch is OFF, the frequency display is switched to the time display. When the power switch is ON, the FM reception function and clock function operate in parallel.It is equipped with 50% modulation, 440 hz air check and calibrator for setting the recording level of the tape deck, dedicated outputs for recording directly to the tape deck, and multipath outputs for good antenna setting.The multi-path output terminal is capable of detecting up to 80 dB strong input in a linear manner, and can be used in combination with an oscilloscope to determine antenna settings with less distortion.Even when there is no oscilloscope, by connecting the amplifier to the multi-path V terminal, only the distortion component can be checked directly by ear.The front end uses a 3-MOS-FET and a 6-row varactor diode, and employs a two stage RF amplification and double-double-single-tuning circuit configuration to achieve excellent interference rejection performance.We also thoroughly reduce reception interference (intermodulation interference) caused by two stations in close proximity.The wide IF uses a MOS-FET with a low noise figure and a wide dynamic range instead of conventional bipolar transistors and ICs. The second gate is also equipped with an AGC to ensure a linear response to strong input.It employs an IF with 2-stage bandwidth switching that realizes the best sound quality according to differences in radio wave conditions. In the wide mode, a new 4-element linear face filter with the center of the flat band at 10.7 MHz is adopted by the county delay direct view device. By selecting and managing the strict special quality, it is possible to add an accurate reverse special phase equalization filter that compensates for slight undulations.In the narrow mode, a 6-element linear-phase filter is added to the previous stage of the above filter to sharply cut interference waves from strong adjacent stations.The 19 khz pilot signal included in FM broadcasting is necessary for stereo separation, but after L and R separation, it was removed with a low-pass filter with a cutoff of 15 khz to prevent mixing into the audio signal. This filter had a negative effect on the high-frequency audio signal. However, in the T-410DG, a pilot canceler is incorporated in the MPX and PLLIC. By sufficiently extending the cutoff frequency of the low-pass filter, the frequency characteristics are expanded to the high-frequency range of 18 khz. In addition, sufficient NFB is applied to the amplifier inside the IC to reduce the generation of harmonic distortion.When the 19 kHz pilot signal required for L / R separation at MPX is modulated by an audio signal, not only a beat occurs in the high range of the L / respiratory sound audio signal that is finally separated, but also distortion increases in the middle range.Integra clarified that this is the main cause of distortion in MPX and developed a beat canceler. We succeeded in extracting a pure pilot signal by cutting off all signals except 19 kHz. As a result, we achieved significant results in reducing mid-range distortion and high-range beat, and achieved excellent low distortion over a wide range.In FM broadcasting, the modulation wave deepens as the amplitude of music increases. In music programs with a wide dynamic range, the modulation wave usually reaches 100 to 150%, with a peak value of 200%. Therefore, even if a tuner receiving this signal shows good quality at 100% modulation, if the sound quality deteriorates rapidly beyond that, it is meaningless to use Hi-Fi.To solve this problem, the T-410DG employs an IF section, a wide-band ratio detector, a low-distortion MPX section, and a   2 power audio amplifier with a large dynamic margin to achieve low distortion even at 200% modulation.

sections.overview: This is an FM stereo tuner developed by Integra's FM engineering team by drawing on its know-how.In the front end section, in addition to a high-precision 7-row varicon with triple tuning input stage, a high-linearity dual-gate MOS FET is adopted for an RF amplifier and a balanced mixer.Furthermore, in consideration of the difference in radio wave conditions in the receiving area, we have developed an IF section with two stage bandwidth switching between WIDE (high sensitivity) and NARROW (high interference rejection performance) without changing the input triple configuration, thereby achieving clear reception performance.The IF section uses a D-MOS FET for the input stage that takes advantage of the reception performance of the front end. It also consists of a linear phase filter with flat delay characteristics and eight interstage high-slew rate double-base differential ICx units.The bandwidth is automatically switched by the S/N detection circuit between WIDE (4-element filter) and NARROW (+ 8-element filter), enabling reception with optimum audio characteristics depending on the radio wave condition.We have developed and adopted a Cerasoid detector for the detector that demodulates FM carrier waves into audio signals.The principle is that the mixer lowers the 10.7 MHzFM wave of the IF output to 1.68 MHz and then the limiter shapes it into a square wave. The high-precision square wave directly controls the sawtooth wave to detect the relative density of the sawtooth wave and extract an audio demodulation signal with a voltage completely inversely proportional to the frequency.We have developed a quartz PLL circuit that uses a crystal oscillator to obtain a stable comparison frequency within 19 kHz   2 Hz. This circuit reduces the characteristic degradation caused by the phase difference with the 19 kHz pilot signal to the limit, and has succeeded in extracting a pure 38 kHz switching signal from the pilot signal included in the composite signal.In addition, a high-speed D-MOS FET with a rise of + 1n/sec is adopted as a switching element that separates the composite signal into LR, and the distortion at the rise and fall part due to the slow switching speed is cleared.In addition, to prevent mixing of pilot signals into audio signals, the MPX input stage is equipped with a pilot auto-canceler with a sine wave function to cope with severe fluctuations in the signal level of the station.All audio circuits after the detector are composed of a servo operational DC amplifier, and a low noise operational amplifier IC is used for the servo amplifier that controls the DC amplifier.Quartz lock system for perfect tuning.The frequency display is a quartz digital readout.Touch sensor tuning.Equipped with DC active low-pass filter.Bus-earth line is adopted. sections.overview: FM stereo tuner using FM feedback system and W super servo system.In the FM feedback system, part of the output signal of the detector is fed back to the local transmitter through the FM servo circuit, and the local transmitter signal is modulated by the low distortion circuit built into the local transmitter. The modulated local transmitter signal is mixed with the input signal by a mixer and an IF signal is extracted.Therefore, the FM feedback method has the same effect as doubling the bandwidth of the IF circuit and allows only the part of the IF circuit with the best phase characteristics to pass through.As a result, the dynamic range of the IF circuit is expanded, and a low distortion factor can be maintained even in the wide IF signal band accompanied by large input in overmodulation.In addition, since it has the NFB effect, linearity in the IF and detection section is greatly improved, and distortion can be reduced.Other features include improved separation at the MPX by clearing the signal, enhanced effect of the servo lock system by widening the IF band, and improved tuning accuracy.Even if a slight phase shift occurs in the detector output signal, the FM servo does not work.Therefore, since it is necessary to obtain excellent phase characteristics, the IF linear phase filter and wideband ultralinear detector are strictly selected and adopted.In addition, it is equipped with 2-stage switching of IF bandwidth (low distortion rate WIDE, high selectivity NARROW), and FM feedback is operated only when WIDE.The front end consists of a direct-input triple-chain frequency linear 7-train varicon and a wide dynamic range dual-gate MOS FETx2 double balanced mixer.The output from the station is fed into the mixer through a tuned buffer consisting of a 3-terminal MOS FET, thereby eliminating intermodulation interference ratio and intermodulation interference.The antenna input stage is two stage switching between Booster Out (direct) and Booster In. The sensitivity can be selected according to the receiving condition.The Booster Out is a position that can show performance in a strong electric field region. After the input triple tune, it enters directly into the mixer without going through RF (harmonic amplification). By ensuring a sufficient dynamic range, interference such as intermodulation is eliminated, and stable and clear reception is possible.Also, the Booster In is a position for the weak electric field region, and before the triple tune, there is RF2-stage amplification (input single tuning) by MOS FET.This makes it possible to receive weak radio waves from a long distance.In the MPX section, a high-speed response C-MOS analog switching element is used for the switching element, and an active filter and a pilot canceler are used to cut the sub-carrier component after L/R separation to prevent sound quality degradation caused by magnetic distortion of the LC low-pass filter.All circuits after MPX are equipped with double super servo amplifier which is the amplifier technology of ONKYO.In this method, the + and - terminals of the tuner output feed back to the MPX input only the harmful noise and distortion components generated in the output and cancel the feedback. At the same time, the distortion due to the slight impedance of the ground line inside the tuner is suppressed.It uses a touch sensor circuit that cuts low-frequency pop noise only when the tuning knob is touched.Uses a touch sensor servo lock system for comfortable channel selection and perfect synchronization.Equipped with 440 Hz air check and calibrator.Equipped with automatic noise reduction.Equipped with a deviation meter with multipath detection useful for antenna installation.

In particular, this FM feedback circuit reduces the distortion of the local frequency modulation circuit to 1/10 of the conventional one, improving the distortion reduction effect.Also, by applying FM servo feedback, the IF spectrum signal band is greatly compressed. This is equivalent to expanding the bandwidth of the IF circuit. The IF signal band can only pass through the part of the IF circuit that has the best phase characteristics. This allows the wide IF signal band for stereo reception or dynamic live programming (overmodulation) to pass and amplify linearly.In addition, since the stereo separation signal included in the IF spectrum is also transmitted, the phase shift in the MPX demodulator is suppressed and separation is improved.Even if there is a slight phase shift in the detected output signal, the FM feedback (servo) does not work, so we pursue excellent phase characteristics. To this end, we carefully select and select an IF linear phase filter and a wideband ultralinear detector.Equipped with 2-stage switching of IF bandwidth, FM feedback operation can be selected at WIDE time.The front-end consists of a direct-input triple-tuned frequency linear 7-train varicon and a wide-dynamic-range dual-gate MOS FETx2 double-balanced mixer. After the input triple tune, it enters directly into the mixer without passing through RF (high-frequency amplification). This ensures a sufficient dynamic range, eliminates interference such as intermodulation, and enables stable and clear reception.The Booster IN is a position for low-power regions. sections.title: ONKYO A-V801PRO
sections.overview: AV surround amplifier with improved operability and sound quality by AI full auto program system and DSP.Equipped with an AI full auto program system to eliminate complicated level setting.Nine surround modes that are most suitable for each AV playback are stored in the device in advance. By simply pressing a key called a multi-preset key, you can turn on the device and automatically recall the settings for the input selector, volume, sound mode, surround content, and tone control.There are five multi-preset keys in total. You can press the key once for settings 1 to 5, and press the key twice for settings 6 to 10.You can also store (overwrite) the surround level that you usually use in the preset keys.The attached remote controller is equipped with a cursor commander.The A-V801PRO can be operated freely using the five keys of the cursor commander while watching the on-screen display on the monitor screen. By using this system, most operations of the A-V 400 PRO can be performed.Equipped with DSP (Digital Signal Processing), in addition to the normal "Dolby Pro Logic Mode", 9 types of surround mode are installed : theater mode 1/2, hall mode 1/2/3, live concert mode, jazz club mode, and disco mode.The audio, video, and microcomputer sections are mounted on separate printed circuit boards for each block. In addition, ground and power lines for these sections are also separated and independent so that mutual interference of each circuit is suppressed.In addition, the power supply to the digital circuits such as the microcomputer and DSP circuits and the class d to the video circuit are provided with a 2-transformer power supply system that uses a transformer with a separate power supply independent of the main transformer to prevent high-frequency noise from entering the audio circuit.Five types of Dolby Pro Logic are installed, enabling effective sound field reproduction for various speaker settings.It is also equipped with Auto Input Balance, which automatically compensates for input balance errors during playback of Dolby Pro Logic. This function automatically compensates for balance errors that occur with input signals from the left and right channels during playback of AV software. You can obtain the best channel separation without worrying about the channel balance of each software.The front, center, and rear channels are equipped with independent tone controls to eliminate unnatural sounds caused by differences in the tone of the front, center, and rear speakers.Each tone control can be set for each of the three bands Bass, Mid, and Treble, and the level adjusted by the tone control is indicated by an indicator on the display.With the adoption of DSP, among the nine surround modes except for Dolby mode and Theater mode, more detailed sound field reproduction is possible by setting the sound field parameter level in other surround modes.It is equipped with three kinds of test tone functions which are useful for adjusting the level of each speaker and functions such as Rec Standby Mode.The power amplifier section consists of five discrete amplifiers.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-V901PRO
sections.overview: This is the first AV amplifier in the Integra series developed by combining ONKYO's audio technology.The surround processor features a newly developed Balanced Audio Dolby ProLogic processor.This circuit employs two sets of excellent analog decoder circuits that have performance exceeding that of digital decoders even when used alone. These two circuits operate in opposite phases to each other and output L (left) / C (center) / R (right) / S (surround) through a differential amplifier to cancel non-linear distortion and residual noise.This realizes the world's highest level of pure and clear sound quality in surround sound reproduction with logic operation, and improves various characteristics.It is equipped with an Ambisonic surround decoder to reproduce the sound of "Ambisonic Recording Method", a unique one point recording method developed by Nimbus Records Records UK, in the listening room as it is.It is equipped with a UHJ mode for CDs with ambisonic recording, and a STEREO mode for ordinary stereo recording software to provide ambisonic surround effects.It combines a logic decoder with DSP (digital signal processing), and is equipped with a theater mode function that adds multi-surround speaker effect and reverberation effect.A multi-surround speaker effect is achieved by simulating sound that is played from a surround speaker installed in a movie theater at different distances and directions, and distributing it appropriately to two front, one center, and two rear speakers. It also simulates a space of different sizes from a mini theater to a large theater, and adds an appropriate reverberation effect to the speakers for realization in a listening room.It is equipped with a number of surround modes, such as halls and live concerts. In these surround modes, you can set various sound field parameters. You can adjust the room size to adjust the size of the hall, the reverb to adjust the decay time of the reverberation, and the effect level to adjust the level of sound effects. You can make detailed adjustments according to the conditions of the listening room and your preference.The theater mode is equipped with DSS (Digital Simulated Super Woofer Processing) and creates a super-low sound sensation in the listening room.In order to realize simple operation, it is equipped with AI full automatic program system, and certain operation is automatically performed by pressing the Multi Preset key.There are a total of five Multi Preset keys, and you can call up to ten patterns : one press to call up to one five patterns, and two presses to call up to six ten patterns.Equipped with full mode Dolby Pro Logic with auto input balance circuit.Equipped with wide aspect screen automatic support function.Each block is designed separately and independently, and the power amplifier section consists of 5 amplifiers of discrete design.It is equipped with video circuits with transmission characteristics equivalent to 1,600 units.It features independent 3-band tone control for all channels, three test tones for adjusting the speaker level, a Rec Standby mode with voice recording, and A/V separation for audio and video sources.All channel pre-out jacks and four channel discrete inputs for HDTV are included.The included learning remote control includes a learning interface function.For example, when the remote control is used to turn on the video, the amplifier automatically turns on, the input selector switches to VIDEO-1, and so on. The learning interface function learns and automatically executes operations that are closely related to a certain operation by remembering the user's habits.In this way, it is possible to easily control the operation of multiple AV devices by the learning interface function that learns and executes the auto-startup function, auto-shutdown function, and auto-input selector function in association with each other.

sections.title: ONKYO A-V1000PRO
sections.overview: 6-channel AV amplifier with dual center speaker support.When the center speaker is mounted on a single speaker, it is installed above or below the monitor to prevent a gap between the sound image and the video image. To this end, we have adopted a dual center speaker system in which a Centner speaker is installed on the left, right, top and bottom of the screen.With the built-in Dolby Pro Logic Surround System, the sound separation between each channel has been improved to approximately 25 dB, which was only approximately 3 dB with the conventional Dolby Surround system.The A-V1000PRO is equipped with 3-mode Dolby Pro Logic and can be installed freely according to the situation of the speaker and listening room."Normal mode" is suitable for using a small speaker for the center channel. The signal below 100 Hz is split left and right, and the center channel outputs the signal above 100 Hz.In "Wide Mode", the signal is output to the center channel as it is, and the center speaker is responsible for playback of all bands from low to high.Phantom mode is a mode that does not use the center channel and distributes the center channel signal to the left and right speakers.The remote control is equipped with a cursor commander function that can be operated with 5 buttons of direction keys and Enter/Escape keys. It can be operated with one finger while watching the screen.The Cursor Commander controls the following functions : "Surround Preset" for adjusting the surround delay time, center level, and rear level ; "Input Selector" for switching and displaying the input selector ; "Recording Check" for displaying the recording status of video and audio according to the position of the recording selector ; "Option" for switching and displaying the Source Direct, Super Bus, and on-screen display modes ; and "Menu Off" for erasing the currently displayed menu.Bass and Treble tone controls are provided for each of the front, center and rear channels, so you can adjust the sound quality according to the setting and the size of the room.Equipped with a test tone function that is useful for adjusting the level of each speaker.It generates a noise signal that automatically cycles through the Left ? Center ? Right ? Rear channels, making it easy to adjust the level of each channel.In addition to L/R, Center and Rear audio input terminals are mounted on the BS input terminal.In addition to Dolby Pro Logic, a 3-mode surround system is built in so that you can enjoy surround sound even when you are not playing Dolby recorded software."Dolby" is used by Dolby Pro Logic Surround to play Dolby Mark Source or Dolby Surround broadcast."Hall" adds reverberation to the rear and front signals, so you can enjoy the feeling of being in a theater or concert hall.In "Stadiium", the reflection sound is added to the rear. It is used when you want to enjoy the atmosphere of the stadium such as the stereo broadcast transmission of sports program.Simulated turns a mono source into a simulated stereo sound, giving a sense of spaciousness and depth.The delay time can be set at 5 ms intervals from 0 to 30 ms (15 ms to 30 ms for Dolby and Hall modes).It also comes with a "surround off" mode for two channel stereo playback.The BGV function allows you to select video and audio separately for playback and recording, the "Rec Selector" with back recording function, and the L/R input level adjustment function allows you to adjust the surround effect to the best condition.

As with high-end models, you can also customize the Input Selector to remember the listening mode.It features an audio-oriented 24-bit crystal DSP processor, a 96 kHz / 24-bit D/A converter, and a separate aluminum extrusion heat sink for front and center & surround systems.The power amplifier section is equipped with a completely independent 5-channel discrete power amplifier.Wide Range Amplifier Technology WRAT compatible with DVD-Audio and SACD has been introduced.Equipped with an optimal gain volume circuit that improves S/N with optimal attenuation control.It uses an audio / video separation board that protects the signal purity by preventing noise contamination.All channels use a screw-type speaker terminal that supports banana plugs.Equipped with digital / analog automatic input switching function.It is equipped with a late-night mode that allows you to hear clearly even when playing in low volume such as at night, and suppresses large sound effects.This function can be used when playing Dolby Digital.Equipped with 30-station preset FM/AM tuner.It comes with a remote control for main operation such as DVD player made by Onkyo.

sections.title: ONKYO TX-DS575
sections.overview: An AV amplifier equipped with a Dolby digital and DTS signal decoder, and also equipped with new technology for DVD-Audio.The 24-bit HD (High Definition) DSP in the DSP section realizes high-quality decoding of Dolby digital and DTS signals.In addition, it is equipped with a 5.1 ch analog input terminal and can be extended to DVD-Audio and SACD.WRAT (Wide Range Amplifier Technology), a new wide-range technology, was introduced to support DVD-Audio.At WRAT, by examining the parts and circuit configuration, dependence on NFB circuits is eliminated as much as possible, and a wide range of bare characteristics is achieved.The TX-DS575 takes note of the fact that the audio signal passing through the amplifier itself changes the ground potential, so it is possible to propagate the audio signal more accurately. The TX-DS 200 takes note of the fact that the audio signal itself that passes through the amplifier itself changes the ground potential, so it is possible to stabilize the signal by closing the entire network into a loop.Focusing on interference with sound field reproduction caused by the back electromotive force of speakers, we aim to expand the distortion factor and frequency characteristics by eliminating dependence on NFB circuit as much as possible.HICC (High Instantaneous Current Capability) is used to drive the speakers accurately even under various conditions caused by rapidly changing audio signals, so that a large current can be supplied instantaneously.The D/A converter is equipped with a 96kHz/24bitD/A converter.Equipped with a cinema re-equalizer (Re-EQ), it reduces the high-frequency components that are emphasized in DVD-Video, which is made based on the playback environment of movie theaters, to obtain more natural playback sound.Includes Dolby Digital, DTS Digital, DTS, and Dolby Prologic.There are five original surround modes for listening to music sources : Orchestra, Unplugged, Studio-Mix, 5 ch Stereo and TV Logic.Equipped with a late night function that reduces the dynamic range during low-volume playback (Dolby Digital Only)It is equipped with a front effect function that cuts off the additional functions of DSP processing when playing back a source that has been pre-processed in the sound source itself, such as a live concert.You can adjust two types of speaker settings : level and distance.It is equipped with a Dimmer function to change the brightness of the display.Equipped with an FM/AM tuner equipped with 30-station preset and auto-tuning function.It comes with a wireless remote control equipped with not only a learning function to learn the main operation of other devices, but also a macro function to memorize continuous remote control operations with one button.

sections.title: ONKYO TX-DS777
sections.overview:
125,000 (released on September 10, 1999)

This AV amplifier is compatible with Dolby Digital and DTS, and is also certified by THX SELECT.Among the Home THX Cinema standards by Lucasfilm, it is certified by THX SELECT, a standard intended for use in a relatively small room of approximately 57 cubic meters. This standard is certified only for products that have passed a wide range of rigorous screening including product design concepts, THX technology realization devices, product features and ergonomics, technical composition, and audition screening.The Dolby Digital and DTS signals are decoded using 24 bitDSP of Crystal Semiconductor Products Division developed exclusively for audio. The DSP has twice the processing power of the general 24 bitDSP by improving the signal processing method.The A/D converter is equipped with 96kHz/24bit IC, and the D/A converter is equipped with 96kHz/24bit IC.DAC circuit configuration with non-scaling configuration is adopted.Normally, when downmixing, such as when the center channel is not played, the center channel signal and the front channel signal are added in the DSP before being processed by the D/A converter. In this case, the maximum value (full scale) that can be handled in the DSP is overflowed, so the dynamic range is degraded because the addition is performed after scaling (half the amount of data for the front and center channels).In addition to the 6-channel DAC (total of three chips), the TX-DS777 has another 2-channel DAC chip, enabling full-scale transmission without adding two types of signals in the DSP.WRAT (Wide Range Amplifier Technology) has been introduced to extend the frequency characteristics of a bare circuit without negative feedback to high frequencies and to reduce the distortion factor. By this, the frequency band can be extended to 100 kHz by applying only a small feedback that does not affect the audibility.By stabilizing the ground potential, which is the reference for the audio signal processed in the amplifier, more accurate audio signal propagation is possible.In the TX-DS777, we focused on the fact that the audio signal passing through the amplifier itself changes the ground potential, and succeeded in stabilizing the ground potential by closing all the networks into a loop.High Instantaneous Current Capability (HICC), which can instantaneously supply a large current, has been introduced in order to accurately drive speakers under various conditions caused by rapidly changing audio signals.It is equipped with an on-screen display function that displays the menu screen on the TV and makes various settings.Equipped with 5.1 ch pre-out output capable of connecting 5.1 ch input terminal and external power amplifier.Surround modes include Action, Unplugged, Musical, Studio-Mix, Mono Movie, 5 ch Stereo, Orchestra, and TV Logic.The remote controller comes with a learning function to learn how to operate peripheral devices such as a TV or DVD player, and a macro function to memorize continuous remote control operations.

175,000 (released on September 18, 2001)

There are two modes of menus : Basic menu (minimum required) and Advanced menu (for custom setting). It also has a listening mode memory function that automatically stores the listening mode for each input source type, an intelligent volume function that automatically adjusts the volume level for each medium to be constant, and a function that allows video signals input from the composite connector to be output from the S connector and vice versa.Equipped with wide-range amplifier technology WRAT for DVD-Audio and SACD.Equipped with a linear optimal gain volume circuit that improves S/N with optimal attenuation control.Equipped with a non-scaling configuration function to prevent degradation of dynamic range and S/N during downmix.Equipped with a speaker impedance setting function that can be used with 4   speakers.It is equipped with digital upsampling function which also supports analog source.Equipped with an A/V sync function to compensate for the minute gap between video and audio that occurs when using a line doubler.Onkyo's unique surround modes include Theta-Dimensional, Mono Movie, Enhanced7, Orchestra, Unplugged, Stuio Mix, TV Logic, and All Ch Stereo.Equipped with power on volume function that can set the level when the power is ON.Equipped with a maximum volume that can set the upper limit of the volume level.The LFE level can be set according to the signal format.There are two ways to display volume levels.It is equipped with a function to display naming (select alphabet, etc.) of each input source.Equipped with a 40-station preset FM/AM tuner.It comes with a remote control equipped with learning & macro function that includes operation codes for AV equipment of major manufacturers in advance.This remote control is also capable of self-illumination of buttons by the back light.

sections.title: ONKYO TX-DS989
sections.overview: AV amplifier equipped with THX Ultra certified 7 ch amplifier.The TX-DS989 is available in early and late models.The latter model is equipped with Dolby Pro Logic II, DTS-ES and MPEG-2 AAC decoder in addition to the same configuration as the former model, and each mark is written on the front panel.In addition, during the period from April 2001 to April 2003, an upgrade service was provided for the early model, and the early model was compatible with Dolby Pro Logic II, DTS-ES, and MPEG-2 AAC.Equipped with an THX Ultra certified 7-channel amplifier, it realizes the spread of a front sound field that perfectly localizes to the image targeted by THX and a rear sound field that creates natural surround feeling.In addition to the conventional 5.1 channels, the THX Surround EX decoder uses a surround back channel to further enhance the sense of diffusion in the rear sound field. This enables a more theater-like playback environment with two surround back channels (surround L/R) and 7.1 channels including a subwoofer.Equipped with an RS 232 terminal, it can be used for DSP upgrades and home integrated control systems such as the AMX system.It also includes an expansion board slot for the IEEE1394 terminal, which provides power and voice information through a single cable.It uses a design in which buttons for setting are hidden inside the electric slide door.Various settings can be made by on-screen display while watching the display. Each input selector can automatically store the previously selected listening mode and its parameters. In addition, the automatic listening mode selection function linked to input signal formats such as DTS, PCM, and analog, and the intelligent volume function that can adjust the signal level in advance depending on the input device or source can be set for each input selector.You can also lock the setting.It features two 24-bit crystal DSP processors and a 192 kHz / 24-bit D/A converter.In addition, high-quality parts such as Maxim's video amplifier used in professional equipment and toroidal transformer which is superior in low impedance design are used.Wide Range Amplifier Technology WRAT compatible with DVD-Audio and SACD has been introduced.Equipped with a linear optimal gain volume circuit that improves S/N with optimal attenuation control.Equipped with a non-scaling configuration to prevent dynamic range and S/N degradation during downmix.It is equipped with digital upsampling function which also supports analog source.It is equipped with an AV sync function (up to 3 frames) to compensate for the minute gap between video and audio that occurs when using a line doubler.It is equipped with Theater-Dimensional mode which reproduces virtual surround with only the front speaker.Equipped with power on volume function that can set the level when the power is ON.Equipped with a maximum volume function that can set the upper limit of the volume level.The LFE level can be set according to the signal format.Built-in 40-station preset FM/AM tuner.Remote controller with learning & macro function is included.In addition to learning the remote control code of another connected device and memorizing continuous remote control operations using the macro function, this remote control can also illuminate buttons with the back light.

sections.overview: AV amplifier equipped with Dolby Pro Logic II and MPEG-2 AAC decoder.In addition to DTS and Dolby Digital, it is equipped with a Dolby Pro Logic II decoder capable of 5.1 channel playback from a 2-channel sound source, and an MPEG-2 AAC decoder, an audio format for BS digital broadcasting.A new design has been adopted for the amplifier section.The design layout is designed to minimize noise by increasing the depth of the casing and shortening the wiring between circuit boards. The digital signal processing circuit uses a Cirrus Logic 24-bit DSP processor and a 96 kHz / 24-bit D/A converter.Equipped with WRAT, a compound wide range amplifier technology unique to Onkyo.Equipped with a non-scaling configuration to prevent degradation of the dynamic range S/N ratio that occurs during downmix.Equipped with an optimal gain volume circuit that improves S/N with optimal attenuation control.In order to compensate for the difference in the playback environment from a movie theater where speakers are installed behind the screen, it is equipped with a cinema filter function unique to Onkyo that reduces the high-frequency component and realizes more natural sound.It is equipped with a crossover frequency switching function (80/100/120Hz) that can adjust the low frequency band emitted from the subwoofer depending on the speaker size.In addition, it is equipped with a double bus circuit that realizes powerful low sound reproduction even from a sound source without an LFE signal.Equipped with a simple configuration function, you can easily obtain sound field space by simply setting the number of speakers and the ON/OFF of the subwoofer.In addition, the Center Delay and Surround Delay functions allow you to fine-tune the settings.It uses an audio / video separation board that protects the signal purity by preventing noise contamination.All channels use a screw-type speaker terminal that supports banana plugs.Equipped with digital / analog automatic input switching function.It is equipped with a late night mode in which you can listen to the dialogue even in low volume playback such as at night, and large sound effects are limited to the degree.This function can be used when playing Dolby Digital.Onkyo's unique surround modes include Orchestra, Unplugged, Studio-Mix, TV Logic and All Ch Stereo.It comes with a remote control for main operation such as DVD player made by Onkyo.Equipped with an RI audio control terminal that can be operated in conjunction with AV devices with RI marks.

sections.title: ONKYO TX-SA600
sections.overview: Equipped with a 6 ch discrete amplifier, this AV amplifier supports 6.1 ch surround sound formats such as Dolby Digital EX and DTS-ES.In addition to Dolby Digital, it is equipped with Dolby Pro Logic II, Dolby Digital EX, DTS-ES, and MPEG-2 AAC decoder.The amplifier circuit is equipped with a discrete 6-ch power amplifier and a simple design layout that stabilizes the ground potential of the amplifier circuit and reduces harmful noise.The digital signal processor uses a 96 kHz / 24-bit D/A converter and a 24-bit DSP chip made by Cirrus Logic.Onkyo's proprietary compound wide-range amplifier technology, WRAT, has been adopted in order to enhance the performance of the amplifier in actual operation and to improve the S/N of the sense of hearing.Equipped with a non-scaling configuration to prevent degradation of dynamic range and S/N ratio during downmix.Equipped with a linear optimal gain volume circuit that improves S/N with optimal attenuation control.Pure Audio Audio mode enhances the quality of 2 ch playback. This feature allows you to power off the video circuit without going through the sound adjustment circuit and then turn off the display to minimize noise sources.To compensate for the difference from a movie theater where speakers are installed behind the screen, Onkyo's unique cinema filter function reduces the high-frequency component and realizes natural playback.It is equipped with a crossover frequency switching function (80Hz/100Hz/120Hz) that can adjust the low frequency band emitted from the subwoofer depending on the speaker size.It is equipped with double bus circuit which realizes powerful low sound reproduction even for sound source without LFE signal.It is equipped with an on-screen display function that can be set while watching the monitor.It uses an audio / video separation board that prevents noise contamination.All channels except SP-B have a banana plug-compatible screw-type speaker terminal.Equipped with digital / analog automatic input switching function.It is equipped with a late night mode that allows you to hear clearly even in low volume playback such as at night, and suppresses large sound effects.This function can be used when playing Dolby Digital.Onkyo's unique surround modes include Orchestra, Unplugged, Studio-Mix, TV Logic and All Ch Stereo.A learning remote controller with pre-set operation codes for AV equipment of major manufacturers is included.This remote control also has a macro function that combines continuous operations into one button.Equipped with an RI audio control terminal that enables operation in conjunction with AV equipment with the RI mark.

sections.title: ONKYO BR-NX10A
sections.overview:
Discretionary price (around   69,800, released in June 2008)

A CD/HDD tuner amplifier that you can enjoy by combining with your own speakers.The BR-NX10A was designed as the main body part of the mini-component X-NX10A, but it was also sold separately.Super Floating HDD unit is used for the HDD part to reduce the effect of electrical noise.The electronic components used inside the HDD function as a low-sensitivity microphone, picking up vibrations caused by the high-speed rotation of the HDD and generating electrical noise. This electrical noise causes the loss of minute music information, so when you record music on a PC, you may hear the expression and nuance of the music slightly different from the original, or you may feel that the clarity of the low tone has been lost.In order to prevent this problem, we have developed a chassis structure that is strong against torsion and deflection using thick chassis material and high-rigidity aluminum front panel based on the know-how cultivated in high-grade single component components, and the generation of electrical noise is prevented from the foundation. Inside the chassis, noise is reduced by optimal layout and wiring, power control and ground control.The HDD unit is equipped with additional anti-vibration measures. The special steel base in which the HDD is fixed has rubber bushings at the four corners that act as buffer cushions. These cushions effectively make the HDD part a floating structure, preventing vibration from the HDD from being transmitted to other circuits and parts.The discrete configuration amplifier, which is the design method used in the single amplifier, provides more pure reproduction capability, and the VLSC circuit, which reduces pulse noise and realizes more pure analog conversion, is incorporated.Uses an optimal gain volume that does not lose sound even at low volume.The CD drive can play music CDs and CD-R/RW (including MP3 files).You can dub music at up to 8 times the speed from the music CD to the HDD with a single button. In addition, when dubbing, information such as album names and song titles can be automatically registered from the database of 350000 albums pre-registered in the HDD. This function supports not only when dubbing to the HDD but also when playing music CDs on the BR-NX10A. Songs are not registered in the BR-NX10A, you can search for song information via the Internet.You can choose a linear PCM format for recording, the same uncompressed format as music CDs, or you can convert to ATRAC and MP3 formats after recording.Equipped with USB direct play function.Simply insert a USB flash drive, digital audio player, or external HDD containing MP3 music files into the USB port and press the USB Play button on the remote control to start music playback. With conventional models, it was necessary to load music into the HDD once, so it is easier to use.You can transfer and record music data in ATRAC3, ATRAC3plus, or MP3 format stored in the HDD of the BR-NX10A to digital audio players (ATRAC players / MP3 players) or USB memories.The BR-NX10A can also record MP3-format songs stored in digital audio players, USB thumb drives, or PCs (LAN connection) to the HDD.If you register for Any Music, you can listen to music on a trial basis or download music from titles distributed on the Internet music distribution site mora.You can also purchase a lineup of CDs, view on-air information of FM broadcasting (such as information on programs being broadcast or information on songs being broadcast), and store music information on the BR-NX10A so that you can download songs and purchase CDs.It has a built-in tuner that supports preset functions for 20 FM stations and 10 AM stations.You can use the timer function to record your favorite programs and later edit only the parts you need to enrich your library. There are three timer functions : recording, playback, and sleep timer.By connecting an MD deck or cassette deck, past sound sources can also be saved in the HDD.It is compatible with the Gracenote service, and it is possible to register names of songs and artists by automatically recognizing waveform data of songs recorded on the Internet from sources other than music CDs.You can store image data (JPEG format) stored in a USB memory or LAN-connected HDD to songs or albums recorded on the HDD.It is equipped with a normalization function that automatically adjusts the volume level of each piece of music when playing back the music in the HDD, so that each piece of music can be played with uneven peak values.All songs in the HDD can be played in BGM with one button. Random playback is also supported.You can create a playlist.Equipped with a super bus function.Equipped with tone control.The original system-linked RI enables one touch recording and other linked operations by connecting an On-Kiyo MD deck or cassette deck.A remote control is included.

sections.title: ONKYO E-83ANEWMKIII
sections.overview: Based on the E-83AmkIII, this is an upgraded speaker system with new mid-range and low-range units and improved high-range units.In the low range, it is equipped with W-3024E which is a 30 cm cone type woofer with technology developed in the Ceptor and materials.The diaphragm uses a mixed cone made of two types of Finnish pulp with different physical properties. It is finished with a curved curved cone that is effective for sound quality. In addition, the edge uses neoprene foam rubber edge that has good followability and prevents mechanical strain such as horizontal deflection of the cone. This realizes fo = 20 Hz for the woofer alone.The voice coil is an edge-wise wound voice coil, and a long voice coil with a winding width of approximately 20 mm using an aluminum foil bobbin ensures good propagation characteristics.In the middle area, the diffusion horn squawker of the Septor unit HM-450A is mounted as it is in the MD-301001C which is a type without external surface makeup only.The diffusion horn is designed so that the sound path of the horn becomes longer at the peripheral part. By changing the sound wave inside the horn into a spherical wave, the directivity, which was a weak point of the horn type, is greatly improved.In addition, the diaphragm is made of ultra-hard Djelal Min-foil, and active air damping is performed in the back cavity, so that transient characteristics and strain characteristics are improved and the low-frequency reproduction range is expanded.A newly designed double equalizer has been adopted in the horn throat section. By making the slit double, the sound emitted from each part of the diaphragm becomes opposite phase in the slit section and cancels out each other to shorten the wavelength, thus improving the high-frequency characteristics.As a result of these measures, although the cut-off frequency is as low as 450 Hz, the horn length is shortened and miniaturized by the diffusion horn, and the high band is extended to 1.3 kHz by the adoption of the double equalizer, realizing a wide band.A horn type tweeter TW-611A is mounted in the high range.The horn section has a sufficient horn load and employs a precision die-cast extrinsic horn that reduces internal reflection and material noise. The surface of the horn is treated with a malt-plane treatment that increases the apparent length of the horn and improves braking, resulting in excellent transient characteristics. This malt-plane treatment also reduces reflection inside the horn and increases the naturalness of the reproduced sound.The diaphragm is made of ultra-hard duralumin foil developed by Septor, and combined with the magnetic circuit with magnetic flux density of 14,500 gauss, smooth response is realized.Low-loss LC network is used in the network section.It is also equipped with 5-step level control for mid-range and high-range, and can be adjusted within   2 dB.The enclosure is sealed, with hard chipboard for the front baffle, lauan plywood for other areas, and a walnut finish for the exterior.Equipped with multi-terminals, 3-way multi-amplifier drive is possible.

sections.overview: This model has been revised and improved in all components from the M-3 unit to the network.A 28 cm cone type unit is used for the low range.This unit is responsible for most of the bandwidth that is occupied by the fundamental components of Ong-buy.A seat cone with multi-corrugation that is strong for large input is driven by a magnetic circuit that employs a 50   mm long voice coil and a 120   x60   x20mm magnet.Utilizing the know-how developed in the M6II, we have also improved resolution and orientation in the lower frequency range by adopting a reinforcing ring, etc.In addition, it uses a long-stroke corrugation molding method and a damper with a special shape in which the wave Takabe gradually becomes larger (deeper) from the inner circumference to the outer circumference. This not only reduces the mechanical resistance and improves the damping characteristics, but also stresses when displaced are added to each corrugation, bringing about an appropriate restraining effect on all the guiding regions of the woofer and improving the linearity.The types of urethane foam with different physical properties, an ester type for the upper layer and an ether type for the lower layer, are bonded together at a ratio of 3 : 7. The edge is molded into a special shape that gradually reduces the density from the cone paper side to the frame side. This enables linear tracking even when the cone moves violently at large amplitude and suppresses non-linear distortion.The frame is an aluminum die-cast frame with a black finish that is approximately 20% heavier than the M-3, increasing rigidity and effectively suppressing baffle vibration.A 4-cm compound type tweeter unit is used for the high range.It uses a carbon radiator with high rigidity and light weight and large internal loss, and a diaphragm made of a radiator using titanium with high Young's modulus and light weight.The edge is laminated with lightweight and high internal loss material, and the frame is filled with high internal loss plastic material.The mounting position of this tweeter part can be exchanged with the bass reflex port.

sections.title: ONKYO M-6
sections.overview: This speaker system was developed from the starting point of audio reproduction, which is to make music more enjoyable.A 31 cm cone type woofer, W-3503A is mounted in the low range.The diaphragm uses a sheet cone with multi-corrugation, which is strong against large input, and is driven by a 78   mm large diameter long voice coil. The magnetic circuit uses a large magnet of 180   x95   x15mm that ensures a magnetic flux density of 10,000 gauss. The pole is equipped with a copper short ring with a drop that reduces harmonic distortion near fh due to current distortion, to prevent distortion in the magnetic circuit.The edge uses a specially molded urethane foam edge that is molded so that the cone paper side is high density and thin, and the frame side is low density and thick, ensuring light weight and moderate internal loss.The butterfly damper is made of a polyimide with excellent heat resistance, high strength, and excellent response characteristics against hysteresis has been put into practical use as a butterfly damper for the first time in Japan. Along with the edge of a new structure, a highly effective suspension system with little change over time has been realized. This polyimide plate has excellent damping characteristics and Qm (mechanical resistance) compared with other materials. In the M-6, it is also used in the Woofer voice coil to improve low-frequency characteristics.The M-6 uses this woofer close to the full range so that the fundamental band is almost entirely covered by the woofer, which improves the sense of orientation and enhances the ability to reproduce sound images.A 4-cm composite tweeter, TW-406A, is mounted in the high range.High-frequency characteristics have been improved by a composite structure combining titanium diaphragm with high Young's modulus and lightweight, and carbon cone with light and high internal loss.A mode selector is used for the level control.Mode 1 is suitable for normal listening rooms, Mode 2 is suitable when you want to emphasize the high and low frequencies depending on the source, or when the sound characteristics of the room are dead, and Mode 3 is suitable for a live room where the middle and high frequencies are too high, and the sound is quiet in the middle and high range.The enclosure uses a bass-reflex method. The baffle plate is made of 20 mm Yonematsu plywood and the side plate is made of 18 mm conifer chipboard. The bass-reflex port is equipped with slits to improve low-frequency braking.The mounting positions of the bass reflex port and the tweeter section are the same size with the same dimensions. By reversing the mounting position of one channel, a symmetrical unit layout can be achieved.The exterior is coated with polyurethane.

sections.title: ONKYO QUARTLAM-III
sections.overview: A floor-type speaker system using the QL system.The QL system applies the principles of flute and Yokobue. It uses an ALT (Acoustic Loading Tube) installed at the back of the speaker to resonate the sound emitted from the back of the speaker at the speaker at frequencies corresponding to 1/4 of the length of the tube, and efficiently reproduces low frequencies. The structure of this type of enclosure looks similar to that of a backload horn. However, the mounting position of the unit differs between the QL type and the backload horn. In the QL type, the unit is installed in the middle of the tube.In the QuartLam III, the tube length is designed to be 1.8m, and the resonance frequency at 1/4 wave length (lowest resonance frequency) is 47.2 Hz, which is the lower limit of the lower range.In addition, as a resonance tube, resonance occurs at frequencies of integral multiples with a minimum resonance frequency of 47.2 Hz. In order to prevent this, measures are taken such as changing the thickness of the tube by tapering the partition plate, attaching an appropriate amount of sound absorbing material to a part of the tube, adjusting by installing a tuning port, and selecting the mounting position of the speaker strictly. These measures reduce the Q and prevent disturbance of the response.The low range is equipped with W-1608C which is a 16 cm cone type woofer.In this unit, light and long fiber cone paper and highly compliant urethane   type roll edge realize bright and rich bass reproduction. In addition, the magnetic circuit uses large magnet of 100 mm diameter and voice coil of aluminum foil bobbin of 30 mm diameter to improve damping and linearity.TW-825A/TW-825B 8 cm cone type tweeters are mounted in the high range.These units have different edges, fixed edge and free edge respectively. This gives different characteristics even with the same 8 cm aperture. By shifting the responsible band and overlapping with the stagger, the high-frequency reproduction capability is enhanced.The network structure is also independent of each other.Equipped with a level control on the rear surface, the level of the tweeter can be switched to 3 levels.In the Minimum position, Tweeter 1 is cut.Hard particle board is used for the enclosure, and the thickness of the front baffle is especially thick.

sections.title: ONKYO SCEPTER10
sections.overview: A large-scale floor-type speaker system designed for rich bass sound and strong and bright sound.A 38 cm cone type woofer unit W-3810A is mounted in the low range.The diaphragm uses a multi-corrugation cone that is strong against large inputs. It is driven by a 78   mm large diameter long voice coil with a special heat-resistant design. In addition, an aluminum reinforcing ring is attached to the joint between the cone paper and voice coil to improve the mechanical strength against large inputs, effectively prevent the bell vibration of the cone paper, and clear the middle and low range sound.Specially molded 2-layer urethane foam edge is used for the edge. This edge is made of 2 types of urethane foam with different physical properties, ester type for the upper layer and ether type for the lower layer, bonded together at a ratio of 3 : 7. In addition, it uses a special shape in which the density gradually decreases from the cone paper side to the frame side. By this, it exhibits linear follow-up even to the violent movement of the cone at large amplitude and suppresses the generation of non-linear distortion.A butterfly damper using a special heat-resistant resin laminate is used for the damper. This material is excellent in heat resistance, strength, and hysteresis. Along with the edge of the new structure, it realizes a highly effective suspension with very little aging. This material has excellent damping characteristics compared with other materials and is also used for voice coil bobbins.The magnetic circuit uses a 180   x95   x20mm magnet. The pole piece uses an H-type to maintain the symmetry of the magnetic distribution. In addition, the copper short ring reduces the harmonic distortion near fh due to current distortion.A combination of a horn-type tweeter TW-1206A and an acoustic lens AL-120 is mounted in the high range.The TW-1206A diaphragm uses an ultra-thin 20 micron foil titanium diaphragm. The high hardness of titanium increases the frequency at which split vibration occurs. Combined with the use of a free edge structure using polyester film and a double equalizer, excellent high-frequency stretch and transparency are obtained. In addition, the transient characteristics are further improved by the advantage of hardness and light weight, and sharp rise characteristics are obtained.The horn section is an aluminum die-cast short horn with a cutoff frequency of 500 Hz. High efficiency and wide directivity are realized by combining with an acoustic lens.The acoustic lens AL 120 uses a high impact styrene polymers and copolymers to prevent the blades from sticking.Equipped with a 3-position mode selector.Position 1 is a mode that actively uses woofer and tweeter. The crossover area is slightly raised and has a sharp tone.Position 2 is designed to make the connection between the woofer and the tweeter as flat as possible in terms of sound pressure and frequency characteristics. sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAH-1E
sections.overview: An MC head amplifier that improves the S/N ratio by taking advantage of the frequency characteristics and distortion factor characteristic of a head amplifier for electronic circuits.In order to improve the S/N ratio, a source feedback amplifier circuit is adopted.The equivalent noise resistance of the input stage of a source-feedback amplifier circuit is 1 / 2 of that of a general differential amplifier often used in the first stage because of its excellent DC performance. Therefore, the S/N ratio can be improved in a head amplifier that handles minute level signals.In addition, by using this circuit, the slew rate is increased and wide-band reproduction is possible.The newly developed SEPP (Single Ended Push-Pull) power supply with excellent noise performance is used to take advantage of the low noise characteristics of the head amplifier.The push-pull operation improves the linearity of impedance against output current fluctuation and realizes high-speed response.In addition, the response to the increasing and decreasing directions of the current becomes symmetrical, and the fluctuation of the power supply voltage can be reduced.The equalizer amplifier uses the NF type, which has a proven track record as a separate amplifier, and has acquired excellent characteristics by using carefully selected high-precision parts.In addition, a DC servo circuit has been incorporated and coupling capacitors have been eliminated to improve sound purity.The power supply unit is a twin power supply consisting of a LASER transformer with ultra-low leakage flux characteristics that suppresses leakage so that the flux leaked from the transformer does not pollute the music signal. The transformer is installed separately for the head amplifier and for the equalizer amplifier.In addition, the condenser is equipped with a blue condenser (development number 923), which was developed over three years to solve the difficult problem of achieving both energy sensitivity and high resolution.A 9 mm thick all-aluminum monocoque chassis is used for the front panel.By providing many ribs on the inner and outer surfaces, the rigidity of the chassis is improved and unwanted resonance is reduced. In addition, DuPont Corian, which combines rigidity and vibration control, is used for the insulator that supports the chassis.To achieve high sound quality, we have adopted a high-sound film condenser, carbon resistance, and a printed circuit board with a copper foil thickness of 70 ? m.The PIN terminal is made of a highly rigid brass ground gold plated terminal. The rear panel of this terminal is fixed rigidly with two point connections for one pair of left and right terminals. The distance between the left and right terminals is 18 mm, enabling the use of very thick PIN plugs.The muting circuit is a soft muting circuit that reduces unpleasant noise during operation, and uses a shunt type that does not affect sound quality.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAD-655NII
sections.overview: A crossover network that enables strict control such as adjustment of various characteristics in order to realize multi-channel playback that is closer to the ideal.By adopting a dual channel system with independent power supply circuits on the left and right sides, the effect of interference between channels on sound quality is prevented.The filter circuit uses a newly designed Darlington constant current load filter.In addition, all filter capacitors, including the coupling, use film capacitors with an extended foil structure that have little effect on sound quality.A transient killer circuit using a lead relay prevents a click when the switch is ON/OFF.The cutoff frequency can be independently variable for both high cut and low cut.Each filter has eight built-in frequencies in increments of 1/2 octave, and also has two additional frequency reserve positions (AUX) that allow you to incorporate elements of any value.The slope characteristics can be independently switched to 2 stages of 12dB/oct. and 6dB/oct.When the attenuation slope is 12dB/oct., the damping coefficient can be switched in 4 stages from 0.7 to 1.0.This allows you to change the shoulder characteristics and make subtle adjustments at the crossover point.The level can be adjusted up to -20.5 dB in 0.5 dB steps using a precision trimming 43 contact attenuator for each band.

sections.title: ONKYO FRX20
sections.overview: A 20 cm cone type full range unit that uses specially molded 2-layer urethane edge and elliptical cone technology.A newly developed special elliptical cone is used for the diaphragm.This diaphragm uses a composite curve calculated using a computer to suppress peaks and dips in the middle and high frequencies, which are the most problematic in the large diameter full range. The edge and center are perfectly round, but the curvature differs in the longitudinal direction and the lateral direction, and the intermediate section is shaped to be an ellipse. This allows the rigidity of the cone to change from the center to the outer circumference, dispersing and canceling the modes of divided vibration generated in the high frequencies.Together with carefully selected materials, it achieves flat characteristics in the main band from 40 hz to 9 khz.A dome containing carbon fiber with high density is adopted for the cap at the center of the cone, and it is used as a radiator for the band of 9 kHz or more.This radiator is formed into a dome shape with an ultra-thin plastic film sandwiched between two carbon fiber plates with a mixing ratio of more than 80%. Compared corn with a high pulp content, this radiator has greater rigidity (more than 20 times that of duralumin) and superior internal loss due to the use of plastic film.This realizes excellent high-frequency response and transient characteristics.Specially molded 2-layer urethane edge is used for the edge part.Two types of urethane foam with different physical properties are bonded together at a ratio of 3 : 5. The upper layer is an ester-based single-bubble type and the lower layer is an ether-based continuous-bubble type. The foam is then molded into a special shape that gradually decreases in density from the cone side to the frame side.As a result, it has a linear response to the strong motion of the cone of the Oshin woman, and realizes flat characteristics while suppressing non-linear distortion.The magnetic circuit uses a large Alnico magnet of 55   x35mm and a round yoke of 10 mm or more in thickness with low magnetic resistance.A copper cap is attached to the center pole to reduce strain and prevent impedance rise in the middle and high range, and the top plate is thinner inside to improve the magnetic flux density and to make the magnetic flux distribution symmetrical.

It realizes a natural sound with low distortion and good articulation as well as high power and high efficiency.A super hard titanium diaphragm is used as a radiator for the center dome in the center of the cone.Titanium has much higher hardness than aluminum and duralumin, and also has excellent resistance against continuous pulsating vibration, greatly improving strain rate and transient characteristics.In addition, by molding it into a small-diameter dome with a diameter of 25 mm, smooth response in the high-frequency range and wide directional characteristics are realized.
