sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-701XD
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier based on Integra A-817XD equipped with D/A converterThe D/A converter employs an 18-bit super-real D/A converter that is independent on the left and right sides. The resolution is four times higher than that of the 16-bit D/A converter, and the distortion factor and S/N ratio are greatly improved.In addition, although only the heaviest bit (1 bit) is usually adjusted, the A-701XD performs adjustment of 4 bits each on the right and left sides for all models, realizing more accurate D/A conversion.The digital filter uses an 8-times oversampling digital filter.The DAC part is perfectly protected by a shield case.Equipped with a DAC direct switch that passes the analog filter, you can select ON/OFF of the low-pass filter.Unlike conventional power supplies, we have developed a supercharger circuit that can continuously charge the Chemi-Con is mounted on both the + side and - side.The supercharger does not have ripple fluctuations of 100Hz/120Hz. Moreover, since the charging current is controlled while monitoring the power supply voltage, there is almost no fluctuation in the power supply voltage. The stability is comparable to that of a large-capacity power supply with a transparent capacitance of approximately 300 times.A photovoltaic element is mounted in the differential amplifier section at the first stage of the power amplifier section, and a newly developed optical drive amplifier that amplifies by light energy is adopted.This dramatically stabilizes the reference voltage, which previously fluctuated unstably due to the influence of the speaker drive current or ripple, and enables highly stable amplification.The bottom chassis is made of 2 mm thick steel plate, twice as thick as conventional ones, and the chassis thickness other than the bottom is increased by 20%, making the whole chassis more rigid.In addition, a double-structure insulator made of copper plate and cork material is used in the leg part to suppress vibration propagation from the floor surface. The cork material used in this insulator changes the area between the power supply side with transformer load and the circuit side with less load in consideration of load distribution.The power supply section and circuit section are separated by a 2-box chassis structure, and the circuit section is further separated into a voltage amplification stage for handling very small signals and a power stage for handling large outputs. Therefore, a U-shaped heat sink is, and electromagnetic coupling is cut off by a closed loop with this heat sink as a wall.In this heat sink, heat radiation fins are arranged independently on the right and left sides, and the length of the fins is unequal between 14 mm and 18 mm to disperse resonance.In the power supply section, two 10-mm-thick stabilizers are mounted on the core of the heavy power transformer in a sandwich structure from both sides to control the power transformer, which is the source of vibration inside the amplifier.In addition, a special rubber insulator is used in the lower part of the transformer to reduce vibration propagation to the chassis.The power supply Chemi-Con employs a twin-roll Chemi-Con with two pairs of positive and negative foils wound around it, and the internal resistance (ESR) is reduced to approximately one third of the impedance of conventional Chemi-Con.The rectifier diode is a high-speed diode whose response time (reverse recovery time) is less than 1/10 of that of conventional products.A gold-plated pin jack is used for the CD input, and a large vise type is used for the speaker terminal.Also, very thick AC cord with polarity display, H-shaped copper bus plate for power supply part, 8 square copper bus plate for power amplifier part, high-fTPc200W 2-point stop type power transistor is adopted.The volume is a 4-series detent type with 7 multi-brushes.Equipped with a source direct switch that sends all sources directly to the power amplifier via a dedicated volume.When this switch is set to the TONE position, it can be adjusted by direct tone. When it is set to the Processor & Tone position, it can be used to control the connected external Gray.Equipped with video input / output terminal.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-701XG
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with built-in D/A converter that adopts BI-MOS drive amplifier.It is an optical / coaxial digital amplifier with an analog base of A-817XG and an 18-bit optical D/A converter protected by a shield case.In the D/A converter section, real 18-bit D/A converters are mounted independently on the left and right sides.In addition, in order to achieve excellent linearity during reproduction of a small signal, the ACCU BIT4The system is installed, and the error of ladder network which slightly occurs is adjusted for upper 4 bits of right and left respectively.This improves the linearity for small signals.It uses a 2 PLL digital interface demodulation circuit that reliably captures digital input signals and reduces distortion on the time axis of analog output, and an 8 x oversampling digital filter that cuts noise components.In addition, the digital circuit is shielded with a pure copper shield case to suppress noise emission to the analog section.The digital input coaxial automatic switching circuits are used for digital input, and a coaxial Route 3, two optical input systems, and digital out (coaxial) are installed.The sampling frequency can be confirmed by the 32/44.1/48kHz digital lock indicator.The digital part is equipped with an auto digital OFF circuit that shuts off the digital noise by turning off the power to suppress the digital noise when the digital input is not heard.The BI-MOS drive amplifier has an output stage for each of a MOS FET and a bipolar transistor, and drives a speaker by both of them. As the input voltage increases, the MOS FET rises first and then the bipolar transistor rises.As a result, the BI-MOS composite characteristic shows the characteristic of the gentle rise curve of the MOS FET in the small current region, and the characteristic of the stretch and linear characteristic of the bipolar transistor becomes dominant in the large current region.As a result, the overall + / - characteristics are very close to a straight line in the crossover region, and excellent linearity characteristics with elongation even in the large amplitude region are realized.We have developed and adopted a laser transformer to prevent the power transformer from generating magnetic leakage flux and harmful noise caused by magnetic induction in the amplifier circuit.This laser transformer uses a new type of EI core with a wider outer circumference than the standard one. This reduces the magnetic resistance of the outer circumference and makes it difficult for magnetic flux to leak from the core.In addition, the area around the core is carefully shielded with silicon steel shielding material, and the area around the coil is also shielded to prevent flux leakage.As a result, the leakage flux is reduced to 1 / 20 compared with the conventional EI transformer.It comes standard with a wireless remote control that controls the input selector and volume at hand.In addition, it uses a motor-driven mechanical system to suppress the occurrence of non-linear distortion like semiconductor switches and to prevent adverse effects on sound quality.The video input / output jacks are installed Route 3 to enable Iori, recording, playback and BGV playback.An optical drive and a current converter are used in the differential amplifier circuit at the first stage of the power amplifier circuit to obtain a stable reference voltage without fluctuation from the light energy produced by the photovoltaic element.A voltage / current (V-I) conversion circuit using an operational amplifier generates a constant current and drives a differential amplifier circuit.This suppresses unstable operation caused by fluctuation components due to music signals and power supply ripple fluctuations.In order to eliminate interference between each stage and to realize pure signal transmission without causing unnecessary current to flow in the ground line between stages, the secondary winding of the power transformer is separated into power amplifier, EQ amplifier, microcomputer, D/A converter, etc.The input, voltage amplification section and power amplification section are separated by sandwiching a heat sink. In addition, the power supply section and microcomputer section are also independent and shielded, and block separation construction is adopted which completely eliminates mutual interference.In order to reproduce all music signals with high purity, it is equipped with a source direct switch that sends the source directly to the power amplifier via a dedicated volume.When the position is set to TONE, it can be adjusted by direct tone, and when the position is set to Processor-TONE, it can be controlled by an external device such as a connected Gray.The power supply Chemi-Con employs a large capacity, low impedance twin-roll Chemi-Con and high-speed diodes for all power supply rectifier diodes.In addition, we use carefully selected parts such as die-cast detent type volume, gold-plated pin jack, large speaker terminal, and AC cord with polarity display.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-810
sections.overview: This is a W super type stereo pre-main amplifier.The W / Super Servo system is used to solve the effects on sound quality due to noise components caused by DC leakage to the output and power source impedance in the power amplifier section.The MC-compatible equalizer amplifier also incorporates a super servo system for ultra-low-frequency cut.It uses a linear switching method that improves the linearity of circuit operation without changing bias at all and suppresses crossover distortion.It is a class B operation in which two power transistors are used to divide and amplify the waveform, but by adopting a special correction circuit, crossover distortion that tends to occur at the junction of the waveform is suppressed.Furthermore, High f is also applied to switching distortion.TThe 3-stage Darlington configuration of the power transistor and the double push-pull method have succeeded in removing it from the audible band.MC-MM compatible, variable gain equalizers, and high-gain power amplifiers are the only two amplifiers used.The equalizer amplifier is designed to improve S/N and high gain by developing a non-click capacitorless NF constant conversion method using a current conversion super servo method that does not require a head amplifier or step-up transformer when using an MC cart, and by using a 3-stage differential amplifier with excellent bare characteristics.The power amplifier based on the W / Super Servo system achieves a wide dynamic range and low distortion factor by increasing its gain by 20 dB and omitting the tone amplifier.In addition to the tone control, which simply varies the sound pressure in the low and high ranges, it is equipped with a softness circuit that can select three different tone characters.A large twin-winded power transformer is used for the power supply section, and the Chemi-Con for rectification uses a multi-tab type low-impedance wide-range Chemi-Con as a low-inductance circuit directly connected to a printed circuit board in pursuit of the correlation between careful hearing and material properties.In addition, hot copper bus lines are used for the power supply / distribution and ground lines of each section to ensure low impedance.Uses a direct tone system that eliminates the sound quality degradation caused by tone amplifiers.Uses an auto tracking bias system that detects the temperature difference of each part and enables always stable low distortion rate drive.In order to suppress the generation of higher harmonics, a non-magnetic material is used to give priority to sound quality.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-815
sections.overview: Cost-performance machine that adopts W / Super Servo system, dual direct amplifier system, etc.The W / Super Servo system is adopted in which all components caused by the inside of the amplifier are canceled by the feedback loop of the servo operational amplifier separately provided.As a result, harmful components such as ultra-low frequency components below 1 to 2 Hz and noise electromotive force due to impedance caused by power supply capacitors, ground patterns, wiring, etc. are canceled, and the purity of the input music signal is increased.The A-815 uses a linear switching method for amplification.Although the basic operating characteristics of this system are high efficiency class B, the amplification part of the two transistors is made smooth, and harmful crossover distortion hardly occurs. Thus, the system has operating characteristics equivalent to class A.Compatible with MC cartridges. In addition to the head amplifier and step-up transformer, it is equipped with a straight equalizer amplifier designed mainly for MC.In addition, the tone circuit and buffer amplifier are omitted, and a 2-amplifier configuration is used for direct input to a high-gain power amplifier, giving priority to sound quality.It is equipped with accessory circuits such as a 5-stage mode selector, a subsonic filter that cuts low frequencies below 15 kHz, a high-cut filter connected directly to the Treble control, a loudness switch, and a 2-channel speaker selector switch.It uses a direct tone system composed only of passive elements.In order to avoid high-order harmonic distortion, we use non-ferrous metals instead of magnetic materials such as iron for mechanical parts.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-815D
sections.overview: A stereo pre-main amplifier that adopts the W super servo system.In the W Super Servo system, all components originated in the amplifier are canceled by the feedback loop of the servo operational amplifier separately provided.As a result, harmful components are skillfully cancelled and only the incoming music signal is transmitted in high purity.Linear switching method is adopted for power amplification at the final output stage.Although the basic operating characteristics of this system are highly efficient class B, it has the same operating characteristics as class A because it smooths the amplification part of the two transistors and does not generate harmful crossover distortion.In order to support MC cartridges, it is equipped with a straight equalizer amplifier with MC as the main element, rather than a simple head amplifier or step-up transformer.In addition, the quality of the MM cart has been upgraded accordingly.In addition, the tone circuit and buffer amplifier are omitted, and a 2-amplifier configuration is used for direct input to a high-gain power amplifier, giving priority to sound quality.It is equipped with a direct-tone tone control consisting only of passive elements that have little effect on sound.We aim to achieve purer waveform transmission by using non-ferrous metals in the main parts of the mechanical components to suppress harmonic distortion.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-815GT
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier that uses Onkyo's proprietary Super Servo Integral technology.In the Super Servo Integral Method, in addition to the W / Super Servo method, which suppresses noise components that cause distortion due to harmful ultra-low frequencies and power source impedance by the servomechanism applied to the + - poles of the output side, the electromotive force of the speaker caused by external factors such as other channel signals with time lag is corrected by a special method for the linearity of the output stage, so that harmful time difference distortion does not occur.Linear switching method is adopted for the output stage.As a result, the basic operating characteristics are equivalent to those of Class A amplification, which generates almost no harmful crossover distortion due to a special correction circuit, while efficiently performing Class B amplification.It is compatible with MC cartridges, and in order to perform high-quality MC playback, it is equipped with a high-gain straight equalizer amplifier instead of a head amplifier or booster transformer.In addition, by eliminating the tone amplifier and buffer amplifier and adopting a 2-amplifier configuration with direct input to a high-gain power amplifier, the circuit becomes simpler and higher sound quality is achieved.In addition to simplifying the circuit by eliminating the tone amplifier, a direct tone system is adopted that eliminates the need for tone defeat.It is composed of only passive elements without using active elements that affect sound quality. It is considered as a means to freely create desired sound quality from mere accessories of tone control.The shielding materials for the circuit and other necessary parts are made of non-magnetic materials such as copper, brass and aluminum, avoiding the use of iron materials.This prevents the magnetic flux generated from the circuit from generating harmful harmonics due to the non-linear characteristics of the magnetic path, thereby degrading the sound.We have also examined the resistors used in parts from the aspect of sound quality, and newly developed resistors with improved sound quality are used for circuits that are important for sound quality.In addition to excellent frequency characteristics and distortion characteristics, the conductive coating layer is intended to make the charge distribution uniform and improve magnetic characteristics, and plays an important role in sound quality.It is equipped with a protection circuit that uses a high-speed relay to shut down the circuit when there is a DC leak in the speaker circuit.Equipped with accessories such as various filters, muting, loudness, etc.When a deck is connected to the REC output terminal, the recording signal always flows out. Therefore, even when recording is not performed, a recording switch is installed to prevent the recording signal from entering part of the circuit of the deck.In addition, it is equipped with a function for recording back-channel programs such as recording the output of a tuner while enjoying a recording performance.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-815GTR
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier equipped with a super servo integral system and a delta turbo power supply.We have developed and adopted the Delta Turbo Power Supply in order to obtain an effect close to the ideal power supply in the same size as the conventional one.This reduces the generation of special intermodulation distortion in the power supply section, which adversely affects sound quality, by -20dB compared to conventional power supplies.Super Servo Integral System is adopted in the amplifier section.The electromotive force induced in the speaker by external factors such as sound pressure emitted from the reverse channel speaker is directly fed back to the amplifier by the microphone effect of the speaker. This electromotive force with a time difference as much as the sound travels through the space causes time difference distortion due to the linearity of the output stage of the amplifier.This problem is reduced by a special linearity correction circuit compared with the conventional one.In addition, the servo mechanism applied to the + - pole of the output side of the amplifier reduces harmful ultra-low frequency components and noise components that cause distortion due to the total impedance of the power supply.In order to make the most of the performance of the MC cartridge, the GTR Series is equipped with a high-gain straight equalizer amplifier, which is designed mainly for high-quality MC playback, rather than merely adding a head amplifier or booster transformer.In addition, the purity of sound is improved by a complete two amplifier configuration in which the tone amplifier and buffer amplifier are omitted and input directly to the high-gain power amplifier.In addition, the final stage of the equalizer amplifier is class A push-pull so that the signal can be sent to the next stage with low distortion to cope with heavy loads in the high frequency range.In addition, we examined the bare characteristics of both the equalizer and power to improve the overall linearity and adopt a low feedback system that is also effective in terms of audibility.It uses a direct tone method which is an original tone control.Since the tone amplifier, which had many problems in sound quality, is omitted and the tone is changed by using the loudness circuit related to volume control, the circuit is composed only of passive elements which have no problems in sound quality.This reduces variations in sound quality.Linear switching method is adopted for operation of output transistor.There is no difference from class B in that two transistors are used, but the linearity of the joint of the operation curve, which is a problem, is corrected by a unique bias circuit to obtain always linear operation characteristics as a whole.As a result, the crossover distortion is equivalent to class A amplification and the efficiency is class B.High fTThe use of power transistors keeps switching distortion within a negligible range.In addition to the shielding material of the circuit, all necessary parts are made of non-magnetic materials such as copper, brass and aluminum, avoiding the use of magnetic materials such as iron.MC1 and MM1 cartridge selectors are installed in order to obtain the best matching.All models are fully equipped with 5 levels of mode switching (Norm, Rev, R + L, L, R).Special noise-improving resistors with excellent frequency and distortion characteristics are used for important circuits.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-815RS
sections.overview: RS series pre-main amplifier using super turbo system originally developed by Onkyo.In the Super Turbo system, the dynamic dynamic range is expanded by more than 20 dB by the function of the delta turbo circuit and turbo filter. In addition, noise components that enter the AC line from outside the amplifier are cut off, and the effect of the polarity of the AC power plug on sound quality is also reduced.In order to reduce interference between the left and right channels, a super servo integral system is adopted.An electromotive force is induced in the speaker by the sound pressure emitted from the speaker on the reverse channel. This force flows into the output stage of the amplifier and causes time difference distortion, which is reduced by a special linearity correction circuit.The servo circuit applied to both poles of the output side of the amplifier suppresses noise to less than -40dB, which causes distortion due to harmful ultra-low frequency components and total impedance of the power supply.The MC straight equalizer and power amplifier are all part of the simple design. The equalizer amplifier is a high-gain design for MC cartridges.The Direct Tone Control method is used for tone control.Since the tone amplifier, which had many problems in sound quality, is omitted and the tone is changed by using the loudness circuit related to volume control, the circuit configuration can be made only with passive elements which have no problem in sound quality.Onkyo has adopted a linear switching system originally developed by Onkyo. By using a special linearity correction circuit, the crossover characteristics equal to those of class A can be obtained with high efficiency class B amplification.The chassis uses non-magnetic parts that do not affect sound quality.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-815RX
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier of the RX series that employs a double sensing servo system.In the double sensing servo system, in addition to the conventional negative feedback, servo feedback is applied to the input side of the amplifier through the servo amplifier from both the + terminal and - terminal of the speaker.The servo on the + side cuts out harmful noise components at very low frequencies, and the servo on the - side cancels out distortion and noise components caused by electromotive force in the impedance of the earth line, and controls the - terminal of the speaker precisely.This makes it possible to drive accurately not only the + terminal but also the - terminal of the speaker.It uses a simple two amplifier configuration with only an equalizer amplifier and a power amplifier section with a double sensing servo system. Moreover, it uses a unique direct tone system that does not require a tone amplifier to increase the purity of the sound.Each of the two tape jacks has an independent recording selector. You can record completely different signals using Tape1 and Tape2, or use a deck and a graphic equalizer for equalization recording.In addition, since the recording selector is equipped with an off position, the deck recording terminal can be completely disconnected from the signal system when recording is not performed.In order to improve the low impedance capability, the power supply part is strengthened and parallel connection power transistor is adopted.A charge noise filter is installed to reduce power supply noise.It employs a linear switching system originally developed by ONKYO, and the crossover distortion is reduced by a special linearity correction circuit applied to the power stage.In addition, switching distortion is improved by the adoption of high-ft power transistor.The equalizer amplifier section uses a high-gain equalizer amplifier for low-impedance MC cartridges.There are 2 color variations, black and silver.

sections.overview: This is a real-phase <digital> amplifier that verifies the effect of digital signals on the amplifier and takes full-scale measures for digital signals.The Real Phase <Digital> amplifier uses two in-phase transformers, an input in-phase transformer and a power in-phase transformer, to prevent external noise from entering the amplifier circuit.In addition, a charge noise filter is used to eliminate normal mode noise that is superimposed on home AC lines and enters by microwave ovens and other high-frequency equipment.The input-in-phase transformer prevents common-mode noise from the ground line of the other device when connected to the amplifier. This transformer is connected between hot and ground in the input circuit and eliminates noise without affecting the music signal.The power-in-phase transformer eliminates common-mode noise from the AC line and cancels the noise that enters the amplifier circuit from the secondary side of the power transformer. The power-in-phase transformer also cancels the phase shift signal that occurs when a speaker is connected, and helps improve the phase characteristics of the amplifier.The tone control circuit uses a volume circuit instead of a tone amplifier, and uses a direct tone system composed only of passive elements with little degradation in sound quality.In addition to the general bass and treble, it is equipped with a contrabus that boosts the band below 100 hz. It can boost only the very low band while suppressing the influence of vocals and other sounds on the mid-range.Uses a double sensing servo system that controls both + - ends of the speaker.

I.), which reduces sound field and SN sensation.This digital interference is a harmonic noise component and flows in a loop with the CD player, amplifier, power line, and CD player.The Integra A-815EX has a signal-in-phase transformer (S. I. T) in the CD input, which removes only high-frequency digital noise without affecting the music signal.In order to achieve low impedance in the power supply section, a newly developed low impedance twin roll Chemi-Con with a total capacity of 24,000 ? sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-817
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with dual direct amplifier configuration using W / Super Servo system.The W / Super Servo system is incorporated into the power amplifier and equalizer amplifier.This system feeds back only the extra noise and distortion components contained in the signal other than the music signal from both positive and negative poles of the amplifier output terminal via a servo operational circuit, and cancels the feedback. On the positive side, ultra-low frequency components due to fluctuations in the power supply generated inside the amplifier and temperature changes in semiconductors are mainly suppressed. On the negative side, the electromotive force induced by the impedance of the power supply is suppressed.Moreover, we have dramatically improved the resolution of reproduced sound by suppressing it without relying on capacitors and other devices that are problematic in terms of sound quality.Linear switching method is adopted for the transistor operation of the final stage.This method is the same as Class B in that it is amplified by two transistors, but the linearity of the joint of the operation curve, which is a problem in this case, is corrected by a special bias circuit to obtain linear operation characteristics.And High fTBy using a power transistor, the switching distortion can be suppressed to a completely negligible range.To support MC cartridge, MC straight equalizer amplifier is mounted.It has a high gain design with MC as the main role, and it can be directly connected to the equalizer without putting any extra things in between.It is also possible to switch between MC and High MC depending on the output voltage.Uses a direct tone system.In this method, as the gain of the power amplifier increases, the tone amplifier is omitted, and the tone is changed by the loudness circuit related to the volume control. Therefore, it is composed only of passive elements with no problem in sound quality, so that the change in sound quality caused by the use of tone hardly becomes a problem.Uses an auto tracking bias system that detects temperature differences in the final stage and always supplies a stable bias.Non-magnetic material is used to suppress the generation of higher harmonic waves.

sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with supercharger power supply and optical drive amplifier.Unlike conventional power supplies, we have developed a supercharger circuit that can continuously charge the Chemi-Con is mounted on both the + side and - side.The supercharger does not have ripple fluctuations of 100Hz/120Hz. Moreover, since the charging current is controlled while monitoring the power supply voltage, there is almost no fluctuation in the power supply voltage. The stability is comparable to that of a large-capacity power supply with a transparent capacitance of approximately 300 times.A photovoltaic element is mounted in the differential amplifier section at the first stage of the power amplifier section, and a newly developed optical drive amplifier that amplifies by light energy is adopted.This dramatically stabilizes the reference voltage, which previously fluctuated unstably due to the influence of the speaker drive current or ripple, and enables highly stable amplification.The bottom chassis is made of 2 mm thick steel plate, twice as thick as conventional ones, and the chassis thickness other than the bottom is increased by 20%, making the whole chassis more rigid.In addition, a double-structure insulator made of copper plate and cork material is used in the leg part to suppress vibration propagation from the floor surface. The cork material used in this insulator changes the area between the power supply side with transformer load and the circuit side with less load in consideration of load distribution.The power supply section and circuit section are separated by a 2-box chassis structure, and the circuit section is further separated into a voltage amplification stage for handling very small signals and a power stage for handling large outputs. Therefore, a U-shaped heat sink is, and electromagnetic coupling is cut off by a closed loop with this heat sink as a wall.In this heat sink, heat radiation fins are arranged independently on the right and left sides, and the length of the fins is unequal between 14 mm and 18 mm to disperse resonance.In the power supply section, two 10-mm-thick stabilizers are mounted on the core of the heavy power transformer in a sandwich structure from both sides to control the power transformer, which is the source of vibration inside the amplifier.In addition, a special rubber insulator is used in the lower part of the transformer to reduce vibration propagation to the chassis.The power supply Chemi-Con employs a twin-roll Chemi-Con with two pairs of positive and negative foils wound around it, and the internal resistance (ESR) is reduced to approximately one third of the impedance of conventional Chemi-Con.The rectifier diode is a high-speed diode whose response time (reverse recovery time) is less than 1/10 of that of conventional products.A gold-plated pin jack is used for the CD input, and a large vise type is used for the speaker terminal.Also, very thick AC cord with polarity display, H-shaped copper bus plate for power supply part, 8 square copper bus plate for power amplifier part, high-fTPc200W 2-point stop type power transistor is adopted.Equipped with a source direct switch that sends all sources directly to the power amplifier via a dedicated volume.When this switch is set to the TONE position, it can be adjusted by direct tone. When it is set to the Processor & Tone position, it can be used to control the connected external Gray.Equipped with video input / output terminal.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-817RS
sections.overview: RS series pre-main amplifier using super turbo system originally developed by Onkyo.In the Super Turbo system, the dynamic dynamic range is expanded by more than 20 dB by the function of the delta turbo circuit and turbo filter. In addition, noise components that enter the AC line from outside the amplifier are cut off, and the effect of the polarity of the AC power plug on sound quality is also reduced.In order to reduce interference between the left and right channels, a super servo integral system is adopted.An electromotive force is induced in the speaker by the sound pressure emitted from the speaker on the reverse channel. This force flows into the output stage of the amplifier and causes time difference distortion, which is reduced by a special linearity correction circuit.The servo circuit applied to both poles of the output side of the amplifier suppresses noise to less than -40dB, which causes distortion due to harmful ultra-low frequency components and total impedance of the power supply.The MC straight equalizer and power amplifier are all part of the simple design. The equalizer amplifier is a high-gain design for MC cartridges.The Direct Tone Control method is used for tone control.Since the tone amplifier, which had many problems in sound quality, is omitted and the tone is changed by using the loudness circuit related to volume control, the circuit configuration can be made only with passive elements which have no problem in sound quality.Onkyo has adopted a linear switching system originally developed by Onkyo. By using a special linearity correction circuit, the crossover characteristics equal to those of class A can be obtained with high efficiency class B amplification.The chassis uses non-magnetic parts that do not affect sound quality.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-817RXII
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier is equipped with the same functions as the Integra A-815RXII and achieves high power.The Real Phase <Digital> amplifier uses two in-phase transformers, an input in-phase transformer and a power in-phase transformer, to prevent external noise from entering the amplifier circuit.In addition, a charge noise filter is used to eliminate normal mode noise that is superimposed on home AC lines and enters by microwave ovens and other high-frequency equipment.The input-in-phase transformer prevents common-mode noise from the ground line of the other device when connected to the amplifier. This transformer is connected between hot and ground in the input circuit and eliminates noise without affecting the music signal.The power-in-phase transformer eliminates common-mode noise from the AC line and cancels the noise that enters the amplifier circuit from the secondary side of the power transformer. The power-in-phase transformer also cancels the phase shift signal that occurs when a speaker is connected, and helps improve the phase characteristics of the amplifier.The tone control circuit uses a volume circuit instead of a tone amplifier, and uses a direct tone system composed only of passive elements with little degradation in sound quality.In addition to the general bass and treble, it is equipped with a contrabus that boosts the band below 100 hz. It can boost only the very low band while suppressing the influence of vocals and other sounds on the mid-range.Uses a double sensing servo system that controls both + - ends of the speaker.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-817XX
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier is equipped with a real-phase <digital> amplifier and a W stabilizer system to improve the quality of playback sound by increasing the linearity during low sound.In order to prevent dynamic distortion that occurs when the linearity of the power stage temporarily deteriorates when the signal level changes inside the amplifier, and acoustic distortion that occurs when the amplifier vibrates due to sound pressure from the speakers, we have adopted a new real phase <digital> amplifier configuration using the newly developed W stabilizer method.In the New Real Phase <Digital> amplifier, dynamic distortion is solved by a DD (Dynamic Distortion) stabilizer circuit, and acoustic distortion is solved by a new structure called X stabilizer.The DD stabilizer circuit detects dynamic distortion at the power stage and cancels this distortion component by subtracting it from the signal at the driver stage.In addition, the X stabilizer was created from the idea of attaching a strong base to the chassis of the amplifier itself. The X-shaped structure made of high-rigidity PbSb special alloy reduces chassis vibration.A real-phase <digital> amplifier configuration is adopted in which an in-phase transformer is added to the input terminal and power supply, which are input paths of disturbance signals from the outside.A signal-in-phase transformer (S. I. T) is installed at the input terminal and a power-in-phase transformer (P. I. T) is installed at the power supply section to guard the amplifier circuit, preventing the penetration of external noise and achieving high-purity transmission.A charge noise filter is also added to the power supply to eliminate normal mode noise that enters from the AC line.The power-in-phase transformer inserted into the power supply circuit not only eliminates common-mode noise but also eliminates the phase shift of the charging current of the power supply and transmits correct phase information.The power-in-phase transformer combines charging currents with opposite phases on the + side and - side to generate a charging current with a certain peak, and removes out-of-phase information from the charging current. This improves the driving performance of the speaker and the braking performance in the low-frequency range.In order to achieve high-purity transmission, we have taken various circuit measures, such as eliminating the contact point of the Tape Monitor switch and adopting the Rec Selector method, removing the Tone amplifier from the signal path and adopting the Direct Tone method using the center tap of the volume, and removing the Muting switch from the signal path and placing it in the Direct Tone circuit.It is equipped with a CD Direct switch. When this switch is pressed, the signal is sent directly to the dedicated 4-channel volume without passing through any contact points, which enables high-purity transmission.In order to cope with the low impedance of speakers, a powerful power supply with a margin and a power transistor connected in parallel are adopted. Even if the load temporarily changes to low impedance such as 2  , stable driving is possible.In addition to the Treble/Bass, the tone control is equipped with a Contrabass that boosts the band below approximately 100 Hz.This allows you to boost the low range without affecting the middle range of vocals.In addition, it employs a new circuit that provides a boost of up to 20 dB when muting is on. If you use the Contrabass with muting on in the middle of the night, for example, you can enjoy rich bass playback even at a low volume.Each of the Tape1rec, Tape2rec and Video Mode has an off position. When recording is not performed, the off position allows the recording system to be separated from the signal system, ensuring high-purity transmission.In order to prevent the video signal line from adversely affecting the audio signal line, a remote switching method using a relay is adopted for video signal switching. The layout is separated from the audio circuit by processing the video signal in close proximity to the pin jack.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-817EX
sections.overview: Stereo pre-main amplifier with optical drive system.The power amplifier section uses a newly developed optical drive system.In this method, the reference current of the first stage differential amplifier circuit is obtained from a photovoltaic element that generates a constant voltage when light is irradiated. By obtaining a reference current with higher accuracy than that of the conventional method, highly accurate V to I conversion is performed.In order to prevent magnetic flux from entering the amplifier circuit from the power supply part, the power supply block is separated from other circuits, and the top cover is made independent to realize a complete two box structure.Each of the two top covers is firmly attached with 6   4 mm screws to suppress vibration caused by sound pressure.Furthermore, the amplifier block is divided into a large enclosure-type heat sink, a current amplifier stage closed loop with a barrier, and a driver voltage amplifier stage, each of which is shielded to prevent electromagnetic coupling.A large heat sink is used to surround the power stage in order to cut off interference from the power stage handling large current to the voltage amplification stage processing small signals.In this enclosure-type heat sink, the radiation fins are arranged independently on the left and right, and the fins are designed to have unequal lengths to disperse resonance. In addition, a vibration control structure using a special damper is also added.The power supply section uses a large power transformer with a capacity of 250 VA and a weight of 5 kg, a twin-roll Chemicon with low impedance, and a high-speed diode with a recovery time of 1/10 of the conventional one.The Twin-Roll Chemi-Con has a structure in which two pairs of positive and negative foils are wound in one case. By connecting two pairs of foils reinforced to 2.5 times the thickness of the negative foils in parallel inside, the internal resistance is reduced to 1/3 of the impedance.In addition, a rubber type absorber is used for the transformer part to provide damping measures.In order to protect the amplifier circuit from external vibration, a special alloy hexabalance base is adopted. The chassis frame is directly mounted on this base to suppress external vibration such as floor vibration and sound pressure.In addition, the Hexa Balance Base adopts a 6-point grounding structure, and by adding two legs closer to the power supply section, we have succeeded in balancing the overall weight.In order to transmit all music signals with high purity, it is equipped with a source direct switch that sends the source directly to the power amplifier via a dedicated volume.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-817XG
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier that adopts BI-MOS drive amplifier.The BI-MOS drive amplifier has an output stage for each of a MOS FET and a bipolar transistor, and drives a speaker by both of them. As the input voltage increases, the MOS FET rises first and then the bipolar transistor rises.As a result, the BI-MOS composite characteristic shows the characteristic of the gentle rise curve of the MOS FET in the small current region, and the characteristic of the stretch and linear characteristic of the bipolar transistor becomes dominant in the large current region.As a result, the overall + / - characteristics are very close to a straight line in the crossover region, and excellent linearity characteristics with elongation even in the large amplitude region are realized.We have developed and adopted a laser transformer to prevent the power transformer from generating magnetic leakage flux and harmful noise caused by magnetic induction in the amplifier circuit.This laser transformer uses a new type of EI core with a wider outer circumference than the standard one. This reduces the magnetic resistance of the outer circumference and makes it difficult for magnetic flux to leak from the core.In addition, the area around the core is carefully shielded with silicon steel shielding material, and the area around the coil is also shielded to prevent flux leakage.As a result, the leakage flux is reduced to 1 / 20 compared with the conventional EI transformer.It comes standard with a wireless remote control that controls the input selector and volume at hand.In addition, it uses a motor-driven mechanical system to suppress the occurrence of non-linear distortion like semiconductor switches and to prevent adverse effects on sound quality.The video input / output jacks are installed Route 3 to enable Iori, recording, playback and BGV playback.An optical drive and a current converter are used in the differential amplifier circuit at the first stage of the power amplifier circuit to obtain a stable reference voltage without fluctuation from the light energy produced by the photovoltaic element.A voltage / current (V-I) conversion circuit using an operational amplifier generates a constant current and drives a differential amplifier circuit.This suppresses unstable operation caused by fluctuation components due to music signals and power supply ripple fluctuations.In order to eliminate interference between each stage and to realize pure signal transmission without causing unnecessary current to flow in the ground line between stages, the secondary winding of the power transformer is separated into power amplifier, EQ amplifier, microcomputer, etc.The input, voltage amplification section and power amplification section are separated by sandwiching a heat sink. In addition, the power supply section and microcomputer section are also independent and shielded, and block separation construction is adopted which completely eliminates mutual interference.In order to reproduce all music signals with high purity, it is equipped with a source direct switch that sends the source directly to the power amplifier via a dedicated volume.When the position is set to TONE, it can be adjusted by direct tone, and when the position is set to Processor-TONE, it can be controlled by an external device such as a connected Gray.The power supply Chemi-Con employs a large capacity, low impedance twin-roll Chemi-Con and high-speed diodes for all power supply rectifier diodes.In addition, we use carefully selected parts such as die-cast detent type volume, gold-plated pin jack, large speaker terminal, and AC cord with polarity display.

amplifier that can handle the input from the MM cartridge and the weak input from the MC cartridge.In addition, the tone amplifier and buffer amplifier are eliminated, and a two amplifier between three parts of pre-driver, driver and power transistor.Sound quality priority design using non-magnetic material to suppress the generation of higher harmonics.Equipped with a Pre Out jack sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier that uses Onkyo's proprietary Super Servo Integral technology.W ? Super Servo provides an acoustic improvement effect such as removing harmful noise components by applying servo feedback from both the + and - terminals on the output side of the amplifier to its input side.In addition, by using the Super Servo Integral Method, the electromotive force of the speaker caused by external factors such as other channel signals with time lag is corrected by a special method for the linearity of the output stage, so that harmful time difference distortion is prevented.The final output stage operates using a linear switching method.In this method, an efficient class B amplification is adopted for the operating characteristic, and a special linearity correction circuit works to suppress crossover distortion.Compatible with MC cartridges and for higher sound quality, a simple 2-amp configuration consisting of only a high-gain equalizer circuit that can be directly connected to the MC cartridge and a flat amplifier for output is adopted.Taking advantage of the characteristics of the super servo system, the equalizer amplifier is a one stage system that can be used for all types of cartridges from MM to MC by simply increasing the gain of the equalizer amplifier without using a step-up transformer for the head amplifier for MC.The last stage is class A push-pull, and it is possible to feed the signal to the next stage amplifier with low distortion without difficulty even under heavy load in high frequency range.The tone control circuit eliminates the tone amplifier to simplify the circuit, and uses Onkyo's original tone circuit to improve the sound quality.This circuit consists of only passive elements and does not use a capacitor in the signal path, which is problematic in sound quality.We have developed and adopted a new resistor with excellent frequency and strain characteristics, uniform charge distribution by conductive coating layer, improved magnetic characteristics, and examined the sound quality.In order to cope with poor quality sources, a soft circuit is provided to make it easier to listen by controlling the resolution.There is a recording selector that separates the deck from the circuit when it is not necessary and does not affect the sound quality. You can also record back-channel programs.Built-in pre-out terminal.Audio volume of special structure is adopted.

sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier equipped with a super servo integral system and a delta turbo power supply.We have developed and adopted the Delta Turbo Power Supply in order to obtain an effect close to the ideal power supply in the same size as the conventional one.This reduces the generation of special intermodulation distortion in the power supply section, which adversely affects sound quality, by -20dB compared to conventional power supplies.Super Servo Integral System is adopted in the amplifier section.The electromotive force induced in the speaker by external factors such as sound pressure emitted from the reverse channel speaker is directly fed back to the amplifier by the microphone effect of the speaker. This electromotive force with a time difference as much as the sound travels through the space causes time difference distortion due to the linearity of the output stage of the amplifier.This problem is reduced by a special linearity correction circuit compared with the conventional one.In addition, the servo mechanism applied to the + - pole of the output side of the amplifier reduces harmful ultra-low frequency components and noise components that cause distortion due to the total impedance of the power supply.In order to make the most of the performance of the MC cartridge, the GTR Series is equipped with a high-gain straight equalizer amplifier, which is designed mainly for high-quality MC playback, rather than merely adding a head amplifier or booster transformer.In addition, the purity of sound is improved by a complete two amplifier configuration in which the tone amplifier and buffer amplifier are omitted and input directly to the high-gain power amplifier.In addition, the final stage of the equalizer amplifier is class A push-pull so that the signal can be sent to the next stage with low distortion to cope with heavy loads in the high frequency range.In addition, we examined the bare characteristics of both the equalizer and power to improve the overall linearity and adopt a low feedback system that is also effective in terms of audibility.It uses a direct tone method which is an original tone control.Since the tone amplifier, which had many problems in sound quality, is omitted and the tone is changed by using the loudness circuit related to volume control, the circuit is composed only of passive elements which have no problems in sound quality.This reduces variations in sound quality.Linear switching method is adopted for operation of output transistor.There is no difference from class B in that two transistors are used, but the linearity of the joint of the operation curve, which is a problem, is corrected by a unique bias circuit to obtain always linear operation characteristics as a whole.As a result, the crossover distortion is equivalent to class A amplification and the efficiency is class B.High fTThe use of power transistors keeps switching distortion within a negligible range.In addition to the shielding material of the circuit, all necessary parts are made of non-magnetic materials such as copper, brass and aluminum, avoiding the use of magnetic materials such as iron.The cartridge selector is equipped with the MM2 system in the MC Route 3 so as to obtain the best matching.The phono input pin jack is plated with pure gold to reduce the influence of contact resistance, etc.All models are fully equipped with 5 levels of mode switching (Norm, Rev, R + L, L, R).Built-in pre-out jacks allow you to record signals controlled by various filters and tones.It is equipped with a softness switch that controls the resolution and makes it easier to quality sources.In order to prevent the sound pressure reproduced from the speakers from shaking the amplifier circuit itself and making the reproduced sound muddy due to microphonic noise, the entire chassis structure is reinforced and a special super stabilizer is attached to the main pattern to absorb vibration.Special noise-improving resistors with excellent frequency and distortion characteristics are used for important circuits.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-819RS
sections.overview: The pre-main amplifier of the RS series is fully compatible with digital sources by adopting the super turbo system.In the Super Turbo system, the power transformer, which generates harmful modulation noise components inside the amplifier, is separated from the amplifier purely electrically. This system extends the dynamic dynamic range by 20 dB.In this system, when a low audio signal of 100 Hz or less is input to the amplifier, noise caused by   imbalance in the power supply is prevented by using a delta turbo circuit, and noise caused by signal magnitude is prevented by using a turbo filter circuit.Onkyo's unique super servo integral system is adopted.This method completely eliminates intermodulation distortion that occurs when the electromotive force induced in the speaker flows into the output stage with a time lag due to external factors such as the sound pressure of other channels.In addition, servo feedback is applied to the input side from both the + and - sides of the output side of the amplifier, and harmful noise components especially at very low frequencies are cut off, and noise components generated in the impedance accumulated by various resistance components in the ground line are suppressed.In order to faithfully amplify complex music signal waveforms, a simple structure has been realized. It consists of a straight high-gain equalizer for MC and a two amplifier configuration with only the power section. The tone control circuit also uses direct tone.Direct Tone does not use a tone amplifier and is composed only of passive elements that have little effect on sound quality. It enables high quality sound without tone degradation.It is equipped with a soft circuit that controls the resolution and makes it easier to listen when connected to extremely low-grade program sources or devices such as extremely low-quality cartridges or speaker systems.In order to prevent vibration from the outside, a super stabilizer is installed as a special structural reinforcement.The power amplifier uses a linear switching method developed by Onkyo, which reduces crossover distortion by improving the linearity of the circuit operation without changing the bias. Although the operation of the circuit is class B, the sound quality is close to class A.In additionTBy using a power transistor, the effect of switching distortion is suppressed.Non-magnetic chassis is used for the main parts of the chassis to reduce the generation of harmful high-order harmonics.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-819RX
sections.overview: This is a real phase stereo pre-main amplifier with in-phase transformer to improve the phase shift.The amplifier supplies the speaker current according to the input signal (voltage). However, since the impedance changes suddenly near the fo of the speaker, a phase shift of approximately   90   occurs between the input signal and the speaker current. This out-of-phase speaker current is sent from the power supply through the current amplifier section of the amplifier. In conventional amplifiers, it affects the voltage amplifier section and disturbs the upper phase of the music signal.To solve this problem, we added Onkyo's unique power in-phase transformer to the power supply, which is the source of the speaker current, and adopted a double transformer drive system that drives with two transformers, eliminating the voltage generated by the phase shift of the speaker current.This power-in-phase transformer has a high coupling degree of K = 0.99. It combines the charge current with the opposite phase of + - and creates a charge current with a constant peak. This eliminates out-of-phase information from the charge current and transmits correct phase information.A power-in-phase transformer eliminates common-mode noise.In a power-in-phase transformer, the charging current on the positive and negative sides is at the same level with a constant peak, so no current flows between the transformer midpoint and the ground. Furthermore, the transformer midpoint is grounded, so common-mode noise is bypassed through the ground line and does not adversely affect sound quality.All the circuit technologies developed in the Integra Series have been adopted, and the quality has been improved by installing a double sensing servo system that uses a servo amplifier from both + - terminals of the speaker for servo feedback, a two amplifier configuration consisting of a high-gain equalizer and a power amplifier, and a direct tone circuit.Along with the low impedance of speakers, we have adopted a power supply with a margin and a parallel-connected power transistor so that instantaneous values of 2 to 3   will not be a problem.Equipped with a charge noise filter to block power supply noise.Uses a low-distortion linear switching system that realizes the distortion characteristics equivalent to class A.Compatible with low impedance MC cartridge.A super stabilizer is adopted to eliminate the adverse effect of external vibration.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-819XX
sections.overview: Aiming for digital reference, this pre-main amplifier is designed to improve the reproduction capability by implementing high-purity transmission through simplification of the real-phase <digital> amplifier configuration and circuit configuration.It is basically the same configuration as the A-817XX, and the output is strengthened.In order to prevent dynamic distortion that occurs when the linearity of the power stage temporarily deteriorates when the signal level changes inside the amplifier, and acoustic distortion that occurs when the amplifier vibrates due to sound pressure from the speakers, we have adopted a new real phase <digital> amplifier configuration using the newly developed W stabilizer method.In the New Real Phase <Digital> amplifier, dynamic distortion is solved by a DD (Dynamic Distortion) stabilizer circuit, and acoustic distortion is solved by a new structure called X stabilizer.The DD stabilizer circuit detects dynamic distortion at the power stage and cancels this distortion component by subtracting it from the signal at the driver stage.In addition, the X stabilizer was created from the idea of attaching a strong base to the chassis of the amplifier itself. The X-shaped structure made of high-rigidity PbSb special alloy reduces chassis vibration.A real-phase <digital> amplifier configuration is adopted in which an in-phase transformer is added to the input terminal and power supply, which are input paths of disturbance signals from the outside.A signal-in-phase transformer (S. I. T) is installed at the input terminal and a power-in-phase transformer (P. I. T) is installed at the power supply section to guard the amplifier circuit, preventing the penetration of external noise and achieving high-purity transmission.A charge noise filter is also added to the power supply to eliminate normal mode noise that enters from the AC line.The power-in-phase transformer inserted into the power supply circuit not only eliminates common-mode noise but also eliminates the phase shift of the charging current of the power supply and transmits correct phase information.The power-in-phase transformer combines charging currents with opposite phases on the + side and - side to generate a charging current with a certain peak, and removes out-of-phase information from the charging current. This improves the driving performance of the speaker and the braking performance in the low-frequency range.In order to achieve high-purity transmission, we have taken various circuit measures, such as eliminating the contact point of the Tape Monitor switch and adopting the Rec Selector method, removing the Tone amplifier from the signal path and adopting the Direct Tone method using the center tap of the volume, and removing the Muting switch from the signal path and placing it in the Direct Tone circuit.It is equipped with a CD Direct switch. When this switch is pressed, the signal is sent directly to the dedicated 4-channel volume without passing through any contact points, which enables high-purity transmission.In order to cope with the low impedance of speakers, a powerful power supply with a margin and a power transistor connected in parallel are adopted. Even if the load temporarily changes to low impedance such as 2  , stable driving is possible.In addition to the Treble/Bass, the tone control is equipped with a Contrabass that boosts the band below approximately 100 Hz.This allows you to boost the low range without affecting the middle range of vocals.In addition, it employs a new circuit that provides a boost of up to 20 dB when muting is on. If you use the Contrabass with muting on in the middle of the night, for example, you can enjoy rich bass playback even at a low volume.Each of the Tape1rec, Tape2rec and Video Mode has an off position. When recording is not performed, the off position allows the recording system to be separated from the signal system, ensuring high-purity transmission.

sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier that uses Onkyo's proprietary Super Servo Integral technology.By using the Super Servo Integral Method, the electromotive force of the speaker caused by external factors such as time-lagged signals of other channels is compensated by a special method for the linearity of the output stage, so that harmful time-difference distortion does not occur.Linear switching method is adopted for the final output stage.In this system, the basic operating characteristics are class B with two transistors, but linear operating characteristics are obtained by correcting the connection between the two operating characteristics using a special bias circuit.In addition, aiming at effective improvement of switching distortion, a high f with sufficient margin is obtained.TPower transistor is used and excellent distortion factor characteristics are obtained.It is a 2-amp configuration with only the MC-compatible straight equalizer and the power section of the super servo integral system.In order to take advantage of the excellent quality of the MC cartridge in particular, it avoids head amplifiers and step-up transformers, and uses an equalizer designed with an emphasis on the use of the MC cartridge, thus improving the sound quality when using the MM cartridge.In addition, by improving the bare characteristics of both the equalizer and power section, and by adopting a low feedback system of less than 1 / 10 of the conventional one, we have achieved the pursuit of audible quality and stable operation.In addition, in order to improve sound quality, we have adopted a tone control method using a volume-linked loudness circuit composed only of passive elements instead of the conventional method in which extra gain is always kept in preparation for tone boost.In addition to the tone control circuit, a softness circuit is installed so that two different tone characters can be selected.This circuit can be used for low-grade program sources by controlling the resolution.The power supply section is designed with sound quality in mind by adopting a twin wide type large 2-transformer system and a multi-tab type low-impedance Chemicon directly connected to a printed circuit board.Non-magnetic materials such as copper, brass, and aluminum are used for the main parts related to sound quality to suppress the influence of high order harmonics that are harmful to the auditory sense due to the nonlinear characteristics of the magnetic path.Newly developed special tone improving type resistor is adopted.Equipped with protective circuit with large capacity relay.Equipped with a pre-out terminal that can record control signals.A gold-plated pin plug has been adopted in consideration of minute current.Uses a large heat sink with excellent heat radiation effect.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-820GTR
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier equipped with a super servo integral system and a delta turbo power supply.In addition to theoretically supporting the cause of the power of large power sources, we have adopted a new circuit called "Delta Turbo Power Source," which reduces the factor that hinders the reproduction of energy sensation to about 1/10 of the conventional one.The power supply circuit of an amplifier generally consists of a transformer, a rectifier and a Chemicon for smoothing. In operation, the DC current charged in the Chemicon acts like a battery to supply power to the speakers.However, when the Chemi-Con actually operates, the impedance of the Chemi-Con varies depending on the frequency of the audio signal, so it sometimes does not work as a battery according to theory. In other words, when the frequency of the audio signal is high, the impedance becomes sufficiently low, so there is no problem. However, when the frequency of the audio signal is low, the effect of the transformer connected in parallel with the Chemi-Con appears.In other words, the distortion generated in the AC power supply on the transformer side directly affects the power circuit, and this hinders the reproduction of the low-frequency energy sense.When the capacitance of the Chemi-Con is small, the charge current fluctuates in synchronization with the audio signal, especially for low-frequency audio output when it is charged with the current, and intermodulation distortion occurs. Furthermore, for low-frequency audio signals, this distortion source is connected to the Chemi-Con and Para, so the effect will appear in the power amplifier circuit.The Delta Servo Power Supply was developed as a result of clarifying the mechanism of strain generation in the power supply as described above. The cross modulation strain generated in the power supply can be reduced to approximately 1/10 (-20dB) while the Chemi-Con and Transformer remain the same size as before.In other words, the effect equivalent to 10 times the size of the power supply circuit is obtained.Super Servo Integral System is adopted in the amplifier section.Due to external factors such as the sound pressure of other channels in the sound field, the electromotive force induced in the speaker flows into the output stage of the amplifier with a time lag equal to the propagation time of the sound wave. This causes intermodulation distortion due to non-linear characteristics of the output stage.By completely eliminating this time-difference intermodulation distortion, we have removed the veil of the playback sound field that had been squeezed between the left and right speakers.In addition, servo feedback is applied from both the + and - terminals on the output side of the amplifier to its input side to cut out harmful noise components, especially at very low frequencies, and to suppress noise components, which are the basis of distortion generated in the impedance accumulated by a very small amount of various resistances in the ground line.It uses a straight high-gain equalizer for MC and a 2-amp configuration with only the power section. Both of them have improved naked characteristics and a low feedback system of less than 1/10 of the conventional system, which ensures improved hearing quality and stable operation.As for the tone circuit, in place of the method of always keeping extra gain in preparation for tone boost, a direct tone composed only of passive elements which have little effect on tone quality is adopted, so that you can enjoy better tone quality without tone defeat.It is equipped with a softness switch that can change the resolution and control the character of sound according to the quality of the input program source.For example, it makes sound easier to hear when combined with low-grade sources such as AM broadcasting, or extremely unique cartridges or speakers.In order to prevent the amplifier circuit board itself from being shaken by the air vibration caused by the reproduced sound, generating microphonic noise and making the reproduced sound muddy, super stabilizer is used as a special structural reinforcement material.It uses Onkyo's original linear switching system, and has low distortion rate comparable to class A and high efficiency of class B.Non-magnetic material is used to suppress generation of harmful high-order harmonics.Built-in protection circuit.Pure gold plated input / output terminals are used.Uses a special noise-improving resistor.

Although the operation of the circuit is class B, the sound quality is close to class A.In additionTBy using a power transistor, the effect of switching distortion is suppressed.Non-magnetic chassis is used for the main parts of the chassis to reduce the generation of harmful high-order harmonics.The A-820RS uses a large complete 2-transformer system.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-2001
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier that combines a high-purity amplifier circuit with a simple transmission circuit, and also incorporates a D/A converter.The power amplifier section uses a newly developed optical drive system.In this method, the reference current of the first stage differential amplifier circuit is obtained from a photovoltaic element that generates a constant voltage when light is irradiated. By obtaining a reference current with higher accuracy than that of the conventional method, highly accurate V to I conversion is performed.In the final stage of the power block, a parallel push-pull system composed of four large output transistors with a collector loss of 150W is adopted to realize an output with a margin.To prevent interference between analog and digital circuits in the power supply section, a dedicated power transformer is used for digital circuits, and a super-large power transformer with windings for each secondary side Line 5 is installed for analog circuits.The rectifier and smoothing circuit employs eight low-impedance twin-roll Chemi-Cons (96,000 ? F) with a resistance value one third of that of conventional ones, and a high-speed rectifier diode with a fast recovery time to provide a stable current supply.In order to prevent adverse effects of vibration, we have adopted a high carbon steel rigid chassis with high density, high mass and excellent vibration resolution capability. All components such as power transformers and amplifier circuit boards are mounted on this base.This chassis has a 6-point mounting structure that ensures a stable setting by balancing the weight of the Integra A-2001.In order to prevent distortion due to mutual interference of each circuit, four block complete separate construction is adopted.The power supply block is placed at the end of the box and completely separated by a shield plate. Furthermore, the light-driven D/A converter and the digital processing circuit are each enclosed in an electromagnetically shielded copper-plated case and separated on the opposite side from the power supply.The digital circuit is equipped with a newly developed real 18-bit optically driven twin D/A converter.

sections.title: ONKYO D-77FX
sections.overview: A bookshelf type speaker system equipped with a MID4 concept bio-cross cone unit and SH horn.The MID4 concept is an idea that focuses on vocal expression, and by covering four octaves from 120 Hz to 2000 Hz with one unit, music can be played without failure.A 27 cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.High internal loss type pure cross carbon is used for the diaphragm, and the unique resonance dispersion structure realizes deep low sound reproduction.In addition, both the diaphragm and edge have been reduced by 15%.16 cm cone type skoker is used for the middle area.In order to cover four octaves from 120 Hz to 2000 Hz, which is the main band of vocals, with one unit, the diaphragm has a balanced 16 cm diameter. In addition, we have developed and adopted an ultra-lightweight (2.6g) adopted an ultra-lightweight (g) been developed and is used for the diaphragm.Biochloroscone is a mixture of wood pulp produced in high latitudes near the Arctic and refined cellulose, which is highly crystalline among natural cellulose. As a result of the formation of the paper layer network by integrating these two types of cellulose, the confidentiality is improved.For the high-frequency band, we have adopted the SH horn (SH horn), which was developed when the Grand Scepter GS-1 was designed, as a prototype model, and the SH horn tweeter, which was developed by taking advantage of the know-how of the SH horn.The change of Horn cross-section is determined by hyperbolic function, and the change of shape is determined by superelliptic function including oblate function and shape function by solving simultaneous equations.In addition, we have taken thorough measures to eliminate multipath ghost distortion, which is a problem in horn sound quality, in terms of horn shape and structure.In addition, the gap adjustment between the diaphragm and phase plug, which is an important factor determining the sound quality of the horn type, is designed to make the gap as narrow as possible. We have developed our own new technology to achieve more stable performance, and have achieved mass production of high-precision horns.This new technology improves the accuracy of the height and shape of the diaphragm by the ultra-precision press method and streamlines the manufacturing process by using the slide-type pole piece. This makes it possible to control the total number with high accuracy and narrow gap.Each unit is provided with anti-magnetic measures using a cancel magnet to suppress leakage flux.This prevents the influence of magnetic fields on the choke coils in the network and protects cathode ray tubes and other objects.In the network section, the circuit board for each unit is divided, and all parts that need to be divided up into circuits and parts are divided to create a high-purity network with no interference and little distortion.The enclosure uses an acoustic wave regulator consisting of a slit and a chamber to suppress standing waves. This reduces the frequency band that is necessary when sound absorbing materials are used frequently. This reduces the low-frequency response and noise that is difficult to pass through.In addition, in order to prevent the reflection and diffraction at the edge angle and the unevenness of the front baffle, the baffle surface is flattened except for the projection such as emblem and controller, and a large round of 40 mm is provided on both sides.In order to improve the overall sound quality when installed in a listening room, the speaker stand is designed with high rigidity and no resonance.It is made of a hard board that secures the same strength as D-77FX, and uses a single-leg structure that does not generate standing waves.In addition, you can fine-tune the height of the rear two of the four bottom points for flat and non-rattling settings even on slightly uneven floors.
