sections.title: ONKYO D-77FXII
sections.overview: A speaker system that further advanced the MID4 concept as an improved version of the D-77FX.To further promote the MID4 concept, both Woofer and Skoker cover a cutoff frequency of 2000 Hz, eliminating crossover from vocals and formant frequencies.Combining the advantages of a large-diameter woofer, which is advantageous for dynamic low-range playback, and a small-diameter squaker, which is advantageous for cross directivity, it realizes powerful vocal playback and crisp low-range playback.For the low range, a 27 cm cone-shaped woofer with a bicycloscone diaphragm is used.Biochloroscone is a mixture of wood pulp produced in high latitudes near the Arctic and refined cellulose, which is highly crystalline among natural cellulose. By integrating these two types of cellulose to form a paper layer network, physical properties with a balance of rigidity and confidentiality are obtained.The middle area uses a 16 cm cone type squaker made of the same bio black cone as the woofer.For the high-frequency band, we adopted the SH horn tweeter developed by taking advantage of the know-how of the Super Hypervolic Horn (SH (SH Horn) developed in the Ground Receptor GS-1.The change in Horn cross section is determined by hyperbolic function, and the change in shape is determined by superelliptic function including oblate function and shape function, by solving these simultaneous equations.We have also taken thorough measures to eliminate multipath ghost distortion, which is a problem in horn sound quality, from the aspects of horn shape and structure.In addition, Onkyo has developed its own technology for mass production of horns, such as the ultra-precision press method that improves the accuracy of the height and shape of the diaphragm, and the manufacturing process that uses the slide type pole piece to achieve matching between a narrow gap, ultra-precision driver section and an SH horn with a cutoff frequency of 1000 Hz, thus realizing the high transient and power linearity inherent in horns.The diaphragm is made of aluminum and magnesium alloy, which is lightweight and has a high internal loss, in order to obtain more natural sound quality.M.D. C.T. (Magnetic Distortion Cancel Technology) has been introduced, and the Skoker and Tweeter are equipped with copper rings, while the Woofer is equipped with aluminum rings to reduce harmonic distortion.Also, a new and large magnetic circuit is used.In addition, a canceling magnet is used to suppress magnetic flux leakage and prevent magnetic field effects on the choke coil in the network. At the same time, the canceling magnet prevents interference with the cathode ray tube during layout.The network is designed with attention paid to the smooth connection of units at the same time. The circuit board for each unit is divided, and all parts that need to be divided including circuits and parts are divided, so that the network has no mutual interference and little distortion.The enclosure employs an acoustic wave regulator composed of a slit and a chamber as a standing wave countermeasure, and the use of sound absorbing material is minimized so as not to affect other necessary frequency ranges.In addition, specially selected high-density particleboards are used to reduce vibration of the enclosure, and mechanical strength is increased by reinforcing the angle block, the center of the front baffle and the top plate.In order to improve the sound quality when installed in the listening room, the special speaker stand (sold separately) is also designed with high rigidity and no resonance. It uses a single-leg structure that does not generate standing waves and is made of hard particle board with the same strength as the D-77FXII body.You can also fine-tune the height of the two rear points out of the four front points for flat and steady settings on uneven floors.

sections.title: ONKYO D-77RX
sections.overview: This speaker system was created based on the development concept of "powerful and emotional vocals" which wants to reproduce at the same time the strong sense of scale inherent in 3 ways and the depth of musical expression that gently speaks.In order to prevent phase rotation due to crossover in the important band of music, both Woofer and midrange are covered up to the cutoff frequency of 2300 Hz, eliminating the fundamental sound of vocals and formant frequency crossover.A 30 cm bio black cone unit is used for the low range.In addition, it uses a direct wiring method that sends music signals directly to the unit.To cover 4 octaves from 120 Hz to 2000 Hz in the middle range, it is equipped with a proven 16 cm aperture unit.In order to match the low-frequency range, a lightweight Bio-Croscone diaphragm is used. This diaphragm satisfies the requirements of light weight, high rigidity, high internal loss, and high airtightness by producing and mixing ascidian cellulose, which has the highest crystallinity among natural cellulose, with wood pulp produced in the high latitude region near the Arctic.The adoption of the short voice coil, which further advanced the concept of MDCT, was designed by increasing the size of the magnetic circuit so that the voice coil can always be oscillated in a uniform magnetic flux density. Compared to the general long voice coil, the voice coil has less distortion, and the differential operates under a constant electromagnetic brake, thus realizing sound with less distortion and high resolution.A 2.5 cm dome type unit is adopted for the high-frequency band.The diaphragm is made of an aluminum-magnesium alloy in which the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin are integrated, and has succeeded in reducing the weight by approximately 25% compared with the conventional tweeter.In addition, by using copper short ring, which is also an MDCT technology, the impedance rise at high frequencies, which is harmful to sound quality caused by AC magnetic flux, is suppressed. It is compatible with high-sampling digital sources, and reproduction is possible up to 40 kHz.For the network, we have succeeded in simple circuit configuration such as direct wiring of woofer to eliminate mounting reciprocal induction by dividing parts by band of each unit, and to avoid phase distortion caused by using complicated network circuit.A high-density particle board is used for the enclosure, and the structural strength is increased by soundbars and reinforcement materials to suppress unnecessary vibration.In addition, the front baffle is made of high-altitude, high-quality softwood medium density fiberboard.In addition, consideration is given to minimizing the use of sound absorbing material so as not to affect the necessary frequency range which influences the tone color.The terminal section has a banana plug compatible gold-plated brass scraping terminal.It is installed directly on the back plate, looking for a place with high strength and less susceptible to vibration.A special speaker stand is sold separately.This stand uses hard-textured, crisp softwood MDF to enhance overall sound quality.In addition, it has a structure that eliminates standing waves generated by vibrations at the bottom of the speaker.

sections.title: ONKYO D-77FRX
sections.overview:
65,000 (1 unit, sold on September 25, 1996)

Bookshelf speaker system, 9th generation of 77 seriesA 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm is made from North American pulp and blended with ascidian fiber, which is considered to be the strongest fiber in nature. It also uses a non-press manufacturing method to increase the thickness and strength.The magnetic circuit uses a magnet with a diameter of 140 mm and a thickness of 17 mm. In addition, a die-cast frame is used so that the vibration system and magnetic circuit can be stably supported even at large amplitude.A 12 cm cone type squaker using Bio-Croscone is mounted in the middle area.For the 700 Hz to 3 kHz skoker, we select the optimum diaphragm diameter, shape and thickness material, and adopt a deep curved non-press manufacturing method biocloth diaphragm.In addition, an independent back chamber of approximately 2L is installed at the rear of the unit in order to improve sound noise and clarity.A composite dome tweeter combining a 2.5 cm aluminum magnesium alloy dome and a 4 cm bicycloscone is installed in the high range.By making it a composite type, we have succeeded in balancing the characteristics of both hard dome and cone diaphragms, and at the same time, we have also achieved high efficiency of the unit itself.In the Network Division, film condensers made by German company WIMA are used for the tweeter condenser. The woofer, squaker and tweeter circuits are mounted on separate boards to eliminate the effects of back-emf generated by the speaker unit and reciprocal induction generated by the choke coil.The enclosure is designed not only for rigidity but also for sound quality. MDF with natural vibration damping is used for all plates, and the front baffle, which requires strength, is 42 mm thick.In addition, we have adopted a method to effectively reinforce only important points, and have conducted careful tuning by hearing.The speaker terminal uses a gold-plated brass scraping terminal.Speaker cables up to 6 mm in core diameter can be connected, and banana plugs can also be connected from the rear.The mounting position is designed so as not to be affected by vibration.There was a special speaker stand sold separately.The speaker stand comes with metal rivets that are driven into the base of the stand to eliminate vibration interference between the speaker stand and the floor.

sections.title: ONKYO D-77MRX
sections.overview: A speaker system developed with Premium Technology introduced everywhere to realize "improvement of dynamic S/N".A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm uses a silk OMF (ONKYO Micro Fiber) diaphragm. This material was developed to be an ideal material that is lightweight, highly rigid and has high internal loss. It uses a matrix structure made of silk fiber and thermosetting resin. This reduces the inherent noise generated from the diaphragm itself, and the shape has been continuously improved to further expand the dynamic range and reduce distortion.In addition, damper material with less natural resonance is used.Equipped with 12 cm cone type skoker in the middle area.The diaphragm is equipped with silk OMF diaphragm as well as woofer.A 2.5 cm compound tweeter is installed in the high range.The vibration plate is a combination of 2.5 cm aluminum magnesium alloy dome and 4 cm bicycloscone.The newly developed S line edge is used for the edge part of the unit.In conventional edge design, the absorption of propagating waves and the superiority of the amplitude linearity of the diaphragm were emphasized. However, the reflection due to the mismatch of mechanical impedance at the junction with the diaphragm caused the loss of spatial information. We determined that the cause was the shape of the edge, and repeated data analysis and hearing to realize the shape with the least reflection of propagating waves.MDCT (magnetic distortion reduction technology) is adopted for the magnetic circuit.The speaker unit converts electrical signals into audio signals in accordance with Fleming's Law. However, in the conversion process, distortion is generated due to complex mutual interference of magnetic fields. To solve this problem, we are pursuing technology to prevent interference of DC / AC magnetic fields by improving the symmetry of magnetic flux, and we are reducing various types of distortion called non-linear distortion, magnetic distortion, and current distortion.The S. G. L. (Steady Ground Level) type isolated wiring network is used for the network part.This system uses an independent board for each unit to enable separate layout and eliminate electromagnetic interference. In addition, an S. G. L. type one point concentrated circuit is used for the ground, which is the reference of audio signals, to prevent current from flowing in the ground line and to enable more realistic reproduction with a constant ground potential.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.MDF is used for the entire surface, and 42 mm thickness is secured for the front baffle which especially requires strength. In addition, a dedicated wooden back chamber is incorporated in the back of the skoker to form an independent space, eliminating mutual interference between units due to pressure changes in the enclosure.The speaker terminal uses a gold-plated brass scraping terminal that supports banana plugs.There was a speaker stand as an option sold separately.This stand has rivets on the bottom to prevent vibration interference between the speaker stand and the floor.(If this rivet is used, scratches or marks may remain on the floor surface.)

This suppresses split vibration of the diaphragm and realizes excellent high-frequency reproduction.In addition, the EQ that fixes the diaphragm is a Shinkai type that can reproduce ultra-high frequencies up to 100 kHz with flatter frequency characteristics. In addition, the sound quality is improved by taking thorough noise reduction measures such as preventing unwanted sound from being reflected around the diaphragm.In the network section, an S. G. L. (Steady Ground Level) type one point concentrated circuit is adopted to prevent ground fluctuation, which is the reference of audio signals.In addition, parts such as a film condenser made by WIMA of Germany are used for the network element, and a gold-plated screw type is used for the terminal that can hold cables with a large core diameter.The enclosure is made of thick material for balanced resonance control, and the corners of the baffle face are rounded to prevent unwanted sound from being diffracted.In addition, instead of the conventional circular duct, a unique slit-type "Advanced Aero Acoustic Drive" has been adopted. sections.overview: An improved speaker system for the DS 500.Returning to the origin of sound, the vocals which come out from one part of human mouth are not reproduced by many units, but are realized by focusing on the form of 2 way.A 18 cm cone woofer is used for the low range.In order to prevent mid-gap, which had been a problem in the two way system, the weight of the pure cross carbon vibration plate is reduced. The vibration plate is reduced by 15%, the edge is reduced by 15%, and the voice coil is reduced by 22%. The vibration system has excellent transient characteristics.In addition, we have newly developed a 2-layer structure that is flexible and elastic with a large internal loss at the edge, and we thoroughly pay attention to the parts that greatly affect sound quality.A 2.5 cm titanium oval dome type tweeter is used for the high range.An oval diaphragm is a dome diaphragm with a special shape that is circular at the outer periphery and becomes elliptical as it approaches the center. This oval shape is an extension of the resonance cancellation structure using the conventional laser cut and staggered rib method. It eliminates the high-frequency resonance peculiar to metal plates by changing the shape from circular to elliptical.In addition, attaching cork material to the frame reduces the secondary reflection from the front of the frame.The network section uses an isolated wiring network with a separate layout to prevent interference and influence from electrical, magnetic, and acoustic aspects.In addition, we focus on selecting parts to supply each unit without damaging the input signal, such as using a large polyester film condenser.The enclosure uses a newly developed bus transmission system.In place of the conventional paper-tube type bass reflex duct, a folding type wooden bass reflex duct has been adopted. As a result, it can be demonstrated over a wider range of frequencies, and the low sound energy feeling and transient characteristics are improved.In addition, since the bass reflex duct is fixed to the enclosure, the whole is strengthened and unnecessary vibration is reduced.In addition, by can be laid out without being aware of the back by making it a high-grade plated finish including the back.In order to support AV, it is designed to prevent magnetic field.

sections.title: ONKYO D-605F
sections.overview: A speaker system that uses Onkyo's original technique to thoroughly reduce noise from all the parts that make up the speaker.Two 16 cm cone type woofers with silk OMF diaphragms are installed in the low range, and the twin drive system expands the low range playback range.The silk OMF diaphragm has a matrix structure made of silk fiber and thermosetting resin, and is characterized by low resonance sound inherent to the material. By using this diaphragm as a small-diameter unit, the response is enhanced.In addition, the edge and damper that support the diaphragm are carefully selected from materials with little inherent noise, and the shape that responds well to small signals and does not give a sense of clipping even when Tsutomu Dainyu is in use is selected.In addition, in order to solve the problem that the sound information is lost due to the reflection of the propagation wave generated at the diaphragm and edge junction, the S-line edge with the least reflection is adopted.A 2.5 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of lightweight polyester mesh and laminated with high-damping special urethane elastomer film to create a natural sound field.In addition, the N. R. I. C. (Non Reflective Inner Construction) structure is adopted to prevent the sound emitted from the rear of the diaphragm from being repeatedly reflected in the back chamber (rear vacant room) and degrading the sound quality, thereby increasing the purity of the sound.In the network section, the boards are separated and laid out separately for each sound range of each unit to prevent mutual interference due to electromagnetic induction. In addition, an S. G. L. (Steady Ground Level) 1-point concentrated circuit is used as the ground for audio signals to ensure a ground potential that does not easily fluctuate and improve reproducibility.In addition, by wrapping damping cloth around the internal wiring material, it is difficult to be affected by sound pressure and vibration of the enclosure, and high purity signal transmission is possible.The enclosure uses MDF and is finished with a real wood veneer.In addition, four horizontal reinforcing plates divide the vertical direction of the cabinet into five sections, increasing the rigidity of the long span baffle plates and side plates, and dispersing resonance frequencies so that sharp resonance does not occur at characteristic frequencies.The speaker terminal is made from gold-plated brass and is compatible with banana plugs and with a 6 mm diameter hole to accommodate very thick cables.In addition, to avoid the effect of vibration, we have adopted a mounting method in which it is fixed to a strong back plate.

sections.title: ONKYO D-908E
sections.overview: The Tollboy type speaker system was developed by gathering together the speaker technology that Onkyo currently possesses.The unit is a further flash-up version of the D-312E mounted unit that was evaluated in the European magazine "Revue du son".A 16 cm cone type woofer by A-OMF Monocoque cone is mounted in the low range.The A-OMF Monocoque cone has a 4-layer structure made of PEN fiber, aramid fiber, cotton, and aramid fiber. In addition, the twill structure of PEN fiber has succeeded in eliminating the resin between fibers, improving the rigidity and internal loss of the diaphragm. In addition, the center cap and diaphragm are integrally molded into a bowl-shaped body with no inflection point to further increase the rigidity and completely eliminate the cause of divided vibration.The magnetic circuit is equipped with a 65 mm diameter voice coil and a large ferrite magnet of 1090g weight / 140 mm diameter to improve input resistance and sound quality.In addition, by adopting an aluminum die-cast frame with an average thickness of approximately 6 mm and an artificial leather edge made of ultra-fine fibers with consideration for responsiveness and reduction of unwanted sound reflection, consideration is also given to noise removal down to the minute level.A ring type tweeter using a ring type diaphragm with an outer diameter of 40 mm / inner diameter of 30 mm is mounted in the high range.The ring diaphragm is driven by a 35 mm diameter voice coil arranged on the same axis. By using the circumference corresponding to the middle point between the outer edge and the inner edge of the diaphragm as the driving point, the split vibration of the diaphragm is completely suppressed, and clear high-frequency reproduction in which the piston motion region reaches almost 20 kHz is realized. The inside of the diaphragm is equipped with a newly designed shaved aluminum equalizer, and by its unique shape, the frequency characteristic is flatter than that of the ultra-high-frequency range.In addition, anti-reflection measures around the diaphragm and the use of a back chamber shape that does not generate flutter echo have been taken to thoroughly eliminate noise.The network circuit uses an isolated wiring method to separate the woofer and tweeter network circuits to prevent interference between the signals of each band. In addition, a circuit mounting technology that does not generate a potential difference in the ground line of each network is introduced to prevent masking of minute audio signals.The capacitor is manufactured by WIMA in Germany.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system, and the bass reflex duct uses an advanced Aero Acoustic Drive, a slit-type duct with unique technology.This method not only attenuates unnecessary high-order noise components by adopting a long and narrow rectangular cross-section, but also achieves high-speed low-frequency playback because it is advantageous in terms of viscous resistance of the air. In addition, the enclosure and duct sections are separated from each other to minimize the effects of vibration.The enclosure structure is designed to increase vertical strength by rounding the sides. In addition, by placing power wood in the appropriate position of thick material such as 30 mm thick baffle, sound trapping due to unnecessary resonance is eliminated.The exterior is elaborately plated with silver heart material compared to the past.The speaker terminal is bi-wired to take advantage of the isolated wiring network circuit by reducing the mutual interference between woofer and tweeter.The terminal uses a brass machined gold plated terminal corresponding to a banana plug, and a short bar is attached.Spikes and spike receivers are included, and by attaching the spikes, unnecessary resonance from the floor surface can be prevented.

sections.title: ONKYO MONITOR900
sections.overview:
80,000 (1 unit, sold on October 1, 1998)

This speaker system was developed as a monitor for listening to music instead of checking sound like a studio monitor.Equipped with a 20 cm cone type woofer in the low range.The diaphragm uses a unique silk OMF (ONKYO Micro Fiber) diaphragm. This diaphragm uses ultra-fine silk fiber made from natural cocoon yarn with no impurities removed. It has a multi-layered structure made of non-woven fabric with fibers aligned in a certain direction. The direction in which the fibers are aligned is changed. Then, both sides of the fiber layer are bound with unsaturated polyester resin to increase the strength. The silk OMF diaphragm uses a manufacturing method that prevents resin from mixing into the silk fiber layer. Since the silk fiber is in a movable state, the slippage between fibers and between layers acts as a loss, absorbs vibration, and reduces noise generated from the diaphragm itself. The diaphragm shape also uses a structure that increases the strength around the voice coil, suppressing resonance caused by the bell phenomenon, expanding the dynamic range and reducing distortion.OMF edge based on superfine non-woven fabric is used for the edge material supporting the diaphragm, and natural fiber is mixed in the damper to improve linearity and reduce natural vibration.The mid-range has a 12 cm cone type mid-range.A silk OMF diaphragm is used for the diaphragm as well as the low-frequency one.A 2.5 cm hard-domed tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of aluminum-magnesium alloy, which is lightweight and has high internal loss, and the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin are integrated. Since there is no adhesive between the diaphragm and bobbin, the vibration system can be made lighter and more rigid, and the transmission characteristics can be improved.Magnetic distortion reduction technology (MDCT) is used for the magnetic circuit of each unit.In this method, the symmetry of magnetic flux is increased, and the shape and structure which prevent the interference of DC and AC magnetic field are adopted, and non-linear strain, magnetic strain and current strain are reduced.The network section is divided into four sections to eliminate mutual inductive interference.In addition, the internal wiring uses a cloth-wound internal wiring cable with a cloth wound around the outer circumference to suppress the effect of vibration.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system, and by installing bass reflex ducts on the front and rear surfaces, it is possible to reproduce the sound in the low frequency range that feels wind pressure and to reproduce the sound field spreading in the depth direction more faithfully.MDF with natural sound is used for the entire plate. Especially, 36 mm thick MDF is used for the front baffle plate. In addition, reinforcing ribs are provided inside the cabinet and a special plate set is used to drive the resonance frequency of the cabinet plate beyond the vocal band, dispersing resonance and reducing harmful noise.The exterior is a walnut veneer finish and finished with four layers of glossy paint.The input terminal uses a brass machined gold plated terminal.This terminal is compatible with a banana plug, and an extra thick speaker cable can be connected by providing a 6 mm diameter hole in the terminal shaft.

sections.title: ONKYO SCEPTER1001
sections.overview:
150,000 (1 unit, released in November 1993)

This speaker system was developed to reproduce as much information as possible from the actual performance of music without adding unnecessary things and without losing necessary things.A 30 cm cone type unit is used for the low range.With MDCT (Magnetic Reduction Technology) proposed by Onkyo, the magnetic strain generated in the magnetic circuit is reduced by improving the shape of the pole piece and top plate, and by adopting copper short rings and copper caps.We have also adopted a short voice coil that further advances the concept of MDCT. This coil is designed with a larger magnetic circuit so that the voice coil always oscillates in a uniform magnetic flux density. Compared with a long voice coil, this coil has less distortion and differential operation under a constant electromagnetic brake, so that resolution is improved.In order to transmit a large amount of information without leakage, 99.9999% ultra-high-purity oxygen-free copper (6N-OFC) is used for the voice coil winding.Bio-Crocone, which was developed from biotechnology, is used for the diaphragm.This diaphragm has improved various important characteristics for diaphragm such as light weight, high rigidity, high internal loss and high airtightness by refining and mixing ascidian cellulose, which is the most crystalline of natural cellulose, with dense wood pulp produced in high latitude areas near the Arctic.We have newly developed and adopted High Legh Near Elastomer Edge for the edge material with excellent linearity.An 8 cm dome type unit with an aluminum magnesium alloy diaphragm in which the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin are integrated is adopted for the middle area.Since no adhesive is interposed between the vibration plate and bobbin, this integrated structure type has high follow-up capability to music signals. Moreover, the vibration system can be made lighter and more rigid, and high-resolution mid-range playback can be achieved.The magnetic circuit is also equipped with MDCT technology to reduce magnetostriction.In addition, the punching net made of magnetic material becomes a part of the magnetic circuit. In order to prevent the magnetic flux that should originally be concentrated in the magnetic gap from protruding to the front, causing interference with the AC magnetic flux generated when music signals are input, and causing distortion, a small high-performance samarium-cobalt magnet is attached to the punching net to prevent the magnetic flux from passing through the front of the diaphragm.In addition, by sandwiching this cancel magnet with damping material, the squeal of punching net is suppressed.A 2.5 cm dome unit with an integrated diaphragm and voice coil bobbin is used for the high frequency band as well as the middle band.In addition, the material is aluminum magnesium alloy, which is approximately 25% lighter than conventional tweeters.The magnetic circuit uses MDCT technology that uses copper short rings to improve resolution.In order to bring out the quality of each unit in the network, carefully selected parts are used abundantly. In addition, each unit is divided into three bands to eliminate reciprocal induction.In addition to the network parts, we have also taken anti-vibration measures to the wiring materials and placed them so that input signals are transmitted to each unit without deterioration.The front baffle of the enclosure is made of hard-textured softwood MDF with 50 mm thickness on the front baffle and sides. In addition to the use of soundbars and elaborate reinforcement to increase the rigidity of the cabinet and adjust the sound.The front baffle has a large round with a radius of 55 mm to reduce sound reflection and diffraction.In addition, in order to prevent adverse effects on other units due to the reaction vibration of the vibration plate of each unit being transmitted from the magnetic circuit to the front baffle via the frame, a slit is provided between the fixed parts of each unit on the back surface of the front baffle, and an isolated mount method is adopted to resolve vibration interference between units.Special speaker stand is sold separately.This stand is made of laminated mizume cherry with excellent vibration damping characteristics, impregnated with special resins, and compressed and formed with high density under high sound and high pressure.As a result, high rigidity and resonance rejection are obtained.

sections.title: ONKYO SCEPTER2002
sections.overview: A 2-way floor type speaker system developed based on the know-how cultivated in the Scepter series speakers and the new theory proposed in the Grand Scepter GS-1.A 28 cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.Corn paper is made from wood pulp produced in high latitudes near the Arctic Circle, refined and mixed with ascidian cellulose, which is the most highly crystallized of natural cellulose. The integration of these two types of cellulose forms a network of dense paper layers, improving rigidity and airtightness.In addition, by adopting a large diameter voice coil of 7.6 cm, the distance to the edge is shortened, and low sound with excellent transient is realized.The magnetic circuit uses a large magnet and a copper cap to reduce harmonic distortion.The high-frequency range uses a super hyperbolic horn with a cut-off frequency of 500 Hz.The super hyperbolic horn is a technology developed at the time of the development of the GS-1. It adopts the hyperbolic function for the change in cross-sectional area and the super elliptic function including the oblate function and the shape function for the change in shape. By solving these simultaneous equations, the horn has a smooth extension without sudden shape change.This reduces the phenomenon called "multipath ghost distortion" in which high frequencies are reflected inside the horn due to stays, separators, steps, and irregularities inside the horn.In addition, in order to prevent a phenomenon called "Reverb distortion" in which unnecessary sound components are generated by vibration of the horn itself, approximately 2g/cm is added to the material of the horn.3By using resin concrete with a specific gravity of approximately 12 kg, the strain is reduced.The driver's 3.5 cm diaphragm uses reinforced A1-Mg alloy and is made by integral molding with the tangential edge which has excellent symmetry of amplitude.This diaphragm has been stabilized to prevent the original physical properties of the material from changing due to the stress applied to the metal during molding, so that the characteristics before molding are not lost.In the network, the filters for the woofer and the filters for the tweeter are built into each unit and are completely separated.In addition, in the network, all parts that need to be separated into circuits and parts are divided to form an isolated wiring network with little distortion and no mutual interference.One problem with horn-type speakers is that because the horn diaphragm is positioned behind the woofer by the length of the horn, there is a gap in the time it takes to reach the listener's ear.This appears as a disturbance in the characteristics near the crossover frequency. The time axis control circuit eliminates this disturbance and smooths the connection between units.The high-range and low-range sections have independent filters, enabling bi-amplifier and bi-wiring connections.In order to reduce unnecessary strain components (Reverb strain) generated by the vibration of the enclosure itself, the cabinet is not only reinforced in an invisible manner, but also actively employs a "constrained damping method" using damping materials and steel plates to reduce vibration.An acoustic wave regulator is also installed to absorb standing waves inside the enclosure.For vertical standing waves, a slit chamber at the bottom of the speaker is used as a wave regulator, and the section seen from the top of the cabinet is shaped like a ladder to prevent horizontal standing waves from occurring.The net of the woofer is detachable.

sections.title: ONKYO SCEPTER-F1
sections.overview:
300,000 (1 unit, sold on November 21, 2000)

The correlation between noise and audibility and the mechanism of generation have been thoroughly verified through theoretical analysis and hearing, and Onkyo's technology and sensitivity have been put into it. This is a tall boy type speaker with improved sound field reproduction capability.It has two 20 cm cone woofers in the low range and a 13 cm cone in the middle range.These units use silk OMF diaphragms. These diaphragms are molded with a matrix structure of 100% pure non-woven fabric made of ultra-fine silk fibers and unsaturated polyester resin, and the inherent energy generated by vibration of the diaphragm is quickly converted into thermal energy by friction between fibers and layers. Unsaturated polyester also has a large internal loss and is carefully selected with high rigidity. As a result, the entire diaphragm is lightweight, has high rigidity, and has high internal loss.For the edge and damper supporting the diaphragm, materials with low intrinsic noise are carefully selected, and the shape that minimizes vibration energy loss at the practical sound volume is selected. In addition, the newly developed S-line edge is also used for the connection between the diaphragm and the edge to smooth the connection, greatly reducing reflection of propagating waves.A 2.5 cm hard dome type tweeter using an aluminum magnesium alloy diaphragm is mounted in the high frequency range.Among metals, aluminum magnesium alloy, which is lightweight and has less natural resonance, is used for the diaphragm and voice coil, which require high-speed vibration. Moreover, the diaphragm and voice coil are made into an integrated structure that does not use any adhesive to improve response characteristics.In addition, the front protective net that protects the diaphragm is made of non-magnetic material to prevent degradation of sound quality, thereby eliminating various factors that cause loss of sound information in detail.The magnetic circuit has a shape and structure that enhances the symmetry of magnetic flux and prevents interference of AC and DC magnetic fields.The adoption of M. D. C. T. (magnetic strain reduction technology) makes it possible to reduce non-linear strain, magnetic strain and current strain as much as possible.In the network section, the boards are separated for each sound range that each unit has, and the layout is separated to prevent mutual interference due to electromagnetic induction. In addition, the ground, which is the reference of audio signals, employs an S. G. L. (Steady Ground Level) type one point concentrated circuit to prevent current from flowing in the ground line.In addition, high-quality parts such as film condensers made by WIMA (Germany) are used for network elements, and damping cloth wound cables that are less susceptible to vibration are used for internal wiring.The enclosure is designed to have a trapezoidal shape that is less susceptible to standing waves, and uses a diffusion material instead of a sound absorbing material to disperse energy, thereby preventing the occurrence of standing waves.In addition, MDF material is used for the material, and the thickness of the baffle board, which is affected by the vibration of the speaker unit, is maintained at 42 mm. In addition, the structure is divided into four by three horizontal reinforcing plates for higher rigidity and dispersion / reduction of resonance.A 5-liter back chamber is installed at the rear of the squaker to eliminate the influence of back pressure from other units.Exterior finished with Cherrywood Glossy Paint.The speaker terminal uses a gold-plated brass terminal for banana banana plugs. A hole of 6 mm diameter is provided in the terminal shaft to support extremely thick speaker cables.

sections.title: ONKYO SCEPTERSC-1
sections.overview:
80,000 (1 unit, released in October 1992)

The Quest Series speaker system is based on Onkyo's concept of "I want to enjoy music with really good sound".Research and development of materials, circuit design and cabinet structure were all developed in pursuit of ideals.For the lower range, a 12 cm unit by bio-Croscone is adopted.In order to draw out the performance of the bi-croscone, we have adopted a new magnetostriction reduction technology (MDCT) to reduce magnetostriction and improve the rise response characteristics of the diaphragm.In addition, the newly adopted pole-phase equalizer, which is made by cutting brass, realizes smooth middle-and-high sound reproduction without the effect of "hollow effect" and "cavity resonance".The high-frequency band uses a 2.5 cm dome unit made of aluminum magnesium alloy that is 25% lighter than conventional units.The enclosure is designed to disperse standing waves generated inside the enclosure by means of tapered side plates and internal soundbars, and to firmly support the woofer equipped with acoustic and stabilizer.It is made of Yonematsu plywood with beautiful sound for the baffle plate and the back plate. In addition, two 50 mm square steel pipes are sandwiched between side plates (thrust plate finish) from both sides of the support part to suppress the swing of the support part.In addition, 4 round rivets can be attached to the back side of the base, and the back 2 of them are adjustable in height.

sections.title: ONKYO SCEPTERSC-2
sections.overview: Based on the know-how accumulated through research, development and production of speakers, the Quest Series speaker system is based on Onkyo's concept of "enjoying music with truly good sound".The magnetic circuit uses MDCT (Magnetic Distortion Cancel Technology). The new shape and structure of the magnetic circuit enhances the symmetry of magnetic flux and successfully prevents the interference of direct and alternating magnetic fields.In addition, the MID4 concept has been introduced to achieve more natural sound quality by not allowing crossover in the frequency band between 125 Hz and 2000 Hz.For the low range, 18 cm cone type woofer is used.The Woofer diaphragm is made of Bio-Croscone, a blend of ascidian cellulose derived from biotechnology. In order to bring out the performance of this diaphragm, a newly designed magnetic circuit using MDCT is adopted to reduce current distortion and improve the rise response characteristics of the diaphragm.In addition, the newly adopted brass machined pole phase equalizer realizes a smooth middle and high frequency range without the effect of the shape of the diaphragm and the "hollow effect" or "cavity resonance" caused by the voice coil bobbin, and efficiently radiates heat generated in the voice coil.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is used for the high range.An even lighter aluminum-magnesium alloy has been developed for the diaphragm, and we have succeeded in reducing the weight by 25% compared with conventional products.In addition, a copper short ring is used for the magnetic circuit to reduce distortion.The enclosure distributes standing waves generated within it by means of tapered side walls and internal soundbars.In addition, an isolated mount system has been introduced. In order to prevent the reaction vibration of the diaphragm moved by the music signal from being transmitted from the magnetic circuit through the frame to the baffle plate and adversely affecting it, a slit is provided between the units to suppress the vibration transmitted through the baffle plate.In addition, an acoustic stabilizer is directly connected to the magnetic circuit of the woofer to absorb unwanted vibrations of the unit itself and vibrations caused by the reaction of the woofer diaphragm.It uses a gold plated terminal for banana plug which can be connected by bi-wiring.The special stand sold separately has a veneer finish with walnut single material (solid wood) at both ends of the base part.The top plate is a "restraint damping structure" with a 3 mm thick steel plate sandwiched with damping material to suppress unnecessary noise. In addition, two 50 mm square steel pipes are sandwiched between side plates (thrust plate finish) from both sides of the support part to suppress the swing of the support part.In addition, 4 round rivets can be attached to the back side of the base, and the back 2 of them are adjustable in height.

sections.title: ONKYO SCEPTER-SW1
sections.overview:
200,000 (1 unit sold on March 13, 2001)

This is a subwoofer system with built-in amplifier developed through many theoretical analyses, hearings, and verification based on human listening feeling with the proposition of drawing out the performance of high-end theater to the maximum.ONKYO's unique Super J' DRIVE system has been adopted to improve playback at ultra-low frequencies.In the J' DRIVE system, the diaphragm of the unit mounted inside the cabinet is in contact with the front chamber, which has an extremely small internal volume. When the diaphragm vibrates according to an audio signal, the air in the front chamber is compressed and expanded according to the movement of the diaphragm. This compression and expansion is transmitted to the air through a short duct.In the J' DRIVE system, it is possible to play back low-frequency sound with good transient even if only one unit is used. However, the Scepter-SW1 uses a dual drive system in which two units face each other to cancel the reaction. This system is named the Super J' DRIVE system.The unit uses two 25 cm cone type woofer that uses OMF diaphragm with less material specific resonance sound.This unit was developed for the Scepter-SW1. It has a 6-layer structure with a diameter of 25 cm and an S-line edge with an edge three times thicker than usual to absorb propagation waves and minimize reflection.The magnetic circuit uses an M. D. C. T. with a shape and structure that enhances the symmetry of magnetic flux and prevents the interference of AC and DC magnetic fields.The enclosure uses MDF.Equipped with preset functions (4 items of cut-off frequency, volume level, phase and mode) including power on / standby, volume level, Music/Movie mode switching, cut-off frequency selection, Normal/Reverse phase switching, mute, and custom-set three pattern storage preset functions (4 items of cut-off frequency, volume level, phase and mode).It also comes with a wireless remote control that can operate all of these functions.

sections.title: ONKYO SL-D1000
sections.overview: The newly developed A-OMF Monocoque cone and digital amplifier VL Digital are flagship sub-woofers developed by gathering the best technologies that Onkyo can have now.The unit is equipped with a newly developed 30cmA-OMF monocoque woofer.The A-OMF Monocoque uses a multi-layer structure of PEN fiber, cotton, and aramid fiber. Furthermore, by making the PEN fiber into a twill structure, we succeeded in eliminating resins between fibers, thereby improving the rigidity and internal loss of the diaphragm.In addition, the center cap and diaphragm are integrally molded to form a bowl-shaped structure with no inflection point, further increasing rigidity and completely eliminating the factor of split vibration.In order to drive this diaphragm faithfully, we use a large voice coil with a diameter of 100 mm, an anodized aluminum voice coil bobbin with improved heat resistance and transmission characteristics, and a neodymium magnet with high magnetic flux density, consisting of 16 magnets with diameters of 24mmx6mm.In addition, by installing double dampers, it is designed to firmly support the diaphragm even at large amplitude.In order to firmly support the structure of the weight class, an aluminum die-cast frame is adopted for the frame, and unnecessary resonance from the frame itself is suppressed by not having a refracting surface. In addition, by keeping the magnetic circuit inside the frame and firmly holding it, unnecessary shake of the whole unit is suppressed.The power amplifier uses a PWM (pulse width modulation) method for A/D modulation with less noise outside the audible band, and uses a VL Digital digital amplifier originally developed for pure audio.The VL Digital is an integral-type modulation circuit with two circuits consisting of a vector generator, an integrator, and an inversion trigger generator. Therefore, even if spike noise, which is the cause of conversion error, enters from the outside, the spike noise itself has a symmetrical waveform in the upper and lower sides, so the energy of the upper and lower waveforms cancel each other out, enabling error-free A/D conversion.This amplifier realizes an instantaneous current supply capability (HICC) of 100A, which is an indication of speaker drive capability.In place of the circular duct, which easily emits standing waves inside the cabinet and easily generates strong standing waves from the duct itself, we have adopted the advanced AERO ACOUSTIC DRIVE, a slit-type duct developed by our own technology.By adopting a thin rectangular cross section, not only can unnecessary high-order noise components be attenuated, but it is also advantageous in viscous resistance of the air, making it possible to reproduce low sound with a sense of speed.In addition, by separating the cabinet and duct, the effect of mutual vibration is suppressed, and reproducibility at the minute level is improved.It is equipped with functions such as auto standby function, 12 v trigger capable of interlocking power supply with external equipment, phase selection switch, 4-stage switchable high-cut filter, switchable filter, etc.

sections.title: ONKYO TORINOST-3
sections.overview: This is a 3D (three dimensional) speaker system based on the new idea of making the satellite unit as small as possible and bringing it closer to the point sound source while allowing only one woofer unit to receive the low sound range.An 8 cm cone type speaker is used for the satellite unit.A compact and lightweight short voice coil is used to reduce the size and weight of the voice coil. This reduces the interference caused by the magnetic loop of the voice coil itself and reduces the second harmonic distortion.In addition, a copper cap is used to reduce the third harmonic wave.The vibration plate of the unit is made by mixing ascidian cellulose (fiber), which is the most crystallized in nature, with cone paper to obtain light weight, rigidity, airtightness, and internal loss. The surface of the cone paper is coated with a special coating to prevent the sound quality from changing due to humidity.In addition, artificial leather edge is used for the edge.A high-loss, high-rigidity engineering plastics frame is used for the frame.By controlling the frequency characteristics of the satellite unit, high performance is achieved even when the satellite is used alone.When using 3D, a network is installed in the woofer.A 16 cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.Highly crystallized plant cellulose (MFC) is refined and mixed with wood pulp produced in high latitude near the Arctic.As a result of forming a paper layer network by integrating these two types of cellulose, we have achieved light weight, rigidity, airtightness, and internal loss.In addition, a lead acoustic stabilizer is installed behind the magnetic circuit of the woofer unit to eliminate the effect of the reaction that occurs when the diaphragm moves.It is equipped with a 20W mixing amplifier with a volume that can adjust the volume level of the low range depending on the location of the woofer and the type of music.In addition, a 2-channel 15W + 15W amplifier is installed for satellite.The enclosure has a walnut natural veneer oil finish for the woofer and walnut natural solid wood for the satellite.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAP-303
sections.overview: A preamplifier with a minimum configuration for high-fidelity transmission.In order to maintain high fidelity as a transmission system, only one MM, MC, Tuner, Tuner, and Tape is switched as a minimum function necessary for practical use. All adjustment and switching circuits including tone are omitted, and a thin structure suitable for simplifying signal flow is adopted.If you absolutely need more functions or sound field correction, you can use the Integra U-30 system unit or the Integra E-30 audio equalizer (sold separately) to expand the functions.The P-303 is designed with attention paid to dynamic modulation (transient intermodulation distortion) caused by interference between functional blocks of the circuit, within the same block, and between left and right channels.Dynamic modulation, which occurs when a transient signal with a sharp rise is input, such as a music signal, is generated by mutual interference between circuits caused by the impedance of the power supply part and the genetic line. In order to prevent this, the P-303 has low impedance for the power supply and distribution line including the power supply part, and ultra-stable supply of the power supply voltage. It also employs a large number of high-purity multi-spray Bussler in made of copper. A copper plate with a resistance value of 0.0027   / cm is used for the bus earth line, and a copper plate with a resistance value of 0.008   / cm is used for the bus hotline for   B power supply. The branch of each circuit block is directly connected to the low-impedance supply main line directly, thus suppressing dynamic modulation.In addition, in order to hold this line in a low impedance over a wide bandwidth, the power supply section employs a double stabilizer circuit with a double supply of a constant voltage power supply, and the capacitors used in the power supply section employ audio signal capacitors with low loss, low leakage, excellent distortion characteristics and temperature characteristics designed especially for audio applications.The D. L. C. (Dual Line Construction) method completely separates the left and right channels to eliminate interference between the channels. In addition, each block is arranged in a straight line in accordance with the signal path from the input side of the low signal level to the output side of the high signal level to eliminate interference between each block and purify circuit operation.In addition, the shield case is entirely made of non-magnetic aluminum material, and the MC amplifier in particular is double-shielded.In all stages of MC amplifier, equalizer amplifier, flat amplifier and buffer amplifier, the linearity is improved by adopting A-class complete vertical symmetrical push-pull system which improves hfe characteristics by combining PNP and NPN.The differential amplifier section of the first stage differential and 3-stage 8-chip equalizer amplifier uses high-voltage, ultra-low-noise PCT silicon epitaxial transistors (2SC1681, 2S¥41). At the same time, the SN ratio is improved by reducing the equivalent noise resistance by making the signal system low impedance.The RIAA constant circuit has excellent frequency characteristics and transient characteristics, and excellent characteristics are obtained by using G class (capacity deviation within   2%) polypropylene film capacitor of non-inductive aluminum foil structure with small tan  .The volume control uses a 4-string precision attenuator type volume that can be controlled in conjunction with the front and rear of the flat amplifier to improve the SN ratio when the volume is reduced.In order to prevent click noise that occurs when the power switch is turned ON/OFF, we have adopted a transient killer circuit using a newly developed break-type lead relay. Instead of being directly connected to the signal circuit as in the past, we have incorporated it into a shunt-type relay to reduce the influence of contact resistance of the relay during normal use.The MC amplifier section uses a 6-chip low input impedance type that uses ultra-low noise transistors in triple push-pull.In the flat amplifier section between stages, a wide-band circuit of DC amplifier configuration is adopted in order to completely remove the capacitor in the NF loop.The first stage differential amplifier circuit employs a dual transistor incorporating two low-noise transistor chips to form a balanced and stable DC amplifier with excellent thermal equilibrium characteristics and a DC amplification ratio of 1   0.02.A film capacitor with a non-inductive extended foil structure is used for the coupling capacitor to prevent degradation of sound quality.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAP-306
sections.overview: Stereo preamplifier using W / Super Servo system.The W super servo system is a system that suppresses cross modulation due to unnecessary ultra-low frequencies and equivalently cancels unnecessary components caused by the impedance between the earth and the ground.By using the supplied Super Servo code, the + side input of the connection code amplifier detects and suppresses harmful ultra-low frequency components, and the - side servo amplifier cancels harmful components caused by resistance, inductance and contact resistance of the output itself with the main amplifier, thereby preventing interference between channels and degradation of separation.In order to take advantage of the characteristics of Super Servo, the MC amplifier does not use a step-up transformer, but uses a one stage type equalizer amplifier that can be used with all cartridges from MM type to MC type by increasing the gain of the equalizer amplifier.In the first stage differential amplifier section, two ultra-low-noise high-Gm FETs are thermally coupled in an aluminum case to improve thermal balance and suppress external thermal noise.The S/N ratio is improved by connecting the differential part in parallel to lower the impedance. This differential amplifier has a cascode connection to reduce the mirror feedback capacitance to obtain a wider frequency response.The second stage differential amplifier and the third stage differential amplifier with current mirror ensure large naked gain, and the high gain amplifier with partial feedback by pole setting realizes excellent stability and low distortion factor.In addition, the final stage uses class A push-pull to transmit the signal to the next stage amplifier with low distortion even under heavy load in the high frequency range.Direct tone method is used for tone control.Since it is composed of only passive elements and has a unique circuit system that does not allow harmful capacitors to enter the signal passage path, sound field correction can be performed without deterioration of sound quality.Since the output amplifier uses the super servo system, there is no need to add an output capacitor. Since the low-frequency time constant is determined only by the servo circuit, the low-frequency shortage at low impedance loads is eliminated.The power supply section uses independent NF-type constant voltage stabilizing circuits on the left and right sides, and each circuit block is directly connected by copper bus (bus) lines to prevent low impedance of the power supply line and interference between each block.Non-magnetic materials such as copper, aluminum, and brass are used for shielding materials and parts.This prevents the magnetic flux generated from the circuit from generating higher harmonics (mainly third harmonics that are harmful to audibility) due to the non-linearity of the magnetic circuit, which adversely affects sound quality.Equipped with a cartridge selector for compatibility with all cartridges.In consideration of the effect on sound quality due to the arrangement of each part and the routing of the line, the arrangement analysis of the signal system is carried out in order.For example, in order to input a signal to a specified circuit at a short distance as possible, direct switching with a remote control switch is adopted to prevent crosstalk and degradation of high-frequency characteristics caused by the routing of signal lines.All circuit parts have been thoroughly examined and tested, and parts with sufficient characteristics, durability and feeling of use have been adopted.For example, the input pin jack for handling a weak current is plated with thick pure gold so that the effect of contact resistance does not sound quality.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAP-306R
sections.overview: This is a Super Servo integral type preamplifier that uses a Super Stabilizer to dramatically improve sound purity and resolution.The equalizer amplifier section uses an MC straight equalizer that takes advantage of the characteristics of Onkyo's unique Super Servo. It does not use an MC amplifier or step-up transformer and realizes a simple configuration of a bowl stage system that can be used for all cartridges.The two low-noise and high-Gm FETs in the pre-stage operation amplifier section are thermally coupled in a special metal case to improve the thermal balance and suppress extraneous noise components.In addition, in order to lower the impedance of the signal system and improve the overall SN, the operating part is connected in parallel. In order to obtain a wider frequency characteristic, the operating part is connected in cascode, and the mirror feedback capacitance is reduced.The second stage differential amplifier and the third stage differential amplifier with differential amplifier with current mirror ensure a large naked gain, and with a handle with partial feedback by pole setting, excellent stability and low distortion factor are realized with high gain.The final stage uses A-class push-pull to smoothly transmit signals to the next stage amplifier at a low distortion rate even under heavy loads in the high frequency range.The newly developed Super Servo Integral System reduces the influence of the sound field and makes the electrical connection with the power amplifier smoother.It is equipped with a super stabilizer to prevent microphonic noise generated inside due to mechanical vibration transmitted, and to prevent the reproduction sound from becoming muddy. The super stabilizer weighing approximately 3 kg is reinforced as a chassis structural material, and vibration resistance is improved by weight. By fixing each printed circuit board firmly to this stabilizer, vibration of the board itself is suppressed by internal absorption effect. In addition, the super stabilizer is made of a conductive layer made of special carbon particles. Space charge uniformity is measured and partial recombination is reduced, so high purity reproduction sound is obtained.In addition, the Super Servo Integral Method eliminates the capacitor. The low-frequency time constant is determined only by the servo circuit. This prevents the low-frequency cut caused by the RC circuit between the capacitor and the input resistance when a general power amplifier is connected, and provides flat low-frequency characteristics.To prevent degradation due to connection code between the preamplifier and the power amplifier, a Super Servo code is included. It suppresses cross modulation due to harmful ultra-low frequencies and equivalently cancels out unwanted components caused by impedance between the ground. The + input terminal of the output amplifier detects and suppresses harmful ultra-low frequencies, and the - input terminal of the output amplifier cancels out harmful components caused by the serious code, the resistance of the connection between the code and the power amplifier, the resistance of the code itself, inductance, etc., to prevent interference between channels and degradation of separation.In order to eliminate the influence of the contact diode characteristics especially at the pin plug part, idle DC bias is superimposed on the ground line to suppress the daily wire diameter characteristics and reduce IM.In addition, to confirm that the servo circuit works when the ground line is connected, the operation can be confirmed by the Connection lamp.The power supply unit not only reduces interference between the left and right channels, but also prevents interference from the power supply between the pre-stage and post-stage channels. To this end, the entire power supply system is designed to have low impedance. Therefore, a high-speed response NF type constant voltage stabilizing circuit is used and each circuit block is directly connected by a bus line.The tone control uses a direct tone system unique to Onkyo that is composed only of passive elements.In order to prevent the magnetic flux generated from the circuit from generating high-order harmonics, mainly third harmonics, which are harmful to the sense of hearing due to the non-linearity of the magnetic path, all main parts are made of non-magnetic materials such as copper, brass, aluminum, and so on, avoiding iron materials.Since the MC cartridge has various output voltage and output impedance, 3 types of cartridge selector are installed so that it can 10   cartridge, 10   ~ 40   cartridge, and high output type cartridge so that it can always be used in optimum condition.With a built-in recording selector, you can turn off the output or record a behind-the-scenes program when you don't record.We analyze the component layout of the signal system in order to prevent crosstalk and characteristic degradation caused by lead wire routing.In consideration of the effect of the resistor used on the sound quality, we use our own noise-improving resistor.In addition to excellent frequency characteristics and strain characteristics, the conductor coating layer is designed to have uniform charge distribution and improved magnetic characteristics.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAP-306RS
sections.overview: Control amplifier using super turbo system.Newly developed super turbo system is adopted.This system combines a delta turbo circuit and a turbo filter circuit to suppress the modulation noise caused by the power transformer, expand the dynamic dynamic range by more than 20 dB, cut the harmonic noise caused by the flux generated by the transformer, and eliminate various electrical noise entering from the outside of the amplifier.The delta turbo circuit is designed to prevent modulation noise caused by + - imbalance in the power supply when a low frequency signal of 100 Hz or less is input.In the conventional power supply, only the positive and negative sides of the B power supply Chemi-Con and transformer windings, which supply power depending on whether the waveform of the signal flowing into the speaker is positive or negative, worked separately. Especially when the audio signal is 100 Hz or less, the power supply on one side, for example, the Chemi-Con on the negative side is off while the Chemi-Con on the positive side is being charged, and the charging current returns to the transformer through the midpoint. In the delta turbo circuit, the diode is turned off while the amplitude of the audio signal is small. Therefore, even while the positive side is being charged, the power supply flows into the Chemi-Con on the negative side without passing through the midpoint. As a result, the Chemi-Con on the negative side is charged up. Even if the voltage on the positive side drops due to the supply of power to the speaker, the voltage on the negative side rises reversely and the voltage fluctuation with respect to the voltage across the transformer is relatively small. This reduces the amplitude modulation of the charging current and suppresses the generation of modulation noise.In addition, in this circuit, the diodes are delta-connected, so that the modulation noise does not flow only to the ground point of the circuit, even if the diode is turned on during high-power operation.The turbo filter circuit is designed to prevent the modulation noise generated by the magnitude of the signal regardless of the frequency of the signal. The function of the circuit is to limit the harmonic spectrum generated by the pulse waveform supplied from the power transformer to only the amount necessary for the Chemi-Con charging.There are two types of modulation noise generated by the harmonic spectrum. One type flows into the amplifier through the power supply line, and the other type flows out into the amplifier as magnetic flux from the power transformer. Especially in the micro-level amplification system in the amplifier, the noise voltage induced by this flux is generated, and it stains the original music signal. Furthermore, since this flux varies in proportion to the signal magnitude, it appears as signal information in the sense of hearing, and it has been considered to be the limit of the resolution of reproduced sound. In the turbo filter circuit, the modulation noise component is suppressed according to the turbo filter optimum attenuation characteristics, and the necessary charging energy is sent to the Chemicon.This turbo filter circuit has a special CR filter placed in the power transformer. The inductance of this CR and transformer constitutes an equivalent circuit filter as shown below.Another function of the turbo filter is to suppress modulation noise and prevent various types of noise from the external AC power supply from entering the power supply section, thereby reducing the difference in sound quality depending on the polarity of the AC power supply.Super Servo Integral System is adopted.This system focuses on sound quality problems caused by external factors such as the sound pressure directly received from the speaker and compatibility with the power amplifier. The system employs a super stabilizer, an output capacitor-less system, and a super servo cord to solve electrical and mechanical problems.The super-stabilizer weighs about 3 kg and is reinforced as a chassis structure material, and vibration resistance is improved by weight. Furthermore, since each substrate is fixed to this stabilizer, vibration of the substrate itself is suppressed by the internal absorption effect.In addition, various circuit currents flow inside the amplifier, and the resulting space charge is distributed in a complex manner on the insulator. These charges adversely affect the signal circuit during reconnection. The super stabilizer is made of a conductive layer made of special carbon particles, and space charge is equalized and partial reconnection is reduced, so that a higher purity sound can be obtained.A common preamplifier has an output capacitor at the output end. However, the low frequency band was cut by the capacitor itself and the RC circuit using the input impedance and the output capacitor when connected to a power amplifier. This was a major problem especially when connected to a power amplifier with low input impedance or when multiple power amplifiers were driven in parallel.In the Super Servo Integral system, since the output capacitor is eliminated, the low-frequency time constant is determined only by the servo circuit. Therefore, flat low-frequency characteristics can be obtained even when driving with a low impedance load, and at the same time, excellent distortion characteristics are realized.By using the supplied super servo cord, the problem caused by the cable between the pre-power and the power is solved.The positive input terminal of the output amplifier detects and suppresses harmful ultra-low frequency components that cause intermodulation distortion. The negative servo amplifier cancels components caused by the resistance of the connection between the P-306RS and the cable, the resistance of the cable itself, and the inductance of the cable itself, thereby preventing interference between channels and degradation of separation.In addition, in order to eliminate the influence of diode characteristics due to contact at the pin plug part, a DC bias for idling is superimposed on the ground line to suppress non-linear characteristics and reduce IM.The servo circuit operates when the ground line is connected, and its operation can be confirmed by the Connection lamp. The effect of this servo code can be effectively combined with any general power amplifier.The equalizer amplifier has a simple one stage configuration that can handle MM to MC types. In the differential amplifier section at the front stage, two ultra-low-noise High Gm FETs are thermally coupled in a special metal case to improve thermal balance and suppress extraneous noise components. In addition, the differential section is para-connected in order to improve the overall S/N ratio by reducing the impedance of the signal system. In addition, in order to obtain wider frequency characteristics, the differential section is leased by cord connection to suppress the mirror feedback capacitance.The second stage differential amplifier and the third stage differential amplifier with current mirror ensure large bare gain, and the partial feedback by skillful pole setting realizes high gain, excellent stability and low distortion factor.The final stage is an A-class push-pull circuit, which smoothly transmits signals to the next stage amplifier at a low distortion rate even under heavy load in the high frequency range.In addition to suppressing the interference between the left and right channels, the entire power supply system is designed to be low impedance to prevent the interference caused by the power supply between the front and rear stages, thereby suppressing the occurrence of dynamic modulation.A high-speed response NF type constant voltage stabilizing circuit is used, and each circuit block is directly connected by a bus line to suppress distortion caused by interference.Onkyo's unique direct tone method is used for tone control.In this system, no tone amplifier is used and only passive elements are used to simplify the circuit. In addition, no capacitor is used in the signal circuit, which is problematic in sound quality.Equipped with a cartridge selector for the MC cartridge to maximize the performance of the cartridge. (10 ~ 40  , 3 ~ 10  )Uses a selector with a CD position.Output can be directly input in the CD position.The recording selector is only required for recording. By feeding the source to the REC pin terminal, the effect on sound quality is minimized.By adopting a mechanical structure using non-magnetic parts, the effect of harmful high-order harmonics is eliminated.High-performance special sound quality improvement type resistor is adopted.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAP-307
sections.overview: A preamplifier that employs the super servo system and direct tone control system.The newly developed super servo system for the Integra P-307 allows a sufficient margin to smoothly cut infrasound frequencies below 2 Hz in order to prevent harmful phase shift in the range of audibility.In this circuit system, a monolithic operational amplifier is used for servo operation in each stage, and capacitors are removed from the signal system (coupling and NF loop) in all stages from the input to the output of the MC amplifier.We have adopted a direct tone control method to further ensure the advantages of the Super Servo method.The tone control circuit of a general amplifier is inserted between the equalizer amplifier and the tone amplifier and has a gain of nearly 20 dB in case of tone boost. By always having this extra gain, the S/N and distortion characteristics of the tone circuit itself are affected. In addition, a buffer amplifier is inserted after the tone circuit in order to function as an impedance converter, and the characteristics are adversely affected.The direct tone control uses only an equalizer amplifier and a flat amplifier, and the tone characteristics are associated with the volume control. This realizes a configuration using all passive elements. This eliminates the need for extra gain and simplifies the configuration by eliminating the need for a buffer amplifier.In actual operation, the effect works in conjunction with the volume control, and usually shows the same change characteristics as the normal tone control. However, when the volume exceeds a certain level, the boost amount of the tone gradually decreases.The power supplies for the left and right channels are completely independent, and the entire power supply system is designed to be low impedance to prevent interference from the power supply between the front and rear stages, thereby minimizing dynamic modulation (transient intermodulation distortion).For the P-307, an NF-type constant voltage power supply stabilizing circuit is installed in each channel in order to provide a stable supply of power supply voltage and to make the power supply and distribution lines low impedance. In addition, a high-purity copper plate bus (mother ship) line is widely used, and each circuit block is directly connected directly to the low impedance supply trunk line.Non-magnetic materials are used for switches, volume bodies and shafts that are easily affected by flux.In addition, each stage is shielded by a non-magnetic material to prevent mutual interference.The equalizer amplifier section has a pre-stage cascode FET differential input, one differential stage with a current mirror, and an A-class parallel push-pull configuration for the output stage.Furthermore, in order to make the RIAA characteristics more precise, the frequency to be corrected for RIAA is divided into two. The NF type is used for the low-boost side and the CR type is used for the high-cut side. In particular, the high-frequency range is corrected with the stable CR attenuation so that there is no degradation of slew rate or blocking, and intermodulation is less.These two time-constant circuits are specialized in each band, and excellent correction accuracy is obtained in a wide band range of 10 Hz to 100 kHz.The MC amplifier circuit is switched using a special muting circuit to prevent clicks. The switch mechanism has an OFF position and an electronic delay circuit that mutes the equalizer output to prevent clicks during switching.In addition, a transient killer circuit that mutes the pre-output and equalizer output when the power switch is turned on, and a break-type read relay that instantly shunt the pre-output to protect the equipment in the subsequent stage in the event of DC leakage.The flat amplifier section consists of a cascode FET differential input with a current mirror and class A push-pull output. The unique circuit configuration is designed to withstand low impedance loads.The MC amplifier section is connected with 3-stage FET differential input to achieve low noise.The output stage is a class A parallel push-pull circuit so that it is less affected by load fluctuation and the distortion in the high frequency range is improved.We use semiconductor electronic components, various operation switches, panels and knobs, and highly accurate parts that have been carefully examined up to a single screw.Silver contacts and gold plating are applied to the main switch, relay contacts and phono terminals, respectively.
