sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAP-308
sections.overview: This is a control amplifier that is designed for full-scale digital applications, with a focus on simplification and high-purity transmission.The Direct In / Direct Out concept is thoroughly implemented and a multi-functional yet simple circuit configuration is adopted.Line-type inputs such as CD inputs are selected with the Input Selector switch and sent directly to the master volume-flat amplifier without passing through muting, balance volume, mode, etc.The tone control employs a direct tone system that uses only passive elements and part of a volume circuit, eliminating the need for tone amplifiers.In addition, both the input side and the output side are connected by direct connection with the shortest distance.Equipped with 8 input selectors and an independent double REC selector for Tape1 only and Tape2 & 3.There are two outputs, each with a MODE switch, so you can get output for 3D subwoofer or center channel playback.The Output2 is equipped with independent output attenuators on the left and right sides for simultaneous use of balance volume.The circuit configuration is a super servo amplifier with twin FET input stage and twin push-pull output stage connected directly to the input. As a material that can obtain a constant voltage of about 2 v with relatively small current, excellent characteristics are achieved by applying LED bias, which is advantageous in terms of temperature coefficient and noise generation.In order to handle very small input signals, the equalizer amplifier has a double-twin-FET configuration with a thermal stabilizer for the input stage to further reduce noise.The power supply section uses a satellite power supply for low impedance power supply, and also uses separate windings for each amplifier for exclusive block power supply to eliminate mutual interference.To eliminate noise from the power supply, a noise separator is installed between the primary and secondary sides of the power transformer to prevent common-mode noise from entering from the primary side. Normal-mode noise is eliminated by a charge noise filter.In addition, the power transformer, charge noise filter, and rectifying / smoothing block are separated from the amplifier circuit and covered with a shield case. Only the DC line is taken out to supply power to the constant voltage circuit, eliminating electromagnetic interference from the power supply.A signal-in-phase transformer is used on both input and output sides to eliminate common-mode noise from external sources and to improve separation by eliminating interference between L and R caused by ground lines of pin cords connecting devices.It uses a direct tone control circuit with a contrabus.Equipped with cartridge selector of MC2 position and MM2 position.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAP-309
sections.overview: A stereo preamplifier developed as the culmination of the "W ? Super Servo System" which is a further development of the "Super Servo System".Taking advantage of the characteristics of the super servo system originally developed by Onkyo, the gain of the equalizer amplifier is increased so that it can be used for all cartridges from MM type to MC type without using a head amplifier or step amplifier transformer.The three units of the MC head amplifier, equalizer and buffer are combined into a single stage type simple equalizer amplifier. It uses a high-current A-class amplifier comparable to a 5W-class output power amplifier, and realizes NF / CR division type equalization in one stage without a buffer amplifier.In the first stage differential amplifier section, two ultra-low noise and high Gm FETs are thermally coupled in an aluminum case to improve thermal balance and suppress external thermal noise. In addition, S/N is improved by connecting the differential section in parallel to lower impedance. In order to suppress mirror feedback capacitance, this differential amplifier is connected in cascode to expand frequency characteristics.The second stage differential amplifier and the third stage differential amplifier with current mirror ensure a large naked gain, and by using partial feedback by skillful pole setting, stability and constant distortion factor are realized.A waiting monitor is mounted on the panel surface.This monitor detects the temperature of the A-class push-pull transistor at the final stage of the equalizer and the transistor used for the power supply of the equalizer, and displays the stability of the bias after the power is turned on and the operational status of the amplifier with 5-level indicators.In order to prevent the inductance and resistance of the extension cord, contact resistance at the connection part, crosstalk, etc., W super servo system is adopted.The W ? Super Servo system suppresses cross modulation due to unnecessary ultra-low frequencies and equivalently cancels harmful noise components caused by the impedance between the earth and the ground. By using the attached servo sensor code, the distance between the pre-power and the power is electrically reduced to 0 to cancel harmful components.Direct Tone is a unique tone control method that does not affect the sound quality.Since it is composed of only passive elements and does not allow harmful capacitors to enter the signal passage path, it can freely correct sound fields without affecting sound quality.When a power amplifier with low input impedance is connected or when multiple power amplifiers are driven in parallel, problems such as shortage of extremely low frequencies tend to occur. However, by adopting the super servo system, there is no need to insert a capacitor in the output section, and the low-frequency time constant is determined only by the servo circuit, so that shortage of low frequencies is prevented regardless of the load.As for the power supply, the right and left channels are supplied with completely independent power supplies, and even within the same channel, in order to prevent interference through the power supplies at the front and rear stages, the entire power supply system is designed to be low impedance, and the generation of dynamic modulation (transient intermodulation distortion) is suppressed.In the IntegraP 309, independent NF type constant voltage stabilizing circuits are used for the left and right sides, and each circuit block is directly connected by a thick copper plate bus (bus) line.Equipped with a cartridge selector, the optimum load impedance can be switched according to the cartridge to be used.It is equipped with a recording selector so that the deck is not always connected to part of the circuit even when recording is not done.You can also record the tuner output while listening to the record.It has a built-in headphone amplifier so that you can use headphones.Various filters, muting and input selectors are stored in the kangaroo pocket.Non-magnetic materials such as copper, aluminum, and brass are used for all necessary parts including the shielding part and all other parts to suppress high-order harmonic distortion caused by magnetic flux.A self-illuminated one touch selector is used for input switching.In addition, a method of selecting by a small special audio relay is adopted, and there is no signal wiring.Equipped with a thermo-coupled register, a register with coupled thermal coefficients is used so that a delicate servo effect is always stably applied to the signal.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAP-388
sections.overview: Stereo preamplifier equipped with super balance circuit.It uses a double differential amplifier circuit that combines a flat amplifier circuit with Onkyo's original double differential amplifier circuit and double super servo. It is compatible with any balanced or unbalanced input and realizes direct and stable operation.In addition, in order to take advantage of the characteristics of the cartridge, an optimized equalizer circuit exclusively for MM/MC is adopted.By using dedicated input terminals and eliminating switching circuits, simple amplification with the minimum number of contacts is achieved.Direct Signal Flow Construction is used to simplify signal paths inside the chassis and to connect them at the shortest distance.The switching circuits for balanced and unbalanced inputs are made independent of each other, and the signal is sent to the microprocessor by the operation of the input selector for total control.In addition, the switching circuit for unbalanced input is placed near the input terminal, and the switching circuit for balanced input is placed just before the master volume to shorten the wiring.The master volume is placed on the flat amplifier input in the center of the chassis and is operated from the front panel via an extension shaft to minimize the distance of the low-level wiring.The power supply section employs a super-shunt power supply that combines a super-linear power supply and a shunt regulator, which are not affected by load fluctuations. The power supply circuit that supplies the MC equalizer amplifier, MM equalizer amplifier, flat amplifier (L), and flat amplifier (R) is mounted completely independently.This reduces AC infrastructure noise and reduces the influence on other circuits.The power transformer uses a LASER transformer with a modified core that reduces the magnetic resistance by increasing the width of the outer part. In addition, the core is carefully shielded with a silicon copper plate shield material to reduce the leakage flux to 1 / 30 compared to the conventional EI core transformer.In addition, 3 laser transformers for the flat amplifier, equalizer amplifier and control circuit are used completely independently to reduce the influence on the amplifier section that handles the signal and to eliminate interference between each stage.The layout is such that the digital control part housed in the front panel, the power supply part which supplies power to each stage, and the signal path are connected by the shortest distance.Furthermore, by adopting a 3 box structure in which each amplifier section is completely shielded, digital noise and power supply noise do not adversely affect each stage of the amplifier section.Both the volume and input selector employ a mechanical system driven by a motor. It can be controlled at hand using a remote control while suppressing the generation of non-linear distortion like semiconductor switches.Compared to conventional volumes, the master volume uses a custom-made 4-series volume made of carbon resistance with an ultra-low distortion rate of -40dB. It also uses film capacitors and other parts made by Raderstein of Germany, which was decided to use after repeated trial listening.The resistor uses parts such as a high-precision large carbon resistor (3/4W type), a 70-micron copper foil substrate, a balanced die-cast XLR type 3P connector, a gold-plated machined pin jack, an ultra-low impedance Chemicon for power supply, and an extra-thick cap-tire AC cord.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAP-855NII
sections.overview: In addition to further improving the transient response measures and dynamic characteristics of the equalizer circuit and tone circuit developed in the Integra Series, a fundamental study was also made on graining and sense of orientation in the middle and low frequency range to raise the quality of the preamplifier.A dual-channel system independent power supply is used to supply power to the left and right channels independently.This eliminates interchannel interference within the preamp and improves separation.The power supply section uses a feedback stabilized   2 power supply type constant voltage circuit with a fluctuation rate of 1.7%, so that the effect of power supply fluctuation does not appear in the circuit that performs delicate voltage amplification.For the equalizer amplifier circuit, the transient response characteristics are improved by using an operational amplifier type circuit with a single 4-chip configuration of differential 1-stage and final stage single, which was derived from detailed theoretical analysis of NF circuit.For the tone amplifier circuit, we have adopted an operational amplifier circuit with a differential 1-stage 3-chip configuration determined by circuit analysis using a computer. We have taken various measures such as selection of the optimum time constant, securing of dynamic range in open loop, and improvement of SN ratio.In the past, various elements such as the NF circuit were used to change the important rise characteristics in the middle and low frequency range, but this has been improved to realize a circuit with a good rise regardless of tone ON / OFF.A transient killer circuit using a lead relay is employed to prevent a click when the switch is turned ON or OFF.As coupling capacitors, which have a significant effect on playback sound, we use film capacitors with non-inductive extended foil structure and ultra-low leakage special electrolytic capacitors.The volume and tone are adjusted using a precision trimming attenuator volume with an interlocking error of   0.5 dB. The volume can be adjusted in 43 contacts (middle position is also possible), and the tone can be adjusted in   5 steps of 2 dB steps.In order to monitor the input of the equalizer amplifier, it has a built-in peak monitor with LED so that the clip point of the equalizer input can be monitored.There are two levels of loudness, Low only and Low & High.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAM-505
sections.overview: DC power amplifier with improved dynamic modulation (transient intermodulation distortion).In order to improve dynamic modulation, D. L. C. (Dual Line Construction) direct-coupled power supply system is adopted to eliminate not only interference between left and right channels but also interference that occurs within the same channel.For the power supply and distribution lines of each circuit, a multi-spray Bussler in held at ultra-low impedance is adopted, and extremely thick power distribution wires (cross-sectional area 5.5 mm) are used.2On the other hand, in the NF block of each stage, each branch is directly connected to the bus hotline for each point, and power is supplied to each stage individually. In addition, a 1 mm thick bus ground line is also used for the ground line, and dynamic modulation is prevented by making these supply and distribution lines low impedance.The power supply unit is also designed to have low impedance. We have developed and used a high-capacity (18,000 ? Fx4) electrolytic capacitor that maintains low impedance up to 100 kHz. This capacitor was developed especially for audio applications. It has a distortion factor of -150dB at the third harmonic level at 10 kHz, an equivalent series resistance (E. S. R.) of 0.01   or less, and a loss of tan   of 0.25 or less. It achieves low impedance.The D. L. C. system is used to reduce interference between the left and right channels by using a two channel D. L. C. system with a mono-amplifier that is independent of all circuits.The power transformer with a large laminated core maintains regulation of 160W + 160W at 4   output, and the stored energy in the power supply reaches 148 joules.A new low-noise monolithic dual FET is used for the first stage differential amplifier to form a complete DC amplifier.This newly developed FET consists of two FETs on a single pellet. The temperature characteristics and other characteristics are almost exactly the same, and the temperature difference is small because the pellet is the same. This FET is an ideal device for a DC amplifier. As a result, the temperature drift is stable within   20 mv at   30 ? for a temperature of 20 ?. In addition, since this FET uses a ceramic base, it is more moisture-resistant than a conventional dual-in-line plastic package.The first stage FET differential amplifier is an active broad of a constant current circuit with good temperature characteristics. It is designed to have a good common-mode rejection ratio. In addition, the low input impedance of the cascade connected transistor prevents the degradation of high frequency characteristics due to the feedback capacitance mirror effect.In addition, impedance conversion is performed by placing an emitter follower next, and the frequency characteristic at the first stage is extended to 2 MHz.The power stage is a pure complimentary service circuit using an NPN-PNP transistor with the same characteristics. The 3-stage Darlington connection reduces the load on the current mirror circuit of the drive stage and reduces distortion. The final stage achieves low distortion by using a TO-3 transistor with sufficient power in parallel push-pull and using it in a region with good linearity.The drive stage employs a current mirror circuit using a high-voltage transistor with low junction capacitance and high fT. This reduces distortion and makes it less susceptible to power supply voltage fluctuations.A large aluminum die-cast heat sink is used for the heat radiation part.It is equipped with a protective circuit that electronically detects the output DC voltage and the power transistor overcurrent. If there is a problem, a relay disconnects the speaker. This circuit is also in standby mode when the power is turned on and can be seen by an indicator on the front panel.Since DC may come in from the input other than when the amplifier has failed, the DC detection section is independent on the left and right sides and operates even when the DC polarity is different on the left and right sides. The overcurrent detection circuit quickly disconnects the speaker when the load is short-circuited or when the impedance is low.The power transformer incorporates a high-precision temperature switch and a thermal fuse in each of the left and right sides. In the event of an abnormal temperature rise due to overload or failure, the power is turned off and the speaker relay is turned off. When the transformer cools down to normal temperature, they automatically recover and the thermal fuse does not blow during normal operation.The switch on the rear panel allows you to switch the lower cutoff frequency from DC to 0.15 Hz to 10 Hz.In the DC position, there is no capacitor in the signal path or NF loop from input to output, and it is a complete DC amplifier. In the 0.15 Hz position, it can be connected to a preamp with a DC leak, which cannot be connected to a DC amplifier. The coupling capacitor used for this is a low-distortion, low-loss special chemical capacitor selected by hearing with a particular emphasis on sound quality, so its performance in the audible band hardly changes.The 10 Hz position is used as a subsonic filter to prevent the cone paper from swaying during disc playback.Left and right independent level volume is mounted on the rear panel.

sections.overview: A stereo power amplifier that adopts the W / Super Servo system.The W / Super Servo system is used to cancel the feedback of harmful components from both the + side and - side of the output terminal via the servo amplifier.The + side cancels the ultra-low frequency component that is superimposed on the music signal and flows into the speaker to suppress harmful intermodulation. The - side servo loop suppresses the electromotive force caused by the impedance between the input ground and the output ground side, the internal resistance of the power supply capacitor, the impedance of the lead wire, etc., and only the music signal is sent to the output terminal.By servocontrol both ends of the output side, the components of impurities, harmful noise and distortion that have masked the music signal are eliminated to improve the resolution.Output stage is 3-stage Darlington configuration, high-fTBy using a power transistor, an output with less distortion is achieved. In addition, the operating characteristic of the power transistor is Onkyo's unique linear switching method to further improve the distortion factor.This system was developed with the intention of taking advantage of the characteristics of A class while taking advantage of the advantages of B class, focusing on the fact that only the final output stage works as B class in amplifiers. It is a system with linear characteristics developed under the design policy that bias must be fixed. It is a high-f type system with linear characteristics.TIt demonstrates excellent performance when combined with a power transistor.As a result of research on the influence on sound quality, we have newly developed a large twin-winded transformer for the power supply section. As a result of careful listening and investigation of the correlation between material properties in consideration of its importance, we have used a multi-tab type low-impedance wide-range Chemi-Con as a low-inductance circuit directly connected to a printed circuit board.In addition, bus (bus) lines are used for the power supply / distribution to each section and the ground line, etc. to achieve a thorough low impedance.When there is a sudden change from a continuous large amplitude operation to a small amplitude operation, a thermal gradient occurs due to the difference in heat capacity between the final blocks. This sudden partial temperature change makes the bias current value of the power section unstable and affects the reproduction of a low-level signal in particular.As a countermeasure against this problem, the M-506 has a 3-point sensing bias circuit in the output stage, detects the temperature difference between the pre-driver, driver and power transistor, and controls the bias, ensuring stable low-distortion drive.The protection circuit uses a monolithic IC to improve stability. It also detects DC leakage voltage at the speaker terminals and overcurrent in the power stage. In the event of an emergency, it instantly shuts off the relay (silver contact, parallel use) to protect the circuit components.For speaker switching, the protection relay dedicated to SP-1 and SP-2 is switched to prevent degradation of the damping factor. Also, the low-pass filter for DC voltage detection is independent of LR so that it operates even when the polarity of the left and right is different.It employs a large peak meter that performs logarithmic compression and peak hold with a stable monolithic IC.In addition, to obtain high-speed response, it is driven by a dedicated drive circuit using an operational amplifier.The level can be changed from 0 dB to 120W or 12W with the front switch.From semiconductor devices and transformers, to resistors and capacitors, printed circuit boards, lead wires for wiring, to solder for fusion bonding, we have repeatedly conducted thorough examinations through interviews.

sections.overview: This is a Super Servo / Integral Stereo Power Amplifier that analyzes the amplifier not only as a single electric circuit but also including the acoustic aspect of the playback sound field, and thoroughly investigates the problem of time difference distortion.In addition to Onkyo's original W / Super Servo system, Super Servo Integral system is used to reduce the influence of the electromotive force of the speaker.When the voice coil of the speaker vibrates, an electromotive force is generated in the coil, a microphone effect, which affects the playback sound. The Super Servo Integral Method employs a circuit that reduces the effect of this electromotive force to -20dB or less. Positive and negative feedback is applied only to the current amplification stage by the linearity correction circuit, and the linearity of this stage is dramatically improved, and time difference distortion is suppressed.The final transistor operates using a linear switching method.Similar to class B operation, this method is amplified by two transistors. In this case, the linearity of the joint of the operation curve is corrected by a special bias circuit to obtain linear operation characteristics. As a result, crossover distortion is reduced, and characteristics close to class A operation can be obtained while maintaining the advantage of class B operation.And High fTBy using a power transistor, the switching distortion is suppressed to a negligible range.It is equipped with a large peak meter in which logarithmic compression and peak hold are performed by a monolithic IC with good stability and dispersion between right and left is suppressed.In order to obtain high-speed response, it is driven by a dedicated meter drive circuit using an operational amplifier, and the level can be switched from 0 dB to 130W or 13W with a front switch.A monolithic IC is used for the protection circuit to improve stability, detect DC leak voltage appearing at the speaker terminal and overcurrent of the power stage, and shut off the relay to protect circuit components in case of emergency.A highly reliable gold-plated silver contact relay is used for the speaker switching relay, and the use of para-connection prevents the damping factor from deteriorating.The low-pass filter for DC voltage detection is also independent on the left and right sides, so that it can operate even when the polarity of the left and right sides are different.A twin-wide type large power transformer is used for the power supply section, and a multi-tab type low-impedance wide-range Chemi-Con is used as a low-inductance circuit directly connected to a bus earth for the Chemi-Con for rectification after careful consideration.In addition, the power supply / distribution to each section and the ground line are designed to be low impedance.It uses an autotracking bias system that detects local temperature changes in each part and provides a stable bias supply.

sections.overview: Stereo power amplifier using super turbo system.Newly developed super turbo system is adopted.This system combines a delta turbo circuit and a turbo filter circuit to suppress the modulation noise caused by the power transformer, expand the dynamic dynamic range by more than 20 dB, cut the harmonic noise caused by the flux generated by the transformer, and eliminate various electrical noise entering from the outside of the amplifier.The delta turbo circuit is designed to prevent modulation noise caused by + - imbalance in the power supply when a low frequency signal of 100 Hz or less is input.In the conventional power supply, only the positive and negative sides of the B power supply Chemi-Con and transformer windings, which supply power depending on whether the waveform of the signal flowing into the speaker is positive or negative, worked separately. Especially when the audio signal is 100 Hz or less, the power supply on one side, for example, the Chemi-Con on the negative side is off while the Chemi-Con on the positive side is being charged, and the charging current returns to the transformer through the midpoint. In the delta turbo circuit, the diode is turned off while the amplitude of the audio signal is small. Therefore, even while the positive side is being charged, the power supply flows into the Chemi-Con on the negative side without passing through the midpoint. As a result, the Chemi-Con on the negative side is charged up. Even if the voltage on the positive side drops due to the supply of power to the speaker, the voltage on the negative side rises reversely and the voltage fluctuation with respect to the voltage across the transformer is relatively small. This reduces the amplitude modulation of the charging current and suppresses the generation of modulation noise.In addition, in this circuit, the diodes are delta-connected, so that the modulation noise does not flow only to the ground point of the circuit, even if the diode is turned on during high-power operation.The turbo filter circuit is designed to prevent the modulation noise generated by the magnitude of the signal regardless of the frequency of the signal. The function of the circuit is to limit the harmonic spectrum generated by the pulse waveform supplied from the power transformer to only the amount necessary for the Chemi-Con charging.There are two types of modulation noise generated by the harmonic spectrum. One type flows into the amplifier through the power supply line, and the other type flows out into the amplifier as magnetic flux from the power transformer. Especially in the micro-level amplification system in the amplifier, the noise voltage induced by this flux is generated, and it stains the original music signal. Furthermore, since this flux varies in proportion to the signal magnitude, it appears as signal information in the sense of hearing, and it has been considered to be the limit of the resolution of reproduced sound. In the turbo filter circuit, the modulation noise component is suppressed according to the turbo filter optimum attenuation characteristics, and the necessary charging energy is sent to the Chemicon.This turbo filter circuit has a special CR filter placed in the power transformer. The inductance of this CR and transformer constitutes an equivalent circuit filter as shown below.Another function of the turbo filter is to suppress modulation noise and prevent various types of noise from the external AC power supply from entering the power supply section, thereby reducing the difference in sound quality depending on the polarity of the AC power supply.Super Servo Integral System is adopted.The microphone effect occurs when the voice coil of the speaker vibrates. This electromotive force is always generated as long as the coil vibrates in a magnetic field. It cannot be fundamentally cancelled. In addition, this electromotive force affects the playback sound when the input signal of the speaker collides with this electromotive force. Especially in stereo sound fields, the sound reproduced from the R channel travels through the air and reaches the L channel speaker. With this sound pressure, the diaphragm of the L channel speaker vibrates. Moreover, there is a time lag for the sound to propagate between the two speakers. When an electromotive force different from the input signal that is generated enters the power stage, if the linearity of the power stage is not good, time difference distortion occurs between the input signal of the L channel and the input signal of the power stage, and this has a large effect on the playback sound.In the Super Servo Integral Method, the generation of intermodulation distortion caused by this electromotive force is reduced to less than 1/10 (-20dB or more). The time difference distortion is not a problem as long as the linearity of the current amplification stage including the power stage is ensured. Therefore, in the conventional amplifier, NF is applied to correct the non-linear part of the current amplification stage, and the part which cannot be corrected by NF is corrected by the W super servo of the + side servo for ultra-low frequency and the - side servo for the ground line, so that it has some effect. In the Super Servo Integral Method, this idea is further advanced, the characteristics of the current amplification stage are greatly improved, and on top of that, the same correction as in the past is carried out to improve the time difference distortion.Specifically, we apply positive and negative feedback by a linearity correction circuit only to the current amplifier stage from the output stage outlet, and improve the linearity of this stage to suppress time difference distortion.Onkyo's original linear switching system is adopted.The linear switching method is a B-class circuit with a fixed bias, but it was developed with the aim of being equal to the A-class circuit in terms of sound quality. It has a simple circuit configuration using simple circuit elements, but the crossover distortion is kept low and there is no change in sound quality due to bias fluctuations.In addition, the use of high-fT power transistors keeps switching distortion within a negligible range.Two large twin-winded power transformers are used for the power supply section, and a multi-tab type low-impedance, wide-range condenser is used as a low-inductance circuit directly connected to a bus earth for the rectifier capacitor.In addition, the power supply / distribution lines and ground lines of each section are designed to have low impedance.Equipped with a large peak meter.Logarithmic compression and peak hold are performed by a monolithic IC with good stability, and there is almost no variation in left / right indication. In addition, to obtain high-speed response, it is driven by a dedicated meter drive circuit using an operational amplifier.The level can be changed from 0 dB to 140W or 14W with the front switch.Equipped with an auto-tracking bias system to ensure stable operation.When there is a sudden change from a continuous large amplitude operation to a small amplitude operation with a music signal, the thermal gradient occurs due to the difference in heat capacity between the final blocks. In the case of a gradual temperature change, each part is affected in the same way, so there is no problem. However, in the case of a sudden change, the bias current value of the power section becomes unstable, which affects the reproduction of a low-level signal in particular.The M-506RS has a 3-point sensing bias circuit at the output stage, detects the temperature difference between the three points of the pre-driver stage, driver section and power transistor, and controls the bias to achieve stable low distortion rate drive at all times.The protection circuit uses a monolithic IC to increase reliability, and detects DC leakage voltage at the speaker terminals and power stage overcurrent. In the event of an emergency, the relay is instantly shut off to protect circuit components.In addition, a highly reliable gold-plated silver contact relay is used for the speaker switching relay to prevent damping degradation by using parallel connection.In addition, it is equipped with a low-pass filter for LR independent DC voltage detection that works even when the left and right polarities are different.

sections.overview: Stereo power amplifier using super servo system.Onkyo's proprietary Super Servo System eliminates harmful ultra-low frequency components and improves low frequency transient response, which is a problem with DC amplifiers.In addition to the NF circuit, this system consists of a servo loop that combines a low-frequency amplifier and a phase inversion circuit. The servo feedback lowers the output impedance below the cutoff frequency, causing the output circuit to shunt. This reduces the harmful ultra-low frequency components generated in the amplifier (inside the amplifier) and the back electromotive force flowing from the speaker to the amplifier.This super servo system is different from the system in which a capacitor is inserted in the output circuit or the low-frequency cut is performed by utilizing the characteristics of the output transformer. It is free from problems of S/N and distortion factor due to the capacitor, sound quality degradation due to magnetic saturation distortion of the iron core, and instability due to applying deep NF, and it is free from the problem of S/N and distortion factor due to the capacitor, and it is free from the instability caused by applying deep NF. The capacitor is designed with extremely low characteristics such as the third harmonic level of -150dB at 10 kHz distortion rate, equivalent series resistance (ESR) of 0.01   or less and loss tan   of 0.25 or less.In addition, the power supply and distribution lines from the power supply to each block and the ground line are made of copper sheets for low impedance, thereby achieving high stability of the whole system.In addition, the AC100V power cord adopts a cab-tire type in consideration of the voltage drop at re-output.To prevent interference and feedback effects between circuits, a non-magnetic aluminum chassis is used for the chassis where the signal system is connected.A large high-speed peak meter is used.The temperature of the meter is compensated by a logarithmic compression circuit made into a monolithic IC and a special resistance element to prevent accuracy and deviation of indication error with time.The speaker output circuit is designed to have low resistance so as not to have excess resistance, and a total of four silver contact relays are used for the switching part.

sections.title: ONKYO M-510
sections.overview:
850,000 (released in 1984)  900,000 (around 1991)

This is a stereo power amplifier developed using technologies such as the double-trans drive system to enable the ultimate music playback.In a general amplifier, the current that is out of phase due to the characteristics of the speaker is returned to the amplifier through flux, ground, or B power supply. This out-of-phase signal is superimposed on the input signal, and the mixed phase acts as the input signal. Therefore, the correct phase information originally contained in music information is disturbed, and the sound field feeling that produces a subtle phase difference is also disturbed.The M-510 is equipped with an in-phase transformer in the current path to prevent out-of-phase components from returning to the amplifier. In this in-phase transformer, when a current with a waveform on the positive side flows, the current with the same waveform flows on the negative side with exactly opposite phases. This allows the positive side and the negative side to mutually control each other, canceling only the extra components that come back on the power supply current. This improves low-frequency braking and provides excellent low-frequency playback.In addition, the in-phase transformer suppresses the overburden of the flux generated from the power supply and improves the low-level regeneration capability.By separating the left and right power transformers and using another transformer for the power supply other than the signal system, there are three power transformers. In addition, the right and left power circuits are equipped with in-phase transformers, so there are five transformers in total.Four capacitors of 33000 ? F/100V are used for the power supply section, and a unique vibration isolation structure is used for fixing.This system takes note of the fact that sound changes depending on the position and material of the belt that fixes the condenser. sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAM-588
sections.overview: Stereo power amplifier with super balance circuit.It is equipped with a super balance circuit created by combining Onkyo's original double differential amplifier circuit and double super servo circuit. By this, it can handle both balance input and unbalanced input, balance load and unbalanced load without requiring a conversion circuit.Double Super Servo Technology shifts the reference potential of the output signal so that a constant gain and maximum output can always be obtained even when one of the outputs is grounded.Not only the power amplifier section but also the input switching, level control and meter circuit are completely independent of each other using twin monoconstruction.The L/R component layout is completely separated from the center of the chassis to the left and right, and the power amplifier and power supply are separated from the L/R circuit board, so that the characteristics are symmetrical.To minimize the signal path inside the chassis and keep it ideal, the power supply is located in the front of the chassis to minimize the path from the input terminal to the output terminal and to minimize the negative effect of power supply noise on the small-level signal area.In addition, there is no input level control at the balance input terminal so that it can be directly connected to a preamplifier, etc. to prevent degradation of sound quality.The power supply section employs a multi-chemicon system (20,800 ? F per one channel) in which four low-impedance electrolytic capacitors wound with low-magnification foils are connected in parallel in order to improve the power supply response speed characteristics, thereby improving the power supply capability.In addition, a bridge rectifier diode with a large capacity (15A), approximately 2.5 times larger than the conventional diode, has been adopted for the diode, and the loss is reduced by operating the element with a margin, and the source impedance is kept low.In addition, a large LASER transformer is placed symmetrically away from the signal system to suppress the interference of leakage flux (magnetic induction).In addition to laser transformer, the leakage flux is reduced to less than 1/30 by using a modified EI core with a wide outer periphery to reduce the magnetic resistance, a silicon copper plate shield material around the core to provide a tight shield, and an iron case that also serves as a shield.The peak program meter is used for the fluctuation of the indicator of the power meter, which is controlled so that the rise time is quick and the return time is a little slow. The power display scale can directly read the power at 8   load, and the digital bell display is also available.In addition, it uses an automatic range adjuster to automatically determine the dynamic range of the music signal and set the power meter pointer to the most readable range.Based on the x0. 1 range (0 dB = 20W), if the output of the 8   load exceeds 40W (+ 3 dB in the x0. 1 range), the range is instantly switched to the x1 range (0 dB = 200W). After that, if the output does not exceed 40W for several seconds, the range returns from the x1 range to the x0. 1 range.In addition, when a large input is suddenly input, the range is switched to the x1 range to prevent the meter from shaking out. When the output is small, the range is set to the x0. 1 range.To achieve complete L/R separation, the meter circuit includes a dedicated circuit for L/R including the power supply circuit.In addition, L/R is shared only for control circuits requiring synchronization such as range switching, and L/R is electrically separated by optical transmission of control signals.In addition, in the protector circuit, sensors for detecting overloads and DC component leakage are L/R independent, and optical transmission is performed between common protector circuits to reduce mutual interference between channels.It uses carefully selected parts, including a custom-made detent volume with sound quality measures such as a carbon resistor with an ultra-low distortion rate of 40 dB, a gold-plated slider, a non-magnetic interstage shield, and a high internal loss brass shaft, a film condenser procured from Germany, a large carbon resistor, a copper foil 70 ? m thick substrate, a gold-plated machined pin jack, and an extremely thick cabtire AC cord.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-705DC
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with 2 DC configuration that is a DC version of the equalizer amplifier and power amplifier.The equalizer amplifier section is composed of differential amplification and interstage current mirror circuit using low-noise FET at the first stage, front three stage amplification and rear two stage differential amplification including A-class push-pull at the last stage. The high capacitance capacitors in the input side and NF loop are removed, and all capacitors in the circuit are selected from non-inductive film capacitors and high-quality audio capacitors to obtain high characteristics.In addition, the RIAA compensation uses the same NF / CR split circuit as the A-708DC, eliminating intermodulation caused by the slew rate in the high-frequency range. As a result, high-purity sound quality is obtained without sound distortion even in the case of a pulsed signal.The power amplifier uses the same 2-stage cascade drive and 3-stage Darlington connection DC configuration as the A-708DC.For the DC drift of the speaker terminal voltage, which is the most important in DC amplifier, a low-noise monolithic dual FET which has the same characteristics as the first stage differential amplifier is used to construct a stable DC amplifier.The power supply section employs a bus earth system that reduces the potential difference in the ground line across the entire circuit. It also employs a smoothing capacitor with an ESR (equivalent series resistance) of 0.01   or less that maintains low impedance up to the ultra-high frequency band of 100 kHz. In addition, the power supply fluctuation rate is 0.1% or less and the ripple rejection ratio is 80 dB. From a constant voltage power supply dedicated to the pre-section, the power supply is directly connected to the equalizer and each branch by a multi-spray bus line.This prevents interference within the same channel and between the left and right channels.The tone control amplifier section of both Bass and Treble can be adjusted more finely by switching the turnover frequencies between two stages (with a defeat).As for the circuit configuration, an NF variation type of differential 1-stage operational amplifier configuration is adopted to obtain accurate variation characteristics. In order to stick to the concept of DC & DC, non-inductive film capacitors and low distortion audio capacitors are used for all capacitors.In the unlikely event that a DC voltage appears on the output, the left and right independent detectors electronically detect it and instantly disconnect the speakers to protect them. This circuit also acts as a transient killer to prevent clicks when the power is turned on.For the speaker protection relay, a gold-plated silver contact relay is used as a 2-contact para-type to suppress the deterioration of damping caused by contact resistance. The input selector is directly embedded in the printed circuit board to prevent the deterioration of sound quality caused by the extension of the shield wire.In order to keep the bias current value of the power amplifier stable, a newly developed autotracking bias method is adopted.This is a 3-point sensing bias circuit for the pre-driver, driver and output stage. It prevents bias fluctuations caused by the temperature difference between the driver and the power transistor when switching from continuous large-amplitude operation to pianissimo reproduction, and enables stable low-distortion drive.Equipped with a 2-stage switching low filter that can switch the low cutoff of the power section to DC and 0.1 Hz.At DC, it operates as a DC amplifier without any capacitor in the signal system of the power section and NF. At 0.1 Hz position, it is an AC power amplifier with cutoff of 0.1 Hz and can be connected to other preamplifiers with DC leakage.Equipped with a power amplifier gain 3-stage switching function, the gain can be changed over 3 stages of 0 db, -10dB and -20dB.The s / N ratio for practical use can be improved by lowering the gain of the power section when low volume.The Phono input terminal is gold-plated.The volume is equipped with a low strain rate attenuator with a multi-slider enclosed in a tight die-cast body.Since it is continuously variable and trimless, there is no distortion due to current concentration action, and the interlocking error is within 0.5 dB up to 70 dB.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-708DC
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with 2 DC configuration that is a DC version of the equalizer amplifier and power amplifier.The RIAA compensation in the equalizer amplifier section is divided into two types in terms of frequency, high and low. The NF type is used for low boost and the CR type is used for high cut. The CR attenuation is used to compensate for high frequencies, so there is no problem with slew rate or blocking, and intermodulation is reduced.In addition, since these two time-constant circuits handle each band, an excellent accuracy of   0.2 dB RIAA deviation between 10 and 100 kHz is achieved.The power amplifier section is DC configuration, low-noise monolithic dual FET is used for the first stage differential amplifier, 2-stage cascade drive system and 3-stage Darlington connection output stage are adopted to obtain good linearity and stable characteristics over the whole range, and the DC drift of the speaker terminal voltage is within   20 mv at   30 ? relative to the temperature of 20 ?.Also, switching distortion, which is common in B-class amplifiers, is minimized by driving a power transistor with a high transition frequency fT with a constant voltage drive.The power supply uses a bus-earth (bus line) system that reduces the potential difference in the ground line across the entire circuit.In addition, a smoothing capacitor of E. S. R. (equivalent series resistance) 0.01   or less that maintains low impedance up to the ultra-high frequency band of 100 kHz, and a constant voltage circuit for the pre-section that is independent of the left and right channels with a voltage fluctuation rate of 0.1% or less and ripple rejection ratio of 80 dB. The D. L. C direct-coupled power supply system that has been cultivated in the past Integra has been adopted. This system prevents mutual interference between the circuits in the front and rear stages of the same channel and between the left and right channels, and also prevents mutual interference between the circuits in the front and rear stages of the same channel and between the left and right channels. It is combined with a DC & DC circuit to improve the rise characteristics of the low-frequency range and secure a sufficient peak power.For tone control, fine frequency adjustment is possible by two step switching of turnover frequency (with defeat).The circuit configuration is a 4-chip configuration (actually 5 chips) using a pair transistor in the first stage. In addition to eliminating the large capacitor of the emitter, a low-distortion film capacitor is also used for the small capacitor (1 ? F and 10 ? F) of the NF loop.This makes it possible to control the sound with less degradation even when the tone is turned on.We have further developed the concept of DC & DC, in which high-capacity Chemicon was removed from the NF system of equalizer and power amplifier. We have removed highly strained Chemicon from all signal systems as well as interstage coupling. We have also carefully selected low-distortion non-inductive film capacitors for small-capacity capacitors.As a protective circuit, it is equipped with a speaker relay that detects the DC voltage contained in the output and the overcurrent of the power transistor in a purely electronic manner and disconnects the speaker in the event of an emergency. This relay also functions as a transient killer that prevents a click when the power is turned on. Its operation can be confirmed by an indicator on the front panel.The DC voltage detection section is independent on the left and right sides, so that it can operate even when the DC polarity is different on the left and right sides. The overcurrent detection circuit can quickly disconnect the speaker when the load is short-circuited or when the circuit is overloaded due to a low impedance load.The relay uses a gold-plated silver contact type with low contact resistance.Considering the use of MC cartridge, low noise MC head amplifier of A-class push-pull configuration is mounted.The switches that are important for sound quality, such as input selectors and speaker switches, are embedded directly in the printed circuit board or are switched in close proximity to the terminals to reduce S/N and crosstalk caused by interference from the routing of shield wires, as well as damping caused by an increase in the resistance of the speaker circuit.The power section is a DC amplifier, but the cut-off frequency of the lower range can be changed to DC-0. 1Hz-30Hz with the Cut-off FREQ switch.In the DC position, there is no capacitor in the signal path or NF loop from the input to the output of the power section. The 0.1 Hz position is used as an AC amplifier with a cutoff of 0.1 Hz, and the 30 Hz position is used as a normal subsonic filter.In order to bring out the performance of the cartridge, the load impedance of the MM cartridge can be switched to 3 stages with Phono1.In order to keep the bias current value of the power amplifier stable, a newly developed autotracking bias method is adopted.This is a 3-point sensing bias circuit for the pre-driver, driver and output stage. It prevents bias fluctuations caused by the temperature difference between the driver and the power transistor when switching from continuous large-amplitude operation to pianissimo reproduction, and enables stable low-distortion drive.Equipped with a power amplifier gain 3-stage switching function, the gain can be changed over 3 stages of 0 db, -10dB and -20dB.The s / N ratio for practical use can be improved by lowering the gain of the power section when low volume.The Phono input terminal is gold-plated.The volume is equipped with a low strain rate attenuator with a multi-slider enclosed in a tight die-cast body.Since it is continuously variable and trimless, there is no distortion due to current concentration action, and the interlocking error is within 0.5 dB up to 70 dB.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-722MKII_150
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier is the top model of the MKII series, and is intended to improve sound quality by clarifying problems in the tone amplifier section.A wide dynamic range source for the equalizer's allowable input, it is compatible with sources with a wide dynamic range.In tone amplifiers, various elements, including the NF circuit that controls tone characteristics, change the rise and fall characteristics of middle and low frequencies, which adversely affect sound quality. This part of the MKII series that had been overlooked in the past has been thoroughly clarified by computer simulation and various problems have been solved.In the tone amplifier, a variable ? circuit is inserted in the NF circuit to give tone characteristics, and it has four time constants in the ultra-low frequency range. If this time constant is not carefully selected, a flat amplifier with excellent feedback stability cannot be realized. In the MKII series, a circuit that is advantageous to ensure feedback stability in a sufficiently low frequency range is selected and adopted, and a stable circuit with a large phase margin is realized.In addition, in order to keep the high-pass cutoff high with a simple circuit while taking into consideration the balance between the high-pass and low-pass, and to ensure sufficient dynamic range even with a simple configuration, we have adopted a unique 2-stage circuit with a differential 1-stage emitter grounding.In order to improve the signal-to-noise ratio, we have selected a PNP type transistor for the tone amplifier section, which has less 1/f noise due to its structure, and set the impedance level at the best point of the noise characteristic of the transistor.In order to eliminate adverse effects of power supply voltage fluctuations, a differential circuit is used for the tone circuit, which is less affected by voltage fluctuations. In addition, the voltage is supplied through a   2 power supply type low voltage circuit with a voltage fluctuation rate of 1.7%, which prevents intermodulation due to voltage fluctuations in the power amplifier section.Pure complimentary service with improved transient response characteristics in all stages Technologies developed in the conventional Integra series, such as power amplifiers with all stages connected directly, and operational amplifier type equalizer circuits, have also been introduced.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-722NII_160
sections.overview: This is the top-of-the-line model of the Integra NII series. It was developed with the aim of thoroughly improving the rise characteristics of the middle and low sound range and accurately reproducing the presence and sense of orientation by vector analysis of the separation characteristics.In order to improve the separation of the pre-main amplifier in the NII series, the correlation between the vector analysis of the separation characteristics and the audibility is thoroughly clarified. The NII series is designed so that the absolute value of the separation is kept to a value that is sufficiently negligible, and the phase is around which the most natural audibility can be obtained.The power supply section uses a 1.6 mm thick bare earth line made of pure copper and a 5.5 mm copper wire equivalent to five 50-core wires, and two 18,000 ? F electrolytic capacitors dedicated to the power supply with low earth impedance.As a result, the rise and fall of the middle and low frequencies, which are important for the excitement of the basic rhythm of music, are improved.The power amplifier circuit employs a single-stage differential constant-current drive OTL circuit that has been developed to reduce the rise characteristics and distortion, especially to improve linearity.Linearity (h), especially for the driver stageFEAnd high frequency characteristics (CobF)TThe power band width characteristic, which greatly affects audibility, has been extended up to 100 kHz.The tone amplifier circuit is an operational amplifier type circuit with a differential 1-stage 3-chip configuration.By selecting an optimum time constant, ensuring a dynamic range in an open loop, and improving the SN ratio, we have achieved a low-distortion design with excellent response characteristics regardless of tone ON / OFF.The equalizer circuit uses an operational amplifier composed of four single-stage differential amplifiers for one stage and final stage.The power supply of the preamplifier uses a feedback-stabilized   2-conductor Minamoto no Sadamu voltage circuit with a fluctuation rate of 1.7%. This circuit is carefully designed to avoid the influence of power supply fluctuations.The volume control and tone control use a precision trimming Attenuator volume with an interlocking error of   0.5 dB.Volume can be freely set in the middle position with 43 contacts, and tone can be adjusted in 10 2 dB steps.

sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier of the mkII series, which is an improved version of the Integra A-755 with a new design.In tone amplifiers, various elements, including the NF circuit that controls tone characteristics, change the rise and fall characteristics of middle and low frequencies, which adversely affect sound quality. This part of the MKII series that had been overlooked in the past has been thoroughly clarified by computer simulation and various problems have been solved.In the tone amplifier, a variable ? circuit is inserted in the NF circuit to give tone characteristics, and it has four time constants in the ultra-low frequency range. If this time constant is not carefully selected, a flat amplifier with excellent feedback stability cannot be realized. In the MKII series, a circuit that is advantageous to ensure feedback stability in a sufficiently low frequency range is selected and adopted, and a stable circuit with a large phase margin is realized.In addition, in order to keep the high-pass cutoff high with a simple circuit while taking into consideration the balance between the high-pass and low-pass, and to ensure sufficient dynamic range even with a simple configuration, we have adopted a unique 2-stage circuit with a differential 1-stage emitter grounding.In order to improve the signal-to-noise ratio, we have selected a PNP type transistor for the tone amplifier section, which has less 1/f noise due to its structure, and set the impedance level at the best point of the noise characteristic of the transistor.In order to eliminate adverse effects of power supply voltage fluctuations, a differential circuit is used for the tone circuit, which is less affected by voltage fluctuations. In addition, the voltage is supplied through a   2 power supply type low voltage circuit with a voltage fluctuation rate of 1.7%, which prevents intermodulation due to voltage fluctuations in the power amplifier section.Pure complimentary service with improved transient response characteristics in all stages Technologies developed in the conventional Integra series, such as power amplifiers with all stages connected directly, and operational amplifier type equalizer circuits, have also been introduced.The wood case was sold separately as an option.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-805
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier was developed by putting new circuit know-how such as direct tone into the core of the super servo system.The super servo system controls the DC amplifier with the built-in servo amplifier.In addition to the NF loop of the amplifier, a servo loop is formed by combining a low-frequency amplifier and a phase inversion circuit. The frequency below the cutoff frequency (1 Hz) is completely shut out by the servo operation circuit.As a result, not only the harmful ultra-low frequency components generated inside the amplifier but also the low-frequency counter-electromotive force that flows from the speaker to the amplifier is osae komi, and the operation of the amplifier, especially on the bias side, is very stable.In addition, DC leakage, which generates DC voltage at the speaker output due to drift (drift of circuit operation with time), which was the fate of conventional DC amplifiers, is also suppressed to a low level.In addition, it consists of only an equalizer amplifier and a power amplifier. The Tone Control Special uses a direct tone control method with volume control and a related loudness circuit to achieve a simple circuit structure and superior performance.The power amplifier consists of a high-Gm monolithic dual J-FET, cascode bootstrap circuit + current mirror push-pull + constant current load Class A predriver + 3-stage Darlington single push-pull output.As a result, we succeeded in increasing the power gain by 20 dB while keeping the distortion factor lower.In addition, by adopting the super servo system using the servo operational amplifier, the DC drift is rather smaller than the conventional one in spite of the gain increase.Linear switching system with very low switching distortion comparable to A-class operation is adopted for the output and transistor operating characteristics.The linear switching method is similar to class AB using two transistors in terms of circuit structure, but by performing a special bias correction, the connecting part between the two operating characteristics is smoothly coupled, so that one operating characteristic is very linear.Coupled with the use of high-ft power transistors, switching distortion is greatly reduced.A bus (bus) line with low DC resistance is used for the feed line from the power supply to each block and the ground line to achieve low impedance of the power supply.This prevents interference between the left and right channels and between the same channel.In order to keep the bias current value of the power amplifier stable, which has a significant effect on the reproduction of the low-level signal, we have adopted a 3-point sensing bias circuit that detects the temperature difference between the three points of the pre-driver, driver, and output stage, and keeps the specified bias value constant.When switching from large amplitude operation to pianissimo reproduction, bias fluctuation caused by temperature difference between driver and power transistor with different heat capacity is prevented, and stable low-distortion drive is achieved.The phono terminals, which handle weak input signals, are gold-plated to keep contact resistance low. The selector switches and speaker switches are all directly connected to the terminals so that they can be switched in close proximity to the terminals to prevent noise from being picked up or interfering with each other.The protection circuit includes a transient killer circuit unique to Integra that reduces unpleasant noise after power is turned on, and a high-speed response protection circuit that instantly cuts the output circuit and protects the speakers in the event of a DC leak.In addition to the 4-system input selector, it is equipped with a convenient recording selector.This lets you select a recording source independent of the source of the Input Selector during playback.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAA-808
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier was developed by installing a super servo system in both the pre-amplifier and power amplifier sections and by investing new circuit know-how such as direct tone.The super servo system controls the DC amplifier with the built-in servo amplifier.In addition to the NF loop of the amplifier, a servo loop is formed by combining a low-frequency amplifier and a phase inversion circuit. The frequency below the cutoff frequency (1 Hz) is completely shut out by the servo operation circuit.As a result, not only the harmful ultra-low frequency components generated inside the amplifier but also the low-frequency counter-electromotive force that flows from the speaker to the amplifier is osae komi, and the operation of the amplifier, especially on the bias side, is very stable.In addition, DC leakage, which generates DC voltage at the speaker output due to drift (drift of circuit operation with time), which was the fate of conventional DC amplifiers, is also suppressed to a low level.In addition, it consists of only an equalizer amplifier and a power amplifier. The Tone Control Special uses a direct tone control method with volume control and a related loudness circuit to achieve a simple circuit structure and superior performance.In order to prevent the occurrence of harmful phase shift in the range of audibility, a newly developed super servo system for the A-808 is adopted, and a preamplifier which smoothly cuts the very low frequency of 2 Hz or less is adopted.The servo operation is performed by a monolithic operational amplifier, and the signal system (coupling and NF loop) from the inlet to the output of the preamplifier does not contain any capacitor.The Super Servo system was developed with the objective of reducing drift, eliminating coupling capacitors, and eliminating unwanted ultra-low frequency components that lead to low frequency dullness.In addition, by adopting the direct tone method, it is a completely direct connection method in which no capacitor enters the signal path even when the tone circuit is turned on.In the case of an ordinary DC amplifier, increasing the gain of the power amplifier inevitably increases the DC drift, and there was a limit. However, in the A-808, we have succeeded in increasing the power gain by 20 dB while keeping the distortion rate lower with the circuit configuration of high-Gm monolithic dual J-FET + cascode bootstrap circuit + current mirror push-pull + emitter follower buffer + constant current load Class A predriver + 3-stage Darlington single push-pull output.In addition, the adoption of a super servo system using a servo operational amplifier has reduced DC drift to a lower level than before despite the gain increase.Thus, the tone amplifier is omitted.It employs a linear switching system with operating characteristics of the output transistor of the power amplifier section that are equivalent to those of class A operation with very little switching distortion.The circuit configuration is similar to class AB using two transistors. In addition, a SBD (ultra-fast rectifier diode) is used for the rectifier circuit of the read / write amplifier system power supply to reduce pulse-like noise. sections.overview: Stereo cassette deck with die-cast mounting and reverse head.We have developed and installed a diecast-mounted reverse head that inverts the recording / reproducing head and the erasing head in one unit. In addition, bias and azimuth are equalized and adjusted independently in both directions to eliminate electrical / mechanical sound quality factors.The mounting material uses high hardness precision zinc die-cast with a finish of micron order, and the rotating shaft uses specially processed metal alloy to realize quick and smooth reversing performance.A symmetrical configuration with capstan / pinch rollers and tape guides on both sides of the head keeps tape running stable.It uses a quick reverse that quickly detects and reverses the leader tape at the end of the tape with an LED sensor.The LED sensor detects quickly and accurately, and since it is a green light emission and transmission type, malfunctions caused by colored leader tapes with low transparency can be reduced to almost 0. The LED sensor, combined with the use of a DC motor for reverse, enables reliable reverse operation.The tape travel section consists of a 3-motor silent mechanism system that employs a DC servo motor for driving the capstan, as well as a high-torque DC motor for reel and reverse / head.Combined with a computer control system, it realizes excellent running performance and soft touch key operation. Especially when recording is reversed, the accurate muting operation eliminates the electrical click noise that is easily recorded on the tape and achieves quiet reverse.Sendust, which has excellent magnetic characteristics and abrasion resistance, is used for the gap and core parts of the head. In particular, the core part is equipped with a 2-layer laminated head core to obtain excellent characteristics.To prevent recording errors, such as recording on both sides of the tape instead of recording on one side, a tab monitor is installed to indicate whether recording on both sides of the tape is possible or not.The presence or absence of cassette tabs (tabs to prevent erroneous erasure) is detected and displayed on the panel.Equipped with a Dolby C noise reduction system.The driving mode can be switched over to 3 stages, the recording mode can be changed to round trip / one way, and the playback mode can be changed to 5 times endless / forward ? reverse / one-way.It is equipped with an auto-search function that continuously repeats 10 seconds playback and fast-forwarding of the intro part of the song.It is equipped with Auto Space Rec Mute, which automatically creates a 5-second non-recording space without performing any level control during recording, and emits air in a pose.

sections.title: ONKYO TA-9X
sections.overview: This is a high-grade stereo cassette deck developed by putting all the latest cassette recording technology into the core of Onkyo's original auto-accu-bias system.It uses a closed-loop dual capstan system in which two sets of capstan and pinch rollers are placed on both sides of the head to run the tape.In this system, since the large windows on both the left and right sides of the cassette half are used for drives, it was difficult to use a metal-compatible head with a strong hysteresis loop even in the case of two heads due to space considerations. However, we have solved this problem by developing an ultra-compact double-gap metal erasing head.The S & S Sendust Recording / recording / playback combination head designed for ideal distortion rate and frequency characteristics, with a wide gap for recording and a narrow gap for playback.The core material uses Sendust with excellent magnetic properties and ferrite-like hardness to demonstrate the performance of metal tape.In addition, we have adopted a double-gap ultra-small head that combines a newly developed material Dynaloy and ferrite for the erasing head, and by generating a strong magnetic field by the erasing current from the oscillation block, we have made the erasing function perfect.We have adopted a 3-motor system with exclusive high-torque DC motors for capstan drive, reel drive, and head base drive.The capstan drive motor uses a brushless FG servo DC motor that has received a top-class reputation for its quiet rotational performance and stable swing. Combined with the dual capstan system, this motor realizes excellent wow flutter.In addition, we have improved driving performance and maneuverability through a full-logic silent mechanism that centrally controls the operation of the drive train with a computer.Aiming for top quality during recording, we have developed and installed an auto-accurate bias system that best tunes the bias value for each tape to be used and obtains flat frequency characteristics.When the start button is pressed in the recording pose, the mixed output of two oscillators with low frequency of 400 Hz and high frequency of 10 kHz is recorded while the bias value is continuously changed. The mixed output is then compared and searched between the low and high frequency levels while simultaneously playing it with three heads. The bias value is locked at the point where the levels match. At the same time, the tape is rewound to the start position and waits in the recording pose.Bias tuning is usually completed in a short time of 5 seconds or less (maximum 15 seconds). Moreover, the best bias value is mechanically memorized when the Accu-bias control knob is operated after the auto-Accu-bias operation is completed and the Accu-bias indicator changes from green to red. Therefore, it is possible to take advantage of the auto-Accu-bias even in the case of unattended recording.Equipped with a real-time counter that displays the remaining time and elapsed time of the tape directly in minutes and seconds by switching the switch.A dual sensor system that detects the rotational speed not only from the delivery reel but also from the take-up reel and calculates the remaining time using a computer based on both rotational speeds. This system prevents in principle the effect of tape thickness depending on brand and grade and improves time detection accuracy.In addition, since the remaining time is displayed within a few seconds from any position during a performance, it is also effective when recording is started with a tape in the middle of rewinding. In addition, the remaining time display continues during fast-forward and rewinding in the same way as when playing.There are three types of remaining charge display switches, C-46/C-60/C-90. By simultaneously pressing any two of them, you can also use C-50 (46 and 60), C-80 (60 and 90), and C-120 (46 and 90) tapes.Equipped with Dolby C NR, the noise reduction operation start frequency is lower than that of Dolby B, and high reduction effect in the frequency band where noise reduction is required is obtained.In addition, by adopting a sliding band method in which the operation start frequency is changed according to the magnitude of the input level, the bleeding phenomenon (noise breathing phenomenon), which becomes more conspicuous as the noise improvement amount increases, is solved.In addition, it has a built-in anti-sound saturation circuit that detects over-level in the high-frequency range and suppresses the high-frequency range of the large input signal for recording. By restoring it during playback, the high-frequency saturation level is substantially improved.The built-in recording calibrator enables level correction even if the recording level is different from that of the reference tape.The Auto-Space / Rec Mute function is equipped. When you press the Auto-Space switch during recording, an unrecorded portion is automatically created for approximately five seconds and waits for recording with Rec-Pause.Equipped with digital level indicator using 2-color FL tube.It is a wide range type of -20dB to + 8 db with 7-point peak hold (approx. 3 seconds) that can read the peak value at the moment.Equipped with a timer standby mechanism.0 : 00 position, memory stop and play after rewind is possible.

It also has excellent characteristics in terms of weak points of ferrite such as cracking and chipping easily and temperature characteristics.A double belt drive system double-belt drive system that uses a flat belt for the capstan drive and a square belt for the take-up reel drive. This system eliminates the influence of the take-up reel drive and ensures that the capstan always rotates stably at a constant speed.The motor uses a PLL servo DC motor that compares the output frequency from the generator built into the motor with the reference frequency and detects the phase difference to keep the motor rotation speed constant.Equipped with Rec Mute for one touch no-signal recording, memory counter convenient for head-out and repeat performance, timer standby convenient for absence recording and alarm playback, and bias / equalizer independent 3-stage switching.Equipped with an INPUT selector to improve the S/N ratio during recording.It has a built-in Dolby system.Equipped with full auto-stop mechanism.Equipped with an automatic mode (stereo / mono) switching microphone jack.It is equipped with a headphone terminal that can also be used for high impedance type.Equipped with a large VU meter with crystal tone.Equipped with a 2-stage peak indicator to help correct the recording level.Cassette case with special thick flat glass is used.Equipped with AC outlet terminal.

sections.title: ONKYO TA-650
sections.overview: A cassette deck that supports metal tapes.A 2-motor configuration has been adopted for the mechanism part, and a high-precision FG servo DC motor for capstan drive and a DC motor for reel drive are mounted.It is directly driven by a large flywheel and a coaxial FG servo DC motor, which combines the simple structure inherent in the direct drive system and realizes excellent running performance.A special hard permalloy head with a hard guard is used for the recording / reproducing head. Permalloy, which has a reputation for good sound quality, is used as a basic magnetic material, and basic performance such as head touch, abrasion resistance, and saturation magnetic flux density are improved.First of all, in terms of sound quality, the contour effect is reduced by improving the head touch by adopting a hyperboloid head shape.In addition, the saturation magnetic flux density is expanded to support metal tape.As for durability, a hard layer called Mohs scale 8.5, which is equivalent to diamond, is specially deposited on the surface of permalloy to guard the core and ensure excellent abrasion resistance. In addition, parts without a core are also guarded with metal of the same hardness as the core to prevent uneven wear of the core.Equipped with a fade-out mechanism.The fade-out level and time can be freely adjusted in volume type, and it is a push switch type to prevent erroneous erasure.The operation system is feather touch full logic control.Switching from Play to a different function such as FF or Rew is a direct change method without via Stop, and the built-in Silent Stop with electromagnetic brake prevents the tape from being damaged.Equipped with a 3-stage tape selector for metal tapes.3-step switching between Metal, High and Norm is possible depending on the type of tape used.Equipped with an accu-bias control mechanism.By controlling the bias value to the optimum value, this function can cope with the subtle characteristics of the same type of tape depending on brand and grade.Built-in counter and built-in memory stop & play function.Equipped with a Rec Mute mechanism.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.Equipped with a standby mechanism, and by combining with a separately sold timer, it is possible to record your absence or play an alarm clock.Equipped with a full auto-stop mechanism to prevent stress on the mechanism and tape.There was a wired remote control as an option sold separately.
