sections.title: ONKYO TA-680
sections.overview: Stereo cassette deck for metal tape.The mechanism uses a dual capstan system that uses two pairs of pinch rollers and capstan.In this method, large windows on both the left and right sides of the cassette half are used for drives. Therefore, it was considered impossible to use a head that can handle metal tapes with strong hysteresis loops due to space considerations. To solve this problem, we developed a small erasing head for small windows in the TA-680.The head uses a double-gap head that combines ferrite and Dynaloy with a Sendust core.The Sendust Combination Head consists of a narrow head for playback and a wide head for recording.The erase head is an FX ferrite junction metal compatible erase head.In order to bring out the characteristics of the tape, it is equipped with auto accubias.In this circuit, the outputs of two oscillators, a low-frequency (400 Hz) and a high-frequency (10 kHz), are mixed, recorded while changing the bias current, played back simultaneously taking advantage of the three heads, compared between the low-frequency and high-frequency levels of the reproduced signal, and the bias current is fixed when the two levels become equal.During tuning, it can be confirmed by flashing green indicator.The fade-out function allows you to fade out and erase unwanted parts of a recorded tape while playing it back. The fade-out circuit erases the recorded content while maintaining an appropriate time constant (approximately 3 seconds).This circuit is also equipped with a safety mechanism to prevent accidental erasure.In order to prevent the tape from becoming painful, if you press FF to REW continuously, the function will be switched to the next function via the STOP position. In addition, with the full auto-stop system, the mechanism will be surely free at the tape end, so that no excessive force is applied to the motor or tape.Operability has been improved by adoption of feathertouch electromagnetic operation logic control circuit.A PLL servo motor is used to drive the capstan of the drive section.Equipped with a logarithmic compression type VU meter and 10-stage left / right independent peak indicators, memory play and rewind, timer recording and playback mechanism, equalizer / bias 3-stage independent switching, Dolby circuit with Rec level carriage, Rec Mute, microphone mixing circuit, microphone jack with automatic mode (stereo / mono) switching, headphone output terminal for high impedance, and soft eject mechanism.

sections.overview: Linear tracking DD full auto player equipped with dust cover auto lift-up mechanism.The tone arm bearing uses a gimbal servo system with high sensitivity and excellent stability. In combination with a straight short arm of linear tracking system, excellent trackability is obtained.Two stepping motors are used to drive the arms, and a microcomputer is used to operate the arms horizontally and vertically to improve the accuracy and stability of the operation.In addition to the normal full auto function, it is equipped with various auto functions such as search drive, memory repeat, and point memory which can store the start and end points of the part you want to listen to.The sensor automatically detects the record size.The dust cover is automatically raised with one touch of the eject button. sections.title: ONKYO PX-3
sections.overview: A full auto player with improved sound quality and operability by introducing the latest technology.It has a built-in computer and realizes accurate auto operation such as normal full auto operation, search drive, queue down / lift up, memory repeat operation, etc.Accurate operation is achieved by a fully non-side-pressure auto-return detection mechanism using CPU commands and photoelectric sensing elements, and by a pulse motor dedicated to arm drive.The newly developed straight tone arm is used for the tone arm.This arm has a linear structure that connects the rotating shaft with the needle tip at the shortest distance. It is a slim type made of hard aluminum material, yet it retains high rigidity. In addition, an ADC-type shell made of carbon fiber is used to minimize contact failure and resistance. In addition, in order to realize smooth movement of the tone arm, ultra-precision miniature bearings are used in the bearing section, and an extremely light feather support system is used in both vertical direction and horizontal rotation direction.As a result, the effective equivalent mass of the tone arm has been reduced to approximately 15g (1/2 compared to the conventional one), and the initial motion sensitivity is as high as 0.5 mg at the center value, greatly improving the traceability.In addition, when a high-compliance cartridge is mounted on an ordinary arm whose resonance frequency determined by the effective equivalent mass of the arm and the compliance of the cartridge is set to 6-7Hz, the infrasound component caused by the sleigh of the record is superimposed on the music signal and causes intermodulation. To prevent this, the resonance frequency is set to a value that suppresses the effect of the sleigh.The cartridge is equipped as standard with a VM type 0.6 mil circular needle OC-201V with a dual magnet structure similar to the recording cutter head.Uses a 20-pole, 30-slot vertical direct drive motor.Since the servo circuit instantaneously compensates for the sudden load fluctuation of the sound groove at large amplitude, smooth rotation characteristics are obtained.In order to improve the flatness of the record surface, the entire surface of the aluminum die-cast turntable is subjected to surface polishing with diamond to improve the horizontal accuracy of the surface to the same level as that of precision machining mechanisms.In addition, the turntable sheet is finished by center gate injection molding of transparent amorphous polyolefin instead of conventional rubber pressure molding to achieve uniform and highly accurate thickness.For the cabinet, a 4-layer polymerization combination cabinet combining materials with different physical properties is adopted for miniaturization and non-resonance.3kg/cm of metal plate for the upper layer, synthetic rubber viscoelastic special resin for the middle layer and impact resistant resin for the lower layer2Three layers are bonded under pressure to thoroughly reduce the vibration transmission of the turntable board. In addition, vibration-proof resin with different specific gravity from the body is used for the bottom plate part to prevent the effects of resonance overlapping and howling.The insulator has a composite structure combining a spiral coil spring that is particularly effective in low frequencies and a special shape rubber vibration isolator that is highly effective in middle and high frequencies.The resonance frequency formed by the total weight of the player and the player and the compliance of the coil spring, is approximately 10 Hz, and an excellent anti-vibration effect is exhibited in the audible frequency band above this.

sections.overview: This is a full auto player that inherits the design policy of the PX-8F and aims for thorough high fidelity.The tone arm uses a precision deadening and straight pipe arm that realizes lighter weight and higher rigidity for high compliance of the cartridge.In addition, in conjunction with the ADC-type carbon fiber head shell, the resolution has been improved by eliminating low-frequency resonance such as warping of records, internal distortion, and partial resonance.Equipped with VM cartridge with elliptical needle.The drive system uses Onkyo's unique quartz lock system high torque 20-pole 30-slot DD motor.In addition, the full-auto mechanism uses a motor exclusively for arm drive to achieve smooth operation, and employs a photoelectric detection type with no side pressure and no burden on the mechanism.

sections.title: ONKYO PX-8F
sections.overview: A full auto player with a straight arm.The tone arm is lighter in weight to improve the followability of the arm itself, and by skillfully setting the resonance point of the arm, adverse effects such as warping of records are eliminated as much as possible.In the PX-8F, by adopting a straight arm, the effective equivalent mass is reduced to 15g, which is about half of the conventional S-type arm.In addition, Pyrofil Carbon Fiber is used as the material. Carbon fiber with a diameter of 8 microns is hardened into a thin film with a thickness of only 0.125 mm by a special treatment method, laminated in three directions in different fiber directions, and shaped and polished into a pipe shape using a high-precision mandrel. This has the advantages of being free from rust and distortion over time, and having a shielding effect because it is conductive.For the tone arm support part, ultra-precision finished miniature bearings subjected to high heat hardening are used, and the feather support system which is very light in both vertical direction and shaft rotation direction is adopted, and the initial motion sensitivity shows an excellent value of 6.8 mg in center value.In addition, an ADC-type connector is used for the shell attachment / detachment part. Sliding pins with spring effect have a large contact area, do not easily become dirty, and have a self-cleaning effect by sliding, thus reducing the probability of contact failure.To detect the end of the record, we have adopted a completely non-side pressure system using photoelectric sensing elements.The near-infrared interrupter, which consists of a light-blocking shutter and photoelectric elements installed on the arm rotating shaft, detects the change in the amount of light entering the phototransistor within a certain period of time, and operates the return mechanism. It detects the large swing of the arm in the eccentric groove at the end of the record, and instantly performs functional processing of the change in the amount of light to identify the difference from the sound groove trace. This prevents accidents such as inadvertent return of the arm during performance.Uses a 20-pole, 30-slot quartz lock system high-torque DD motor.A frequency generator (FG) attached to the motor shaft detects the number of revolutions, and the detected signal is compared with an accurate reference signal obtained by dividing the frequency from a 5.52960 MHz crystal oscillator to compensate for slight disturbances in the rotation.In addition, the frequency generator employs an all-round integration type to cancel even a slight manufacturing error on the circumference, and constitutes a highly stable quartz PLL circuit.The turntable is a large turntable with a weight of 2.2 kg and a diameter of 33 cm. The dynamic balance of each product is checked and a precision finish is applied to obtain the optimum mass distribution. The turntable is 380 kg ? cm.2Moment of inertia.Equipped with continuously variable vari-pitch that can freely control the number of revolutions.The number of revolutions of the record can be freely and continuously varied within   5.9% of the chromatic scale, and the amount of change can be checked every 1% with the front LED indicator.A high-density particle board 15 mm thick is used for the cabinet, and a special shock absorber 3 mm thick is placed between it and the floor board, and it is supported by a composite acoustic insulator. This is a double insulation structure.The insulator consists of a spiral coil spring that is particularly effective in low frequencies and a special shape rubber vibration isolator that is highly effective in middle and high frequencies. The resonance frequency formed by the total weight of the player and the compliance of the coil spring is approximately 10 Hz, and excellent vibration damping effect is obtained in the audible frequency band above this.

sections.title: ONKYO PX-55F
sections.overview: This is a full-auto player system with double suspension system that blocks vibration twice.We have developed and installed a double suspension system to prevent adverse effects of speaker vibration transmitted through the floor surface and sound pressure (air vibration) transmitted from the air.This system uses a double vibration transmission isolation structure in which the signal system attached to the float base is suspended (transmission isolation) with respect to the cabinet and the cabinet is suspended (induction isolation) with respect to the floor surface. The float base is molded with high-rigidity and high-density zinc die-cast in the minimum required area, so that the direct influence of sound pressure is minimized in terms of physical properties and area.In this method, the arm and the motor are firmly connected, and the relative position displacement is suppressed, enabling more ideal tracing.In addition, the cabinet is made of high-density resin and concrete material that balances internal loss and effects on sound quality. For floor durability, it is suspended and stably supported by an 80 mm diameter large insulator that is strong against horizontal and vertical vibration.The motor is equipped with a 20-pole 30-slot quartz lock type high-torque DD motor. The rotation is corrected by a quartz PLL circuit to achieve stable rotation.The turntable is designed not only to be heavy but also to take into consideration the optimum mass distribution and flywheel effect. Each product is made of aluminum die cast with a weight of 1.5 kg and a diameter of 33 cm. The dynamic balance of each product is checked and precisely finished.The tone arm is a straight arm with the natural vibration frequency set to the optimum value.The support part of this arm uses a miniature bearing with a high heat hardened finish, and adopts a gimbal support system with smooth movement in both vertical direction and shaft rotation direction.In addition, the arm material is made of high rigidity aluminum finished by surface treatment with high acoustic effect to achieve both high sensitivity and clear sound quality.Equipped with a full auto mechanism that can control all tone arm movements, including search mechanism and auto-repeat, with front operation keys.The PX-55F uses a completely non-side pressure system with photoelectric sensing elements so that excellent trace capability is not lost due to the auto function.The cartridge is equipped with Orthophone VMS cartridge FF-15EO/mkII.In addition, the head shell adopts an ADC-type detachable type with self-cleaning effect made of carbon fiber.

sections.title: ONKYO PX-100M
sections.overview: A high-grade linear motor system with drastically improved rotational bare characteristics, aiming at the ideal phono motor.The PX-100M uses an induction type linear motor that drives the turntable directly around its outer circumference. This motor realizes excellent rotational accuracy. In addition, from the principle of operation as an induction type motor, the rotor has no magnetic pole, and there is no cocking phenomenon associated with the pushing and pulling of the magnetic pole in the movement of the rotor, and ideal smooth rotational characteristics are ensured by the continuous thrust given from the stator.The PX-100M has excellent bare characteristics and does not require a servo circuit. However, since the PX-100M has some slight variable elements such as temperature characteristics of lubricating oil between shaft and bearing, the minimum necessary servo is applied.The principle of linear motor rotation is that when a current is applied to a coil, a magnetic field is generated, and eddy currents are generated in the conductor in the magnetic field. When this magnetic field is moved in the rotational direction, the magnetic flux that cuts the overcurrent changes, so the disk is guided in the direction of the magnetic field. To move this magnetic field, a sine wave with a 90   phase difference is added. In fact, to increase efficiency, many poles with a 90   phase difference are superimposed. In addition, to increase the torque of the linear motor, the stator and rotor are opposed to each other in the center so that the magnetic flux acts effectively.In the case of the PX-100M, by arranging the stator 4 blocks facing the rotor symmetrically about the shaft center, torque unevenness is completely cancelled, and smooth rotation is realized.The turntable has a dead weight of 10 kg and an inertial mass of 2000 kg ? cm.2Moreover, it adopts a heavy class turntable made of pure copper machined, and an extremely thick and highly rigid stainless steel shaft with a shaft diameter of 20 mm and length of 94 mm.By molding pure copper, which has good electrical conductivity and is ideal for linear motor rotors, by machining it, it can be made compact because it has a specific gravity of 8.9. By machining it out of pure copper, the turntable and rotor can be finished in one piece because it is machined out of pure copper. Moreover, the accuracy of the rotor sandwiched between coils can be secured. In addition, dead-end material is attached to the back of the turntable to suppress the rumbling of the turntable.In addition, a tungaloy ball with higher hardness than any other metal is used at the lower end of the shaft, and ethylene resin is used for the thrust seat. The space between the shaft and ball is filled with special oil for heavy loads to improve abrasion resistance and S/N.A high-torque DC motor that operates only at start-up and a drive circuit are installed in order to quickly obtain constant speed rotation.In order to obtain high rigidity, the cabinet is subjected to precision processing by milling after forming an integrated aluminum casting.In addition, Al-Zn damping alloy is used as the material of the arm base, which is inserted into the cabinet and tightened.The turntable sheet is made of transparent amorphous polyolefin by center injection molding and has an excellent uniform thickness accuracy. This eliminates unwanted resonance caused by deterioration of the physical properties and adhesion of the turntable surface.Comes with an acrylic dust cover.The arm base for the long arm was sold separately.

sections.title: ONKYO DV-S939
sections.overview: DVD-Ultra compliant THX Audio/Video player.It has received strict THX Ultra certification with 60 items for video, 30 items for audio, and 20 items for operation.It is compatible with the progressive scan method in which the scan line is twice that of the interlace method.Moreover, since 24-frame images are converted into 60-frame images as they are at double speed, natural and smooth images are reproduced without overlapping fields or jagged outlines of subjects as in 3-2 pull-down processing (telecine conversion).Equipped with a 54 MHz / 10-bit video D/A converter. With 10-bit resolution exceeding the DVD format, reproduction is possible with a margin. In addition, by speeding up operation from the conventional 27 MHz to 54 MHz, over-sampling processing of progressive signals is possible, and horizontal resolution of 540 lines with progressive video is achieved.For both interlaced and progressive images, on-screen display provides image quality control.Equipped with an RS232 terminal, it is also compatible with home integrated control systems such as the AMX system.It also includes an expansion board slot for the IEEE1394 terminal that enables power supply and voice transmission with a single cable.Equipped with Dolby digital and DTS digital audio output jacks.Equipped with a Dolby digital decoder.Equipped with a 192 kHz / 24-bit D/A converter.It provides a stable DC supply and uses dual power supplies that prevent digital noise from entering the analog ground in the audio path.Equipped with a direct digital path circuit.Uses a magnetic shielding mechanism that does not affect the image and sound.Equipped with a video circuit off function that enables playback of better sound quality by temporarily turning off video signal processing.It is equipped with DNR function that can play back a source with a lot of image noise on a screen with less noise.It is equipped with a virtual remote control function that enables various remote control operations by displaying a picture of the remote control on the screen.It is equipped with a navigation function that displays a screen with operation icons and enables you to jump to the function you want to use.It has a capture function that can be used as a background by memorizing your favorite scene.The DB-25 interface allows multi-channel outputs to be connected via a single cable.It comes with a learning remote controller that can learn the remote control code of another connected device.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAC-1E
sections.overview: A CD player from the Quest Integra series that was developed and designed based on the concept of quality in search of the possibility of new sound.The D/A converter is equipped with a newly developed FPCS (Fine Pulse Conversion System) based on the ONKYO custom digital filter SM5843AP.The FPCS consists of the ONKYO custom digital filter SM5843AP combined with the Philips SSA7350 and TDA1547 (DAC7) x2. The SAA7350 used in the FPCS has an upsampling function of 192 fs when a signal of 4 times or 8 times is input. Good results can be obtained by using a digital filter with high calculation accuracy. Therefore, excellent characteristics can be obtained by combining it with the SM5843AP.The SM5843AP supports 20-bit in/out and achieves a 0.00003 dB ripple in the passband through high-precision arithmetic. In addition, unlike conventional digital filters, the SM 2000 AP employs image-processing technology in the field of computers to solve unnatural music expressions by sharply cutting out frequencies above the playback limit frequency (20 kHz), thereby realizing smooth interpolation.In addition, stable operation is achieved by using the Accu Pulse Quartz, which is a vibration-resistant rod-shaped crystal mounted on a polysorb cushion, as the master clock that serves as the reference for these devices.The power supply section is equipped with a LASER transformer with ultra-low leakage flux independently in digital and analog systems. In addition, seven systems, two analog systems, two D/A D/A conversion systems, one digital system, one mechanical system, and one muting system. This eliminates noise from the power supply, such as interference and interference. These power supplies are composed of the super linear power supply with low noise and low impedance characteristics used in the Integra series, and further improve sound quality.In addition, a static lighting system using LEDs is used on the display to prevent noise from the display from contaminating the music signal, and the muting and emphasis signals are separated by a photo-isolator to prevent interference from digital signal processing to the analog part.For the mechanism part, an open-top mechanism without unnecessary vibration such as a tray is adopted in the center arrangement. In order to reduce the effect of vibration, it is fixed to the chassis with an insulator with multiple resonance frequencies.In addition, it uses a weight chucking system that also serves as a disk stabilizer for removing brass.Construction is adopted in which digital signal processing part, D/A conversion part and analog signal processing part are arranged so as to surround the center arrangement mechanism.The power supply uses an ultra-low impedance, high-grade Chemi-Con and a 4A-type bridge rectifier diode, both of which have been used for separate amplifiers.Doyle Radarstein film capacitors and other parts are used in important parts of the signal system.Uses a highly rigid, non-magnetic all- aluminum extruding molded monocoque chassis with a 9 mm thickness front panel.This aluminum extruding molded monocoque chassis has a high-precision finish with an error of   0.5 mm using state-of-the-art high-precision machining technology. Ribs are provided on the inner and outer surfaces to improve chassis rigidity and reduce unnecessary resonance.The use of a thick AC cord reduces the power supply impedance.Equipped with an optical digital out terminal with on/off switch.Equipped with two gold-plated analog outputs, fixed and variable. The level of the variable terminal can be adjusted with the attached remote control.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAC-1EVER2
sections.overview: Based on the C-1E of the Quest Integra series, this is a CD player the basic operation of the circuit and introduced high-sound quality parts.The D/A converter has been developed and equipped with FPCS (Fine Pulse Conversion System) based on ONKYO custom digital filter SM5843AP.This FPCS configuration uses SM5843AP and two Philips SAA7350 and TDA1547 independently on the left and right. It uses the upsampling function that generates the 8 fs signal of SAA7350 to 192 fs. It is input to the D/A converter TDA1547 independent on the left and right through the data interface circuit, and realizes high-quality D/A conversion.In addition, in order to obtain a more accurate signal, it is equipped with a digital filter capable of smooth interpolation equal to twice the sampling frequency.The master clock for high-precision D/A conversion uses the AccuPulseQuartz method, in which a rod-shaped crystal oscillator with strong vibration is mounted on a polysorb cushion with excellent vibration control.In order to prevent adverse effects caused by noise in digital signal systems and mechanical systems, the power supply consisting of a LASER transformer with ultra-low leakage flux and a blue condenser is mounted independently on the analog and digital systems. In addition, the power supply is divided into seven systems : two analog systems, two D/A conversion systems, one digital system, one mechanical system, and one muting system. This eliminates noise and interference from the power supply.In addition, a static lighting system using LED is adopted for the display section to prevent contamination of the music signal due to noise from the display section.In addition, the muting and emphasis signals are separated by a photo-isolator to prevent interference from the digital signal processing section to the analog section.The front panel part is 9 mm thick, highly rigid, non-magnetic all-aluminum monocoque chassis is used.This chassis is finished to an accuracy of   0.5 mm by high-precision machining technology. By providing many ribs on the inside and outside, the rigidity of the chassis is improved and unnecessary resonance is reduced.The insulator is made of DuPont Corian, which has rigidity and vibration damping properties, to ensure non-resonance and high rigidity.As for the mechanical part, an open-top mechanism with less unnecessary vibration such as a tray is used in the center arrangement, and an insulator with multiple resonance frequencies is fixed to the chassis in order to suppress the effect of vibration.In addition, the weight chucking method, which also serves as a disk stabilizer for brass shaving, realizes an appropriate weight balance and enables error-free reading.Digital signal processing, D/A conversion section, and analog processing section are arranged around the center mechanism, and the construction emphasizes the flow of signals.The power supply unit uses a blue capacitor No. 923, which was developed over a period of three years, and high-quality parts such as Radarstein film cones.For the PIN terminal, a highly rigid brass machined gold plated terminal is used. When it is mounted on the rear panel, one pair of left and right is fixed rigidly with two points.The left and right terminals are separated by 18 mm to enable the use of PIN plugs.An optical digital out terminal with an ON/OFF switch is mounted. When not in use, digital noise can be reduced by turning it OFF.

sections.title: ONKYO C-1VL
sections.overview: A CD player with a clock that boasts the highest oscillation frequency accuracy in its class.The clock circuit uses a crystal oscillator with oscillation frequency deviation on the order of PPM (parts per million).This clock has a specially machined oscillation frequency deviation of   1.5 ppm at room temperature. Compared to the   50 ppm oscillator commonly used in this class of CD players, this crystal oscillator has one order of magnitude higher accuracy. The adoption of this crystal oscillator enhances the realistic reproduction of sound images and sound fields.The D/A converter is equipped with WM8740, a Wolfson D/A converter, independent of L/R.This DAC has a sampling frequency of up to 192 kHz and a bit depth of 24 bits. It has high S/N of 120 dB (mono) and 117 dB (stereo). In addition, it is designed to suppress digital noise, which adversely affects sound quality, and to reduce sound quality degradation caused by phase shift.VLSC (Vector Linear Shaping Circuitry) is used to eliminate digital noise.The analog signal output from the DAC chip contains a large amount of pulsed digital noise, which is hard to hear because of its high frequency. However, when noise is mixed into a music signal, it makes it difficult to hear the next minute sound information, or noise and noise make a beat and generate a new noise component within the audible band.The VLSC mounted on the C-1VL consists of a comparator, a vector generator, and an integrator. It generates a new analog signal with reference to the output of the DAC. This circuit does not respond to sudden changes such as digital noise, so the analog signal output from the VLSC has a waveform similar to the sound component of the DAC output without any noise component.In order to cope with the effects of vibration on sound, we have introduced a method to control harmful vibration to harmless vibration mode without killing sound by thoroughly investigating the location where harmful vibration occurs mainly in the mechanism.The casing panel is made of carefully selected materials and shapes such as aluminum and thick steel plates. The front panel and volume knob are made of highly rigid aluminum. In addition, the side panel is made of aluminum with ribs to increase the strength in the vertical direction, and the top panel is made of 1.2 mm steel plate to hold the entire casing firmly. Each part is made of different parts so that the material suitable for each part can be selected, and the propagation of vibration at the top and side parts is prevented.In addition, taping is applied to parts of the housing that are susceptible to vibration.The power supply section is equipped with a toroidal transformer with low leakage flux and good regulation.The output terminal uses a machined gold plated pin jack.The legs use a brass machined insulator.Uses a Direct Digital Path that minimizes the negative impact of digital output signals on sound circuits.Equipped with digital output ON/OFF switching function.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAC-300X
sections.overview: CD player with optical transmission system.The optical transmission system adopted in the C-300X is a further development of the conventional one. It eliminates digital signal interference (D. S. I.) by adopting new methods combining optical and electronic technologies such as optical transmission devices, optoelectronic modules, and in-phase transformers.In this optical transmission system, an optolink module (front transmission element) is used to transmit data signals with relatively high digital frequencies of 176.4 kHz to 4.3218 MHz that fluctuate. Other clock signals, emphasis signals, and muting signals are transmitted by a hybrid IC with an in-phase transformer inserted. The digital and analog signals are separated by the in-phase transformer to eliminate the penetration of digital noise.An output-in-phase transformer is also added to the left and right outputs to prevent digital signal interference (D.S. I.) from entering the amplifier.The D/A converter is equipped with a 16-bit double oversampling digital filter and a D/A converter.The mechanism uses an integrated, precision finished 3-beam pickup.In consideration of deterioration of sound quality due to external vibration, rigidity is increased by installing X stabilizers made of PbSb special alloys with four legs connected by X type. In addition, the pickup section adopts I. F.S (Isolated Floating Suspension) structure which is separated from the chassis and suspended by non-repulsion rubber and spring to improve reading accuracy.In addition, a special anti-vibration material mixed with mica or resin-based material is attached to the cover, which is most susceptible to external resonance, to prevent the cover from ringing.It is equipped with a 16-track random memory performance function, a direct selection function, a 2-speed fast forward / quick return function, and a repeat function.Equipped with a headphone output with volume.A 10-key remote control is included.

sections.title: ONKYO C-301FX
sections.overview: CD player equipped with ACCU BIT system.The D/A converter uses a left-right independent 18bitD/A converter, and is equipped with an ACCU BIT adjustment system to further improve the accuracy of D/A conversion.The 18bitD/A converter consists of 18 pairs of precise resistor networks (ladder networks). When a digital signal is converted into an analog signal, this ladder network changes the voltage of the analog signal source. The slight error in the resistance value causes distortion and affects sound quality.The conversion accuracy of the C-301FX is improved by the ACCU BIT system, which performs precise adjustment of the left and right resistor networks and corrects the error of the resistance value. In particular, linearity at the input of small signals is greatly improved.The digital filter is equipped with an 8 x oversampling digital filter.The sampling frequency is shifted to 352.8 kHz, which is 8 times the sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz, to keep it away from the music signal, thereby eliminating the influence of digital noise.This system uses an optical transmission method to convert digital signals into optical switching signals for transmission. The optical transmission of data interrupts the electrical loop and prevents digital noise from entering analog circuits.Equipped with a time edit function, recording can be performed according to the length of the tape.If you enter the tape size using the TIME/EDIT and UP/DOWN keys, you can display the number of songs to be recorded on the A and B sides, start playing and recording, and wait for a pause when the last song on the A side is finished. If you play a CD together with the recording operation on the B side of the cassette tape, recording of the songs on the B side starts.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: ONKYO C-303

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAC-500X
sections.overview: CD player with optical transmission system.Optical transmission systems use optolink modules (optical transmission devices) packaged with optical fibers and photocouplers to convert digital signals into optical switching signals for transmission. Digital and analog signals are electrically separated to reduce mutual interference.The C-500X transmits Route 6 digital signals optically, and uses an opto-link module and a photo-coupler, which are connected by an 11 mm optical fiber between the transmitting and receiving optical elements, depending on the transmission speed. Newly developed opto-link modules are used for bit clocks, word clocks, and data signals that require relatively high speeds, while photo-couplers are used for L/R clocks, emphasis signals, and muting signals that require normal speeds. The former data signals are transmitted at relatively high digital frequencies from 176.4 kHz to 4.3218 MHz. If the distance between the light-emitting element and the light-receiving element is narrow, the effect of optical transmission cannot be obtained due to interference caused by electrical / electrostatic coupling. Therefore, the distance between the elements of the opto-link module is wide and the analog circuits are shielded.In addition, all optical transmission systems that require high speed are IC-fired, and are miniaturized to increase speed.As a vibration countermeasure, the whole mechanism is supported by four points with non-resilient rubber developed by Onkyo, and the mechanism body is also covered with an outsert compound molded product to enhance the vibration prevention effect.For the cover, we adopted a non-high-speed vibration control structure that converts and absorbs pressure vibration energy into thermal energy, and developed a special material mixed with mica and resin-based materials to protect the circuit from external vibration.A 96th order oversampling digital filter is used to cut out the high-frequency centered on the sampling frequency of 44.1 khz without affecting the phase characteristics of audio signals up to 20 khz.By doubling the sampling frequency to 88.2 kHz and reducing the load on the following analog filters, phase and frequency characteristics have been improved.Equipped with newly developed low pass filter for exclusive use of oversampling.Non-contact switch is used for Play button.Equipped with a headphone output with volume.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAC-501X
sections.overview: A CD player equipped with a light-driven D/A converter.The D/A converter employs a 4 x oversampling digital filter and an optically driven D/A converter.A general D/A converter generates an analog signal by changing the current supplied from a constant current source in a ladder network according to the digital data. Therefore, the constant current source that is the source of the analog signal must be as pure as possible. The optical drive system pays attention to this point and generates the constant voltage of the constant current source based on the stable voltage obtained from the photovoltaic element to obtain a stable and more accurate analog signal.Light-driven D/A converters are packaged with special resin materials containing electromagnetic wave absorbers to absorb and attenuate external electromagnetic wave noise and minimize adverse effects on the inside.In order to protect the pickup system and electronic circuit from external vibration and internal vibration of the motor, etc., the high-rigidity HEXA BALANCE BASE made of special alloy is adopted. This base is a 6-point installation structure of deformed H type, and the chassis frame is built on this solid foundation to realize high-rigidity construction, damping effect and balanced weight distribution.In addition, two legs are provided on the base near the pickup mechanism to support and vibration-proof the mechanism part mainly. This base is dumped using special rubber with three hemispherical shapes and high internal loss, and vibration-proof effect is enhanced by unequal division.An isolated floating suspension structure has been adopted in which the mechanical part, which is made of an outsert compound molded product with a large damping effect, is separated from the main body chassis and suspended by a spring and non-resilient rubber.A special anti-vibration material mixed with mica or resin-based materials is attached to the cover to prevent the cover from sounding and to eliminate interference with mechanical devices and circuits.The audio amplifier section uses a super servo amplifier, and the circuit after the D/A converter does not use an output capacitor. This reduces the influence of the sound character caused by the coupling capacitor.In addition to the 20-key music selection mechanism and editing function, a random calendar that allows input in the order of performance and music selection has been adopted to improve operability.Equipped with two digital outputs.Equipped with a level variable headphone jack.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAC-700
sections.overview: A CD player that uses an optical transmission system using optical fiber cable to completely separate digital and analog signals.An optical transmission method is adopted in which the output of the digital filter at the final stage of the digital circuit and the D/A converter are connected by optical fiber. By this method, digital and analog signals are completely separated in both the signal line and ground line, and adverse effects on analog circuits caused by digital signals with pulse components, such as clock signals, servo signals for rotating and optical systems, and display signals, are minimized.In optical fiber transmission between digital and analog, a total of 16 channels of optical signals are output, including four channels of signals (L/R clock, word clock, bit clock, and data signal) through serial conversion of 16-bit digital signals, and two channels of de-emphasis and audio muting signals which connect the audio circuit to the microcomputer of the system control.It is equipped with a 2 x oversampling digital filter to sharply cut the ultra-high frequency components (24.1 kHz to 64.1 kHz) centered on the 44.1 kHz sampling frequency without affecting the audio signal.The analog filter is equipped with a 7th active low-pass filter.In order to accurately and stably capture pits, mechanical parts such as laser pickups, pickup drive motors, and disk rotation motors are integrated with an outsert chassis.In addition, the head block has a vibration-proof structure floating from the main chassis, making it less susceptible to external vibration and impact, and improving tracing capability.In the power supply section, the power transformer windings are separated into analog and digital windings, and the windings are shielded to prevent mutual interference.In addition, a delta turbo circuit is added to the analog power supply to suppress modulation noise generated from the transformer and improve the quality.The analog circuits after the D/A converter use ONKYO's unique super servo system.By feeding back to the D/A converter with a super servo circuit, unnecessary ultra-low frequency components such as distortion and noise components generated by the D/A converter etc. are cut off, and large capacitance capacitors in the signal path are removed.It is equipped with functions such as memory performance of up to 16 songs, jump selection function in forward and reverse directions, 2-speed fast forward and fast backward functions, queue review function, index search function, all songs / block repeat function, pause function, etc.Equipped with a headphone output with volume.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAC-701XD
sections.overview: A CD player with a real 18-bit optical converter.It uses an optical converter that uses stable electrical energy derived from pure light energy as an analog signal source. This provides a dedicated power supply that is completely independent from the power supply to other circuits. As a result, fluctuations in power supply voltage due to the operation of all circuits and mixing of digital noise are prevented, and the purity of music signals is increased.For digital-to-analog conversion, high-precision 18-bit D/A converters are installed in an independent 2 dac configuration on the left and right sides.This 18-bit D/A converter performs D/A conversion at four times the resolution of 16-bit to improve the conversion accuracy, and the quantization noise is 1/4.The C-701XD D/A converter is, in principle, an 18-bit charge-transfer-type D/A converter using C-MOS without 0 cross distortion. It can be driven with almost no current, so it is not affected by digital noise and has high sound quality.The digital filter uses an independent left / right 18-bit 4-times oversampling digital filter.The sampling frequency is shifted up four times to 176.4 kHz, and unnecessary high-order noise is shifted to the high-frequency range. It is removed by a low-pass filter with gentle cut-off characteristics summarized by the sense of hearing.In order to prevent noise from entering the analog circuit from the digital circuit, the digital circuit. By converting the digital signal into an optical switching signal and transmitting it, the loop is electrically disconnected, preventing digital noise from entering the analog circuit.The optical transmission element uses an optolink module that connects the transmitting and receiving elements with optical fibers, and the speed has been increased up to 3 times.In order to eliminate vibration interference from inside and outside, it adopts a double chassis structure in which two types of special damping materials are sandwiched between two chassis. The rigidity is strengthened by overlapping two chassis, and vibration is absorbed by the damping material inside.In order to suppress interference between each circuit, a separator is installed between the power supply block and the circuit block to separate them, thereby eliminating the invasion of magnetic flux.The pickup uses the same mechanism as the C-901XD. The pickup is driven by a newly developed linear slide motor mechanism that allows high-speed access and reduces vibration.In this mechanism, the strength of the mechanism is increased by using high-rigidity material, and vibration is controlled by isolating each part by using special spring and non-repulsion rubber at the mounting part. In addition, we have developed a heavy-weight hybrid die-cast tray that combines two kinds of metals, i.e., damping zinc die-cast and aluminum structural material, to increase vibration control effect.Digital / analog exclusive power supply with separate digital / analog windings is adopted.Super servo amplifier configuration is adopted.With the Time Edit function, when recording from a CD to a cassette, by entering the tape size of the cassette, the number of songs to be recorded on the A side and B side and the accumulated time are displayed.Equipped with output level volume and headphone port.Wireless remote control is included.

In addition, it is equipped with dual optical converters that support the left and right D/A converters, each with its own constant current source.In the optical converter, the constant current source is separated from the power supply of other digital and analog circuits, so that high purity transmission without interference from external noise is possible.The D/A converter is equipped with an independent 18-bit super-real D/A converter for the left and right.The ladder type 18-bit D/A converter has sufficient quality even when used without adjustment. Normally, only the heaviest bit (1 bit) is adjusted. However, the C-901XD is adjusted by 4 bits each on the right and left sides to realize more accurate D/A conversion.An optolink module and a photocoupler, which connect optical transmission and receiving elements with optical fibers, are selected according to the transmission speed. By transmitting light through all six signal paths, the loop is electrically disconnected and digital noise is eliminated.The digital filter uses an 8 x oversampling digital filter to shift the sampling frequency from 44.1 frequency from kHz to 352.8 kHz, 8 times the sampling frequency, and reduces the cutoff characteristics of the low-pass filter, which can cause sound quality degradation.In addition, this 8 x oversampling digital filter outputs 8 times as much data as the original audio signal, so you can enjoy the quality of the original sound that does not pass through the low-pass filter from the output of DAC direct (immediately after D/A conversion).In order to suppress the effects of acoustic feedback and vibration from the floor, we have developed a box structure (double chassis) that is fully tightened to the front, back, left and right sides to increase rigidity. In addition, we have adopted a double chassis as a base, which absorbs vibration propagated from the bottom plate and chassis by two special damping materials sandwiched inside the box structure.The main body of the mechanism is a highly rigid chassis with a resonance dispersion structure that combines a 1.6 mm chassis with an outsert compound molded product. In addition, the sub-chassis mounted on the pickup has the same structure as the main body. It is separated from the main body chassis, and vibration control in both vertical and horizontal modes is performed by special spring and silicon rubber.In addition, the chassis of the mechanical body is attached to a high-rigidity double chassis separated by a non-resilient rubber and a double isolated system is adopted, which reduces internal vibration and speaker vibration.The pickup is driven by a newly developed linear slide motor mechanism with less vibration.To prevent magnetic flux from the power supply, a separator is installed between the power supply block and the electronic circuit block. The top cover is also a two piece structure to completely separate the two blocks. A separator is also installed between the digital circuit block and the analog circuit block to reduce digital noise.The power supply section has a two transformer configuration with a transformer for digital and analog only. The audio transformer has a capacity margin of 300%.It is equipped with two digital outputs, coaxial and optical, and analog outputs of fixed, variable and direct Route 3.In particular, the analog direct connector allows direct output from the D/A converter without passing through an analog low-pass filter.Equipped with a random double calendar.It is equipped with gold plated headphone terminal and output level volume.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: ONKYO INTEGRAC-901FX
sections.overview: The CD player is equipped with an Accupulse D/A converter which combines an Accupulse quartz system and a single-bit D/A converter for the D/A converter.In order to obtain an accurate signal cycle of digital signals, it is equipped with an accupulse quartz system with improved crystal oscillator and oscillation circuit. In addition to adopting a small crystal with a shape that is not easily affected by external vibration, the element is protected by an anti-vibration material (Paris Solar Bar) to suppress external vibration. In addition, the oscillation circuit is equipped with a resonance circuit consisting of a capacitor and a coil, and has an electric flywheel effect to absorb instantaneous fluctuations.It is also equipped with a 0 shift noise shaper that disperses quantization noise frequency characteristics to 0 points to reduce high-frequency noise in the audio band. This ensures 16-bit accuracy in the entire audio band while maintaining 20-bit accuracy up to 12 kHz, which is important for audibility.In addition, during the conversion process from digital to analog, it passes through a PWM (pulse width modulation) circuit. Two PWM converters are installed to solve problems such as high-level signals and distortion at high frequencies.These two PWM circuits are operated in complimentary service, and the output of each is input to a distortion canceler circuit to cancel out the distortion components and output only the audio signal.By applying these technologies to a single-bit D/A converter, we have eliminated the 0 cross distortion and non-linear distortion that conventional multi-bit D/A converters have.The disc tray uses high-rigidity aluminum die-cast to eliminate unwanted resonance during disc playing.In addition, by laying out in the center part where vibration is least transmitted, transmission of harmful resonance modes is suppressed and vibration is not transmitted to electronic circuits.In addition, a high-speed access linear motor is adopted for the drive system to realize quick operation.The mechanism computer simulation, the mechanism is located at the center where vibration is minimal, separated from the chassis. In addition, a super isolated floating suspension with special spring and silicon rubber for vibration control in both vertical and horizontal modes is adopted to eliminate the influence of disturbance vibration.The power supply section is equipped with two LASER transformers unique to Onkyo that reduce the magnetic leakage flux to approximately 1 / 30 of that of conventional transformers, thereby reducing the leakage flux that generates harmful noise due to magnetic induction in electronic circuits.Using an optical transmission method, CD data is optically transmitted and the electrical loop is cut off prevent digital noise from entering the analog circuit.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: A CD player developed with the aim of the extreme dynamism of compact disc.The D/A converter uses a light-driven D/A converter. It is packaged with a special resin material containing an electromagnetic wave absorber and filled with zircon sand to make it into a hybrid IC. This reduces the noise of parts and reduces the influence of external electromagnetic wave noise.The D/A converter uses a real 18-bit system to increase the dynamic range and linearity of the D/A converter while improving the precision by the optical drive. This allows the D/A converter to recover low-order bits that have been lost due to masking caused by semiconductor noise and other factors, thereby achieving an excellent dynamic range and signal-to-noise ratio.In addition, the phase difference is suppressed by the left and right independent configuration.The digital filter uses an 18-bit 4-times oversampling digital filter, and the analog filter uses an operational amplifier discrete 5th order GIC analog filter.An optical transmission method using five optical fibers is adopted for transmission between digital and analog blocks. A shield plate is installed between the power supply block for analog circuits and the power supply block for digital circuits to provide an independent layout, thereby shielding high-frequency band digital noise entering from the power supply line.To prevent electromagnetic interference, the digital circuit section is completely encased in aluminum, and the analog circuit section is double-shielded with an aluminum case and electromagnetic wave absorber.It uses a high carbon steel rigid chassis with high rigidity and high mass and excellent vibration reduction effect. The pickup mechanism and all circuits are fixed on the base. This not only blocks vibration from the outside, but also absorbs vibration from internal components such as disk motors and power transformers, increasing the completeness of the system.High Carbon Steel is an alloy with an unusually large damping capacity for a metal. It has a structure of overlapping flaky crystals and has a characteristic of converting vibration energy into thermal energy and absorbing it.The pickup block uses a mechanism that uses a total of four motors. Among them, the pickup drive is equipped with a high-speed access linear motor to realize high-speed and smooth access operation.It is equipped with optical / coaxial digital output terminals using a latch degree digital output circuit that outputs a digital signal after eliminating the jitter component, and equipped with two analog outputs, fixed and variable.The FF/FR (Fast Forward / Backward) function for searching the contents of the song is concentrated in one, and the shuttle search with the large diameter knob allows you to move to the desired position either forward or backward. sections.overview: A CD player developed using the know-how accumulated through the Integra series of amplifiers.Uses a super turbo system that cuts off the power transformer purely electrically.This system uses two circuits, a delta turbo circuit and a turbo filter circuit, to solve the problem of harmful modulation noise caused by the transformer, and suppresses the modulation noise generated by flux generated from the transformer and harmonic spectrum generated by pulse wave for Chemi-Con charging.An 11th-order low-pass filter is used to prevent beat interference (aliasing noise) that occurs between the harmonics of the audio frequency and the sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz.In addition, it employs a super servo circuit that cuts out unnecessary DC components (ultra-low frequencies) that cause intermodulation distortion. sections.title: OTARI MX-5050
sections.overview: A tape deck developed from a 2-track, 38 cm model to professional class.The MX-5050 has eight variations, including 2-track stereo, 4-track stereo, 4-track 4-channel, and full-track mono. In both cases, the mechanical part is mounted on the same mount, and the amplifier part is mounted on the same mount or in two stages.We have adopted a reel motor with spare capacity for Type 10 metal reel.It uses a durable brake.An orthodox single capstan drive system is adopted.Edit operation is possible.All the controls are logic operation and feather touch type.It uses a full-scale rotation switch, allowing direct operation from FWD or RWD to PLAY (REC) MODE.Uses Permalloy head.Synchronous lip switch that can be played back by recording head allows simultaneous recording without time delay (multi-recording)The SRL (reference level) switch allows the output level to be fixed regardless of the position of the OUTPUT volume.Canon terminals are used for input / output connectors.You can adjust the recording bias, recording equalizer and SRL level from the front of the amplifier.An oscillator with a 1 kHz reference signal is built in for bias adjustment and CUE tone recording.

sections.title: OTARI MX7000
sections.overview: A tape deck developed for professionals.3-motor 4-head configuration is adopted.The head assembly can be replaced by a plug-in, and you can select your favorite recording format from 1 channel to 4 channels (synchronous playback is possible).The capstan motor uses a specially designed 3-speed hysteresis synchronous motor.Aluminum alloy is used for the base part of the mechanism to improve durability.All transistors are used for the internal circuit.There are six variations of the MX7000 depending on the recording method and head configuration, and four of them (MX7000-F, MX7000-H, MX7000-3X, MX7000-QX) were made to order.
